studio:prompts3:ours-1192.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Modern vertical app release-notes announcement card, designed as a polished editorial UI poster for an in-app update notice.
Shareable 2:3 mobile release-note layout with strong information hierarchy, version emphasis, three update items, realistic app-news metadata, and a premium product-launch feeling.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: centered rounded card occupying about 86% of the canvas width and 90% of the height, with the hero header block in the top 20%, three update rows in the middle 50%, and the CTA + footer information anchored in the bottom 16%.
- Background treatment: white #FFFFFF to near-white #F8FAFC canvas with a faint electric-blue radial glow, soft cool-gray floating UI tiles, small abstract app-icon glyphs, and subtle dotted grid accents that make the poster feel like a real SaaS update announcement.
- Spacing, framing direction: left-aligned text columns inside the centered card, editorial vertical rhythm, app-store-style clarity, realistic metadata labels, compact footer details, and polished product-card depth.
- Use {서비스명}, {버전}, {새 기능}, {개선}, {수정} placeholders as the exact Korean content hierarchy.
- Add credible release-note supporting content around the placeholders: small eyebrow label “릴리즈 노트”, date label “2026.05.01”, channel chip “Stable”, release ID text “RN-2026-05”, slide/page indicator “01 / 03”, and a tiny service-team handle “@update.team” where appropriate.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header area (top 20%): set {서비스명} as the primary title in a bold editorial UI style, slightly left-aligned; place a compact rounded {버전} badge immediately beside or just below the title, using a premium pill shape with strong contrast and tight padding. Above it, include a small uppercase/Korean eyebrow line reading “릴리즈 노트 · 업데이트 안내”.
2) Header metadata strip: add a slim row under the title with “2026.05.01”, “Stable”, “RN-2026-05”, and “01 / 03” separated by tiny blue dots or short dividers, giving the card an authentic product-release bulletin feel.
3) Intro divider: add a thin electric-blue accent line or small geometric separator beneath the header, spanning about 26% of the card width, paired with a tiny sparkle or arrow glyph to signal the start of the release notes.
4) Feature rows (middle 50%): show three separate rows with a small blue icon bullet or numbered marker on the left and the corresponding text on the right; row 1 for {새 기능}, row 2 for {개선}, row 3 for {수정}; each row should be readable at a glance with clear spacing and aligned baselines.
5) Row styling: each update item should sit inside a refined rounded rectangle with layered pale-blue highlights, light gray dividers, inset padding, micro labels such as “NEW”, “IMPROVED”, and “FIXED”, and tiny supporting captions in Korean such as “새롭게 추가됨”, “사용성 향상”, “안정성 수정”.
6) CTA area (bottom 16%): place a prominent filled button reading “지금 업데이트하기” centered across the width of the card, with electric-blue fill, white text, rounded corners, and clear tap-target proportions. Add a secondary microtext line below it reading “업데이트 후 더 빠르고 안정적인 경험을 만나보세요”.
7) Footer details: include a small footer row with “{서비스명} 업데이트 센터”, “문의 support@example.com”, and a tiny QR-code-like decorative block or barcode-style release marker in the lower corner, rendered as a design element rather than a scannable official code.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; title ExtraBold 54-64px, version badge Medium 24-28px, metadata 18-22px, body SemiBold 28-34px, row label Bold 16-18px, CTA Bold 30-34px, footer 14-18px, with crisp anti-aliased Korean text.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, electric blue #2F6BFF, deep blue #1746D0, cool gray #E9EEF5, pale blue #EEF4FF, slate text #1F2937, secondary gray #6B7280, tiny accent cyan #4DD5FF.
- Border/shadow: rounded corners 28px, layered soft drop shadow 0px 10px 30px rgba(23,70,208,0.10), extra ambient card shadow 0px 28px 70px rgba(31,41,55,0.08), button shadow 0px 6px 18px rgba(47,107,255,0.22).
- Decorative UI details: small app-style icon chips, dot-grid accents, release timeline ticks, thin divider lines, and subtle blue gradient highlights may be used to enrich the product announcement while preserving readability.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: crisp UI mockup look, orthographic front view, no perspective distortion, as if captured as a high-resolution product poster; render the card with tactile paper-like UI layering and realistic soft shadows.
- Lighting: even studio diffused lighting with a very slight cool top-left highlight, gentle ambient shadowing for depth, and a faint reflected blue glow around the CTA button.
- Color grade: clean white + electric blue + soft cool-gray, high contrast for legibility, modern SaaS-app aesthetic with realistic release-campaign polish.
- Surface detail: smooth rounded-card material, subtle glassy highlight on the version badge, faint noise/grain in the background gradient, and carefully aligned vector-like UI components.

[6. MOOD]
Premium mobile product update card — a polished SaaS release note poster with Apple App Store announcement energy, card-news readability, and a real product-team launch notice feel.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “{서비스명}”, “{버전}”, “{새 기능}”, “{개선}”, “{수정}”, “지금 업데이트하기” must appear exactly and be clearly readable.
- Additional Korean text should be clean and readable, including “릴리즈 노트”, “업데이트 안내”, “새롭게 추가됨”, “사용성 향상”, “안정성 수정”, and “업데이트 후 더 빠르고 안정적인 경험을 만나보세요”.
- Layout invariants: the version badge must be visible near the title, all 3 update items must be present as separate rows, and the CTA button must stay at the bottom.
- All Korean characters must be clean, correctly rendered, and not distorted.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals or certification marks

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Four-panel personalized avatar set in a square 2x2 grid, designed for profile use, social sharing, and a polished character-introduction card.
Each quadrant shows the same person as a different genre portrait, with strong identity consistency, cinematic environmental detail, and clear visual separation between the four concepts.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The subject fills about 70% of each quadrant, with a chest-up to shoulder-up crop so the face reads instantly as an avatar while still showing costume, collar, accessories, and theme-specific atmosphere.
- Use {레이아웃} to keep four equal panels with refined separators, small corner metadata, and a cohesive square presentation optimized for profile viewing.
- Add tasteful theme-specific backgrounds, realistic surface textures, atmospheric light, props, and depth cues that naturally belong to each world: neon signs, fabric weave, carved wood, foliage, armor details, helmet reflections, star fields, and floating particles.
- Maintain the exact same facial identity, hairstyle baseline, and age impression across all four versions while changing costume, props, lighting, setting, and material details.
- Use {비율} to keep the composition optimized for profile-image readability, with each face centered enough for a thumbnail but enriched with visible world-building details around the shoulders and background.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left quadrant: {참고 이미지} reimagined as a cyberpunk future character, centered close-up portrait with neon signage glow on the face, wet street reflections, translucent AR interface fragments, thin fiber-optic clothing seams, chrome tech accessories, faint rain droplets, and a dark urban alley background with blue-violet light spill.
2. Top-right quadrant: {참고 이미지} depicted in a Joseon-era setting, wearing traditional Korean attire with visible silk texture, subtle embroidered collar details, a norigae-inspired accessory or hair ornament where appropriate, warm hanji-paper lighting, carved wooden window frames, muted palace interior colors, and gentle historical atmosphere.
3. Bottom-left quadrant: {참고 이미지} transformed into a fantasy elf, with subtly pointed ears, refined elven accessories, delicate gold filigree, layered forest-green fabric, a mystical woodland background, mossy tree bark, floating firefly-like lights, soft bokeh, luminous foliage, and faint magical particles behind the shoulders.
4. Bottom-right quadrant: {참고 이미지} as an astronaut, with the face framed by a polished space helmet or structured suit collar, realistic suit panels, tiny utility markings, reflective visor edges, cosmic stars, deep space gradients, a faint nebula glow, and small highlights suggesting the reflection of a spacecraft window.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: include small, crisp Korean concept labels and card-like micro details that feel like a premium avatar lineup, not a poster. Suggested readable Korean labels: top-left “미래 도시”, top-right “조선의 결”, bottom-left “숲의 수호자”, bottom-right “우주 탐사”. Add a tiny set title near the center separator or lower edge: “나의 4가지 세계”.
- Additional graphic details: add subtle corner ticks, tiny profile-card metadata such as “AVATAR SET 04”, “VOL.2026”, or “PROFILE STUDY”, plus small decorative icons or stickers matching each theme, while keeping the face as the primary focal point.
- Color palette: use {컬러} as the theme base; cyberpunk in neon blue #19B7FF, violet #8A4DFF, black #0B0F1A; Joseon in ivory #F4EBDD, indigo #2E3A59, muted red #8C4A4A; elf in forest green #2F5D3A, moss #7A8F3A, gold #C9A24E; astronaut in charcoal #1B1F2A, silver #C7CCD6, deep space blue #0A1633.
- Border/shadow: refined separators that adapt to panel brightness, with a subtle drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity around each avatar crop; allow small overlaps of light, particles, helmet reflections, or graphic ticks to make the grid feel dimensional.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.4 portrait look, shallow depth of field, crisp facial focus, soft background separation, and natural skin detail preserved across all four versions.
- Lighting: cyberpunk uses cool artificial neon from upper-right with a faint rim light and reflective rain highlights; Joseon uses soft diffused daylight from upper-left with warm bounce from hanji and polished wood; elf uses dappled forest light with gentle backlight, green-gold glow, and soft floating particles; astronaut uses a studio softbox frontal key with cool edge lighting, visor reflections, and subtle deep-space contrast.
- Color grade: cinematic high-contrast portrait grading, with each quadrant tinted to its theme while keeping skin tones natural and consistent across the set.
- Realism: make costumes, accessories, hair strands, skin texture, fabric, metal, glass, foliage, and atmospheric effects tactile and believable, like a professionally retouched editorial character portrait set.

[6. MOOD]
Concept art character lineup — a vivid, high-end profile-avatar showcase with the clarity of premium game key art, the personality of a social profile card, and the realism of an editorial portrait shoot.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: any rendered Korean text must be short, clean, and legible, especially “미래 도시”, “조선의 결”, “숲의 수호자”, “우주 탐사”, and “나의 4가지 세계”.
- All four quadrants must clearly depict the same individual from {참고 이미지}, with consistent face shape, eyes, nose, mouth structure, hairstyle baseline, and age impression across every theme.
- Maintain consistent expression range using {표정} so the subject is unmistakably the same person while each concept has its own lighting, costume, and atmosphere.
- Use {컨셉 4종} as the guiding theme set while preserving the four-panel avatar concept and keeping each portrait readable at social-media thumbnail size.
- Each panel must show only one main person, with no duplicate faces or background characters stealing attention from the avatar.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Elegant vertical family invitation card for a 돌잔치 or 환갑 celebration, combining a personalized portrait hero, rich Korean ceremonial details, and clear event information.
Designed for print-like social sharing with a refined Korean celebration editorial feel, like a premium printed invitation photographed in soft natural light.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main portrait hero is centered and occupies the upper 50% of the canvas, framed to emphasize {주인공} clearly with a warm family-celebration atmosphere around the portrait.
- Event information block sits in the lower 50% with refined hierarchy, centered alignment, and realistic invitation-card typography.
- Background uses a soft pastel cream-pink surface with visible fine paper grain, gentle hanji texture, faint floral embossing, and small ceremonial accents such as ribbon, petal motifs, or a subtle gold foil pattern.
- Maintain {비율} with a polished vertical reading flow suitable for mobile sharing and print.
- Add small realistic invitation details: a top label reading "INVITATION", a date badge, a small RSVP/contact line, tiny location/map and clock icons, decorative corner florals, and a modest bottom credit line.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (top 50%): place {참고 이미지} as the main visual, cleanly integrated in a centered portrait frame with a soft vignette edge, delicate shadow, and a fine warm-rose mat border. Add tiny floral sprigs or ribbon details near the frame corners to make the invitation feel physically designed.
2. Header label: above or overlapping the portrait frame, add small refined text "INVITATION" and "소중한 날, 함께해 주세요" in muted rose or gray-brown.
3. Divider treatment: add an elegant ornamental separator between portrait and text area, using a muted pastel accent with small blossom dots, thin gold-foil strokes, or a traditional knot-inspired line.
4. Event title line: render "이벤트: {이벤트}" as the primary header, visually strongest in the text block, with clear hierarchy and a formal invitation tone.
5. Host line: place "주인공: {주인공}" directly under the title, matching the formal invitation tone and keeping the name highly legible.
6. Date line: render "일자: {일자}" on its own line with consistent alignment and include a small calendar icon or date badge nearby.
7. Venue line: render "장소: {장소}" beneath the date, with a tiny map-pin icon and a secondary fixed guide text "오시는 길은 초대장 하단을 확인해 주세요" in small Korean type.
8. Greeting line: render "인사: {인사말}" as the closing message, slightly softer in weight than the header but still clearly readable.
9. Practical info area: at the bottom, add small realistic invitation text such as "RSVP 010-0000-0000", "참석 여부는 행사 3일 전까지 알려주세요", "가족과 함께 따뜻한 마음으로 준비했습니다", and a tiny footer credit "DESIGNED FOR FAMILY CELEBRATION".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Sans KR Bold for the event title and key labels, Noto Sans KR Medium for secondary lines, and Nanum Myeongjo Regular for the greeting message; title size should feel prominent at roughly 48-56px equivalent, body text around 28-34px equivalent, micro text around 15-20px equivalent.
- Color palette: soft blush #F5E6E8, pale mint #E8F5E6, warm cream #FFF8F1, muted rose #D9A7B0, soft gray-brown #6F625D, with restrained champagne-gold accents #C9A86A for foil-like dividers and tiny icons.
- Border/shadow: apply a subtle drop shadow to the portrait frame, 3px y-offset, 8px blur, 10% opacity; use fine printed-card edge shading, slight paper thickness, and delicate foil highlights on dividers or corner ornaments.
- Decorative language: include realistic Korean invitation motifs such as soft peony petals, tiny ribbon knots, hanji grain, pressed-flower silhouettes, or faint traditional pattern embossing while keeping all required text readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm f/1.8 natural-perspective portrait look, softly compressed enough for a clean invitation hero crop.
- Lighting: soft window light from the left at roughly 45°, with gentle fill from the right to keep faces evenly exposed and flattering.
- Color grade: warm cream and blush tonal grading with slightly muted saturation, similar to a refined Kinfolk-style event spread.
- Render quality: realistic printed stationery texture, crisp Korean typography, soft paper fibers, gentle shadow depth, and tactile invitation-card finish.

[6. MOOD]
Elegant family celebration invitation — Kinfolk magazine event spread aesthetic with a calm, premium Korean ceremony tone, warm handmade stationery details, and a sincere family gathering mood.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as written: "이벤트: {이벤트}", "주인공: {주인공}", "일자: {일자}", "장소: {장소}", "인사: {인사말}".
- Additional Korean text may appear as realistic invitation details, including "소중한 날, 함께해 주세요", "참석 여부는 행사 3일 전까지 알려주세요", "가족과 함께 따뜻한 마음으로 준비했습니다", and "오시는 길은 초대장 하단을 확인해 주세요".
- Ensure the main subject in {참고 이미지} matches {주인공} and is treated as the visual focal point.
- Maintain a 2:3 vertical invitation structure with centered hierarchy, crisp printed Korean text, and visually rich celebration-card details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]

- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical mobile wedding invitation for digital sharing, designed as a refined couple-photo announcement card with realistic printed-paper depth and polished Korean invitation details.
Editorial-style Korean wedding invite mockup optimized for story and messenger sharing, rich enough to feel like a finished mobile 청첩장 rather than a blank template.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {참고 이미지} occupies the upper 68-70% of the canvas as the hero, centered and visually dominant, with the couple framed close enough to feel intimate but still elegant.
- Text block placement: {신랑·신부}, {일자}, {식장}, {인사말} sit in the lower 30-32%, centered in a graceful stacked hierarchy with realistic invitation micro-details around them.
- Background treatment: soft pastel gradient backdrop on a tactile paper-like surface, using pale blush-to-cream transitions, subtle handmade paper fibers, faint pressed-flower silhouettes, and a delicate translucent vellum feel behind the lower text.
- Spacing and framing: stable {비율} portrait composition with clear separation between image and invitation information, plus fine editorial details such as a small top label, date badge, discreet decorative dividers, and tiny contact/map guide text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (top 70%): {참고 이미지} is cleanly integrated and centered, filling most of the upper frame with a subtle realistic drop shadow; keep the couple clearly visible, polished, and naturally blended into the pastel background. Add refined wedding styling around the photo such as faint floral sprigs, pearl-like highlights, soft fabric ribbon curves, and a small Korean label near the top reading "모바일 청첩장" with a tiny English caption "WEDDING INVITATION".
2. Transition band: a gentle visual divider between image and text area, using a pale cream or blush spacer zone with a thin gold hairline, soft watercolor wash, tiny flower-petal accents, and a small centered date-chip or calendar-style badge reading "SAVE THE DATE".
3. Text area (bottom 30%):
   - Name line: "{신랑·신부}" centered at the top of the text block in bold, with slightly expanded tracking for a refined invitation look; add a tiny heart or ampersand ornament between the names if it matches the supplied name format.
   - Date line: "{일자}" placed directly below in a smaller size with wider letter spacing for clear mobile readability; include a small calendar icon-style graphic nearby with Korean text "예식일".
   - Venue line: "{식장}" below the date, centered and aligned to the same text axis, with calm spacing and modest weight; add a tiny location-pin graphic and a secondary guide line such as "오시는 길 · 주차 안내" in very small Korean text.
   - Greeting line: "{인사말}" at the bottom, styled in a graceful script or hand-drawn font to add intimacy and a handwritten wedding feel.
   - Supporting details: include realistic invitation microcopy in small Korean type, such as "소중한 분들을 초대합니다", "신랑측 · 신부측 연락처", "마음 전하실 곳", and "캘린더에 저장" as subtle mobile-card buttons or labels, without overpowering the main required text.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard for main text, Bold 700 for names, Regular 400 for details, and a script/hand-drawn font for {인사말}; name size should be about 20-30% larger than the date and venue lines. Use smaller caption text for labels like "모바일 청첩장", "SAVE THE DATE", "예식일", and "오시는 길".
- Color palette: #F8EDEB light pink, #D1C4E9 lavender, #FFF3E0 light peach, plus soft cream #FFF9F4, muted gray #777777 for text contrast, and restrained champagne gold accents for dividers and tiny icon details.
- Border/shadow: subtle drop shadow on the hero image, 3px y-offset, 8px blur, 10% opacity; add delicate paper layering, translucent vellum panels, soft floral line art, and fine gold hairline dividers while keeping edges gentle and premium.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: simulated 50mm f/1.8 portrait lens look, natural perspective, gentle subject-background separation, no exaggerated distortion.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with faint fill from the right to keep faces evenly lit and flattering.
- Color grade: warm pastel editorial grade with blush, cream, lavender, and soft peach tones; lightly desaturated for a refined wedding-card finish.
- Material realism: make the invitation feel like a high-quality mobile card photographed or rendered with real paper texture, slight vellum translucency, soft shadows under decorative elements, tiny embossed floral details, and crisp typography.

[6. MOOD]
Elegant and romantic, like a Kinfolk wedding feature mixed with a modern Korean mobile 청첩장, with soft editorial warmth, subtle floral celebration, and a polished real-world invitation finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "이서준 ♥ 김민지", "2026. 06. 15. 토요일 오후 2시", "라움 웨딩홀 8층 그랜드 홀", "두 사람의 시작에 함께해주세요" must appear exactly as specified.
- Render all text from {신랑·신부}, {일자}, {식장}, {인사말} clearly in Korean with correct spacing, punctuation, and legible mobile-scale hierarchy.
- Additional Korean microcopy may appear, such as "모바일 청첩장", "소중한 분들을 초대합니다", "예식일", "오시는 길 · 주차 안내", "신랑측 · 신부측 연락처", and "캘린더에 저장".
- Ensure the couple in {참고 이미지} is consistently the same across the hero image and any subtle reflection, shadow, or decorative integration.
- Layout invariant: one main couple hero image on top and one centered wedding-information area below; enrich only with invitation labels, decorative accents, and realistic mobile-card details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean wedding D-day countdown card for couples, designed as a shareable {비율} social graphic.
Elegant announcement card with a centered couple hero image, countdown badge, wedding details, Instagram-like micro UI, date/location label, and a romantic closing caption.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered hero placement: {참고 이미지} fills the middle 68–72% of the canvas as the main focal point, with the couple clearly readable and evenly framed like a premium bridal portrait.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean golf round certification card for social sharing, designed as a premium editorial square post that summarizes score, course, partner, and round memory with realistic clubhouse details.
Instagram-style golf recap graphic with a centered evidence image, bold stat header, compact caption footer, date/location-style labels, small social UI details, and golf-scorecard inspired decoration.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered hero zone takes about 56–60% of the frame: {참고 이미지} should sit slightly above the vertical center, clearly framed as the main round evidence image and visually dominant.
- Top header band occupies about 20% of the frame and carries the course name, score, and a small round-log date badge in a readable, high-contrast layout.
- Bottom footer band occupies about 20% of the frame and holds partner info, the one-line caption, a small stats strip, and subtle Instagram-card style micro icons.
- Background should feel like a premium golf-course recap surface: muted green fairway gradient with fine grass texture, faint topographic contour lines, soft scorecard-paper overlays, and cream highlight panels.
- Keep all text inside a safe mobile-readable area while allowing realistic decorative golf details such as a tiny tee marker icon, ball-dimple texture, divider lines, and small label stickers.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 60%): {참고 이미지} should be cleanly cut out or placed inside a cream rounded photo-card frame as the main evidence image, centered with a soft realistic drop shadow on the green fairway background; if it is a golfer photo, preserve natural posture, outfit details, club/hand anatomy, and round context. Add small realistic corner photo tabs or a thin cream mat around the image, plus a tiny caption label beneath it reading "오늘의 베스트 컷".
2. Header block (top 20%): Place the course label text "CC {CC 이름}" as the primary line, with the score detail text "스코어 {스코어}" directly beneath it. Add a small pill badge near the header such as "ROUND LOG · 18H" and a date label "2026.05 라운딩 기록"; keep strong hierarchy, consistent baseline alignment, and no overlap with the hero subject.
3. Footer block (bottom 20%): Place "파트너 {파트너}" as the first footer line and "{한 줄}" as the second line; use smaller text than the header but keep it mobile-legible and evenly spaced. Add a compact stats row with Korean micro text such as "티오프 07:32", "날씨 맑음", "그린 빠름", and "기분 최고" separated by thin cream dividers.
4. Social recap details: Add tiny Instagram-style save/share/heart/comment micro icons near the lower-right, a small handle line like "@golf_round_log", and hashtags-like text such as "#오늘의라운드 #골프기록 #라베도전" in a subtle but readable size.
5. Framing and spacing: Use balanced left-right alignment, let the hero remain larger than the text blocks, and ensure no element touches the canvas edge; decorative elements should support the golf recap theme without covering the score, course name, partner name, or caption.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Noto Sans KR for all text; header in Bold 700–800 at roughly 44–56px, score line in Bold 700 at roughly 38–48px, footer in Regular/Medium 400–500 at roughly 26–34px, and micro labels at roughly 16–22px with tight but readable line spacing and clean numeric rendering.
- Color palette: #4CAF50, #2E7D32, #FFFFFF, #111111, and soft cream #F7F3E8 for subtle contrast, scorecard panels, label stickers, dividers, and highlight accents.
- Border/shadow: Soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use refined cream photo-card edges, thin divider rules, and small rounded badges to create an authentic sports-editorial card while preserving text legibility.
- Texture and decoration: Include fine fairway grain, faint scorecard grid lines, delicate golf-ball dimple pattern in the background, tiny tee/flag pictograms, and realistic paper layering that feels printed rather than sterile.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens look for the hero cutout, with shallow depth-of-field separation and crisp subject edges.
- Lighting: Soft window light from upper-left at 45° with a faint fill from lower-right, creating gentle dimensionality, natural shadows under the photo card, and no glare on score text.
- Color grade: Warm green and cream tones with slight natural contrast, similar to a polished lifestyle sports editorial print and a luxury country-club Instagram recap.
- Material feel: matte coated paper, soft clubhouse scorecard texture, subtle embossed-looking badges, and realistic shadow layering between header, hero photo, and footer panels.

[6. MOOD]
Premium golf magazine editorial — Golf Digest spread aesthetic mixed with a realistic country-club social post, celebrating the round like a stylish personal score archive with believable on-course details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "CC {CC 이름}", "스코어 {스코어}", "파트너 {파트너}", "{한 줄}".
- Additional Korean micro text must be clean and readable: "오늘의 베스트 컷", "ROUND LOG · 18H", "2026.05 라운딩 기록", "티오프 07:32", "날씨 맑음", "그린 빠름", "기분 최고", "#오늘의라운드 #골프기록 #라베도전".
- Maintain square aspect ratio as specified by {비율}.
- If the reference includes a golfer, hands, golf club, ball, or scorecard, keep anatomy natural, proportions correct, fingers properly formed, and equipment geometry believable.
- Keep the score numbers crisp, evenly spaced, high-contrast, and fully readable on mobile.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean diary decoration concept image, designed as a square editorial comparison sheet for planning, inspiration, and social-media sharing.
Create a 4-cut scrapbook-style grid that shows one diary spread transformed into four distinct decoration directions, with realistic Korean planner labels, small social-card metadata, and desk-craft details that make it feel like an actual stationery creator’s sample page.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the main diary spread occupies about 80% of the frame, centered slightly upward, with the lower area used for realistic craft-table items, small caption strips, and social sharing UI-style micro icons.
- Layout structure: {레이아웃} with evenly sized quadrants, narrow gutters, and an editorial catalog-preview feel that makes each decoration option easy to compare.
- Header area: add a slim scrapbook header band across the top with the title {상단 타이틀}, issue/date text {호수 날짜}, creator handle {계정명}, and a tiny page indicator "01/04" printed like a stationery template.
- Background treatment: warm cream #FFF8EF craft-table backdrop with visible paper grain, faint cutting-mat impressions, light pencil marks, tape shadows, and subtle signs of handmade work.
- Spacing and framing: each quadrant sits like a separate printed sample card with rounded corners, paper tabs, transparent tape corners, small handwritten arrows, and tiny color-chip swatches.
- Style differentiation: each quadrant must clearly separate the four looks from {스타일 4종} while preserving the same diary page base and the same viewing angle.
- Desk-story details: include {책상 소품} around the grid, such as sticker backing sheets, washi tape rolls, paper clips, date-stamp ink pad, glue stick cap, small ruler, and a half-used memo pad.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left panel (25%): {참고 이미지} reworked in the first style from {스타일 4종}, using small clean sticker icons, neat weekday labels, pastel dot markers, tiny weather icons, and carefully placed memo boxes for a calm planner-page look.
2. Top-right panel (25%): {참고 이미지} reworked in the second style from {스타일 4종}, with layered paper scraps, torn edges, old receipt fragments, warm sepia accents, postage-stamp shapes, ticket stubs, and nostalgic collage rhythm.
3. Bottom-left panel (25%): {참고 이미지} reworked in the third style from {스타일 4종}, featuring colorful masking tape strips across corners, angled tape accents, tab labels, taped photo placeholders, and an energetic handmade composition.
4. Bottom-right panel (25%): {참고 이미지} reworked in the fourth style from {스타일 4종}, showing hand-drawn doodles, marker accents, small speech bubbles, smile icons, tiny floral sketches, and playful illustrated details that feel personally sketched on the page.
5. Shared continuity across all 4 panels: keep diary page proportions consistent, preserve the same page orientation, and make decoration style the major variable while allowing realistic page notes, stickers, tabs, and diary markings to differ by style.
6. Desk props integration: {책상 소품} may sit along the craft-table area or lightly overlap the sample-card edges, while the diary’s main writing area remains readable and recognizable.
7. Social/editorial footer: add a bottom caption strip with {하단 캡션}, {해시태그}, save/share/heart micro icons, and a tiny location tag {위치 라벨} as if this is a saved Instagram carousel cover for diary inspiration.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR, medium to semibold weight, 14–18pt for visible panel labels or annotations, with crisp digital clarity and clean spacing.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} anchored by soft pink #F7D9E0, powder blue #D9E8F5, sage green #DDE9D6, butter yellow #F7E9B5, warm cream #FFF8EF, kraft beige #D8C4A8, muted brown #8B6F5A, and soft ink gray #4E4A45.
- Panel treatment: each panel gets a subtle soft drop shadow with 5px y-offset, 10px blur, and 20% opacity; use thin off-white dividers between quadrants plus taped corners and paper-label tabs.
- Surface details: faint paper grain, adhesive tape texture, sticker gloss, matte scrapbook paper layers, slightly raised sticker edges, pencil pressure marks, ink-stamp softness, and tiny glue wrinkles for a tactile craft feel.
- Label system: each quadrant has a small Korean style label tab, one tiny color-chip row, and a short handwritten-style note that describes the decoration mood.
- Realistic diary details: add dates, short to-do snippets, small meal/weather icons, mood trackers, star ratings, and little checkboxes, all rendered as Korean stationery text rather than placeholder gibberish.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat lay captured with a 50mm lens at f/5.6, crisp edge detail, even field sharpness, and no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft daylight from the top-left corner, diffused through a sheer curtain, with gentle fill from the lower-right so all four panels remain evenly legible.
- Color grade: warm cream base with pastel highlights, slight vintage sepia in the collage panel, soft paper whites, natural shadow falloff under props, and gentle contrast that preserves sticker and tape texture.

[6. MOOD]
Lifestyle magazine craft-spread feel — like a Korean stationery creator’s diary-deco sample book mixed with a calm DIY editorial page, friendly, tactile, collectible, and share-worthy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: any visible Korean label must render perfectly with no broken characters.
- Korean text to appear verbatim: "다꾸 스타일 샘플북", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "@paper_daylog", "01/04", "미니멀 스티커", "빈티지 콜라주", "마스킹테이프", "일러스트 손그림".
- Additional Korean text to appear verbatim: "오늘의 기록", "주간 계획", "작은 순간 모으기", "저장하고 따라 해보기", "#다이어리꾸미기", "#다꾸시안", "서울 작업실".
- Layout invariant: the composition must read clearly as a 2x2 comparison grid, and each panel must show one distinct decoration style from {스타일 4종}.
- Structural consistency: all 4 sections must use the same diary page base and the same overall top-down framing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean pet adoption and training graduation commemorative card in a square social-post layout.
Designed as a shareable family memory card with a cute celebration feel, optimized for mobile viewing, like a realistic photographed keepsake from a pet adoption center graduation day.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the pet occupies the centered hero area and fills about 70% of the frame, with the face, eyes, fur texture, and graduation item clearly readable.
- Background treatment: soft cream-to-blue-pink pastel gradient blended with a realistic indoor celebration photo-booth setting: faint fabric backdrop texture, warm bokeh fairy lights, small paw-print garland shapes, and gentle paper confetti accents around the edges.
- Spacing and framing: keep a balanced square card composition based on {비율}, arranging the title, decorative date/location tags, pet portrait, and footer caption so the main pet remains the emotional focus.
- Text integration: place short text blocks above and below the hero, using layered sticker-like labels and rounded caption bars that feel like a real social commemorative card; keep all key Korean text legible and naturally integrated.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 70%): {참고 이미지} is featured as the main subject, joyful and centered, holding a bone-shaped graduation certificate in its mouth with the full shape visible; keep the pet’s body slightly lower than center so the face sits in the upper-middle focal zone. Add realistic details such as a tiny graduation cap, soft ribbon or bandana, polished fur highlights, natural nose shine, and a gentle contact shadow on a warm beige floor or low platform.
2. Header area (top 10%): show "{이름}, {나이}" in bold, large, and highly legible Korean type, centered with strong contrast against the pastel background. Add a small rounded label above or beside it reading "입양 축하 GRADUATION DAY" and a tiny date stamp such as "2026.05" in muted charcoal.
3. Moment label (lower-mid strip): place "{순간}" as a playful caption, slightly smaller than the header, centered inside a soft pastel sticker strip or ribbon label. Add small decorative tags nearby, such as "우리 가족 된 날", "훈련 졸업", and "GOOD DOG!" in tiny readable lettering.
4. Footer area (bottom 10%): render "{한 줄}" in an elegant handwritten style, centered and separated from the edge by comfortable margins. Add a subtle location/caption line beneath or beside it in small Korean text, such as "서울 반려동물 입양센터 · 가족 기념사진" and a tiny handle-style mark "@happy_paws_family".
5. Realistic keepsake details: include a small paw-sticker, heart sticker, light confetti pieces, soft tape corners, a tiny camera-date label, and a simple decorative frame line in warm beige so the card feels printed, photographed, and ready to share on social media.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the header, Nanum Myeongjo Regular for the moment label, and a hand-drawn script style for the footer; use mobile-readable sizes with the header strongest, the label medium, and the footer most delicate.
- Color palette: soft cream #FFF6E8, gentle blue #CFE8FF, pastel pink #F7D7E8, warm beige #E8D8C6, and muted charcoal #3A3A3A for text.
- Border/shadow: subtle inner shadow with 3px depth and 20% opacity; add a soft realistic shadow under the pet and behind paper-sticker elements so the card has gentle depth.
- Decorative elements: use pastel paw prints, tiny hearts, confetti, rounded stickers, tape-corner accents, and soft bokeh lights in a tasteful family-album style, matching the cream, blue, pink, and beige palette.
- Texture: include slight paper grain, soft fabric backdrop texture, and realistic fur detail while keeping the card polished and premium.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with a 50mm f/1.8 portrait look, shallow depth of field, crisp subject edges with soft background falloff.
- Lighting: soft window light from the upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from the front-right to keep the pet’s features bright and readable; add warm catchlights in the eyes and soft highlights on the certificate.
- Color grade: warm cream base with pastel pink and pastel blue accents, low contrast, lightly airy family-album finish.
- Rendering quality: realistic pet portrait photography blended with editorial greeting-card design, natural fur strands, believable shadows, clean Korean typography, and tactile printed-card details.

[6. MOOD]
Heartwarming pet graduation keepsake — like a polished family photo album page from an adoption celebration, with cute editorial greeting-card energy, warm household affection, and a joyful “new family member” milestone feeling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{이름}, {나이}", "{순간}", and "{한 줄}" must appear exactly as written.
- Additional Korean text may include short readable details such as "입양 축하 GRADUATION DAY", "우리 가족 된 날", "훈련 졸업", "서울 반려동물 입양센터", and "2026.05".
- Pet’s expression must stay natural, joyful, and non-cartoonish.
- The bone-shaped graduation certificate must be clearly visible and not distorted.
- Maintain the square 1024x1024 social-post card format and the soft cream, pastel blue, pastel pink, warm beige, and muted charcoal palette.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a square social-media-shareable before/after renovation comparison card with a realistic home editorial layout.
Show a {공간} interior makeover reveal with immediate contrast between pre-renovation and post-renovation states, like a printed home magazine comparison spread adapted for an Instagram carousel cover.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Split the square canvas into two equal vertical photo panels, each taking exactly 50% width, with a slim center divider for instant comparison.
- Keep the {공간} recognizable in both panels with a matched camera angle and crop height; preserve real room details such as flooring, window direction, ceiling line, door frame, built-in storage, furniture placement, cables, fabric texture, wall finish, and lived-in scale cues.
- Use a warm off-white editorial canvas behind the layout, allowing magazine-like labels, small captions, icons, and project metadata to make the card feel published and real.
- Place the header across the full top width with a magazine-cover style title lockup; include a small series label, issue/date text, and a tiny account handle near the header.
- Reserve a structured footer band at the bottom for compact renovation details, including {공간}, {컨셉}, {예산}, {비율}, date/location label, hashtags-like text, and tiny save/share micro icons.
- Use {한 줄} as the main title, and keep {공간}, {컨셉}, and {예산} as the main supporting information.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 14%): Set {한 줄} centered in a bold masthead style with strong visual hierarchy. Add small Korean editorial text above and beside it: "신혼집 리모델링 기록", "VOL.1176", "2026.05", and "@our_newhome". Include a small page indicator "01 / 05" on the upper right as if this is the first slide of a carousel.
2. Left panel — before state (middle left 43%): Place the before image from {참고 이미지} within the left half, showing the original {공간} layout with unchanged perspective and no distortion. Add a small rounded label at the upper-left of the photo reading "BEFORE" and a short Korean caption near the lower edge: "공사 전 분위기". Let realistic pre-renovation details remain visible, such as older finishes, mismatched furniture, exposed storage, worn flooring, dated lighting, or practical household items.
3. Right panel — after state (middle right 43%): Place the after image from {참고 이미지} in the right half, matched to the left panel in framing, height, and camera angle for direct side-by-side comparison. Add a small rounded label at the upper-left of the photo reading "AFTER" and a short Korean caption near the lower edge: "완성 후 첫 기록". Show richer finished styling appropriate to {컨셉}, such as coordinated furniture, rug, curtains, lighting fixture, wall art, plants, cushions, books, trays, ceramics, and natural textile textures.
4. Center divider (middle 2%): Add a thin vertical separator in soft gray #D3D3D3 with a small circular arrow badge at the center reading "전 → 후" so the transformation reads immediately.
5. Footer area (bottom 13%): Display a compact project information strip with icons and dividers: "공간  {공간}" / "컨셉  {컨셉}" / "예산  {예산}" / "비율  {비율}". Add a second micro line: "서울 신혼집 · 2026.05 기록 · #신혼집인테리어 #전후비교 #집꾸미기". Place tiny outline save/share/comment icons on the right and a small CTA text "저장하고 참고하기".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the header at 24–28pt equivalent, Pretendard SemiBold for BEFORE/AFTER badges at 10–12pt equivalent, Noto Sans KR Regular for footer details and captions at 11–15pt equivalent, with tight tracking and clean Korean readability.
- Color palette: #FFFFFF, #F7F3EE, #F3F4F6, #D3D3D3, #111111, warm beige #D8C7B2, muted brown #8A6F5A, plus muted neutral tones sampled from the room photos; keep contrast crisp while allowing natural home textures and realistic material color variation.
- Border/shadow: Use subtle soft drop shadows with 5px y-offset, 10px blur, and 20% opacity around each photo panel; use thin editorial rules, rounded micro-labels, and small icon details to create a realistic designed social card.
- Photo treatment: Maintain believable lens geometry, real shadows, true material textures, and natural imperfections; the before side may look slightly cooler and flatter, while the after side may feel warmer, brighter, and more styled.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Natural interior photography look with a full-frame 50mm lens at f/5.6, straight-on perspective, and matched framing across both panels.
- Lighting: Even diffused daylight from a window source, softly filling the room with balanced exposure in both before and after images; allow realistic localized shadows under furniture, curtain folds, lamp shades, shelving, and objects.
- Color grade: Neutral editorial grade with clean whites, soft grays, accurate room colors, gentle warm highlights on the after side, and slightly reduced saturation for a realistic renovation comparison.

[6. MOOD]
Modern interior renovation feature — like a home decor magazine before/after spread turned into an Instagram carousel cover, warm and aspirational but still realistic, with enough captions, labels, icons, and room details to feel like an actual published 신혼집 인테리어 case study.

- The before and after images must show the same {공간} from the same approximate angle so the transformation is instantly recognizable.
- Both panels must stay visually balanced with equal width and aligned top and bottom edges.
- All visible Korean must be legible, correctly spaced, and not garbled; use the provided {한 줄}, {공간}, {컨셉}, {예산}, and {비율} values exactly where they appear.

Vertical social-media-ready commemorative image that captures an intimate gift exchange with clear emotional storytelling, realistic location detail, and small anniversary keepsake graphics.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The couple is the hero subject, placed slightly above center and occupying about 50% of the frame height, with both faces, upper bodies, and hands fully readable.

[4. STYLE RULES]

[1. PURPOSE]

Transform a customer review screenshot into a believable, ad-ready local café marketing card with a real campaign feel: review proof, café identity, rating emphasis, short CTA, handle, date label, and small social-media details that make the layout feel published rather than like a blank mockup.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Square canvas composition: build a 1:1 social ad card where the main review screenshot occupies the center 62–68% of the frame, supported by a branded header, café trust strip, short testimonial quote, and compact CTA footer.
- Header placement: {헤드라인} sits in the top band as the main bold Korean hook, with a small campaign label above it such as "오늘의 후기", "REAL REVIEW", or "고객 추천 카드" and a tiny date tag like "2026.05".
- Main focal block: {참고 이미지} is presented as a polished screenshot card with crisp crop edges, lightly rounded corners, a subtle drop shadow, and realistic review-capture details around or inside the card: small avatar circle, masked nickname such as "손님_24", date "방문 2026.05.01", star icons, short gray body-text lines, and a small "사진 리뷰" tag.
- Trust row and quote: {상호} and {리뷰 점수} appear directly under the screenshot, followed by {리뷰 한 줄} in the lower band as the main quoted testimonial line, with a warm gold star accent and a quotation-mark graphic.
- Advertising details: add a compact café promo footer with short Korean microcopy such as "저장하고 다음 방문에 확인해보세요", "오늘도 따뜻하게 준비했어요", "신메뉴 · 원두 · 디저트", plus tiny save/share/comment-like micro icons and a handle-style label such as "@cafe.review".
- Background treatment: use a premium warm-white paper or café receipt-inspired surface (#FFFFFF / #F5F5F5) with subtle paper grain, faint receipt grid lines, pale gold accent shapes, small coffee-bean or cup-line icons, and tasteful sticker-like tags that support the café testimonial theme.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 14%): Place a small label "REAL REVIEW" or "오늘의 후기" at the top, then set {헤드라인} centered in bold Korean type with strong contrast. Include a tiny issue/date-style mark such as "REVIEW CARD 05" or "2026년 5월" near the header corner.
2. Main image area (middle 60–64%): Place {참고 이미지} as the dominant cropped review screenshot block, scaled large enough to read clearly. Add a believable generic review-card frame with avatar dot, nickname, star row, timestamp, and gray review-body snippets without copying an exact real platform interface.
3. Trust cue row (lower-middle 9%): Set {상호} and {리뷰 점수} centered beneath the screenshot; emphasize {리뷰 점수} with warm gold stars, a small rounded badge, or a highlighted pill so the row reads as a confidence cue at a glance.
4. Review quote area (bottom 8–10%): Place {리뷰 한 줄} as a quoted line in Korean, slightly smaller than the headline but clearly readable, accompanied by a small quotation icon or soft underline accent.
5. CTA and social detail area (bottom edge 4–6%): Add tiny realistic social-card elements such as "@cafe.review", "저장", "공유", "문의 DM", a bookmark icon, a small page marker "AD 01", or a short line "방문 전 메뉴 확인하기".
6. Decorative hierarchy: Use warm gold separators, small rounded stickers reading "찐후기", "재방문", or "추천", and faint receipt-style dividers to create a richer café advertisement while keeping the review screenshot as the main focal element.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for {헤드라인}, Pretendard SemiBold for {상호} and {리뷰 점수}, Pretendard Regular for {리뷰 한 줄}; header about 42–52px equivalent, body about 24–30px equivalent, micro labels about 12–16px equivalent, with clean Korean kerning.
- Color palette: #111111 for primary text, #FFFFFF for background, #F5F5F5 for subtle surface blocks, #FFD36A and #D8A93A for the review accent, with optional #FF6B6B only for a tiny highlight if needed.
- Border/shadow: screenshot card shadow with 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 18px blur, 12% opacity; corners lightly rounded to soften the layout without making it playful.
- Graphic accents: Use small gold star icons, pale beige receipt lines, soft cream sticker shapes, tiny gray UI icons, and one or two warm coral highlights to make the card feel like a finished social media advertisement.
- Text realism: Add short Korean supporting text that fits a café ad, for example "오늘의 고객 후기", "재방문 의사 100%", "따뜻한 커피와 디저트", "저장 후 방문해보세요", while keeping all required placeholder text exact.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: digital UI card composition, no photographic camera effect; present the screenshot as a crisp screen-capture block rather than a physical photo, with pixel-clean edges and print-safe scaling.
- Lighting: flat, even studio-style presentation light with no glare, no harsh reflections, and no screen bloom.
- Color grade: neutral clean editorial tone, white-dominant with restrained warm accents for trust and readability.
- Rendering quality: high-resolution social ad graphic with sharp vector-like typography, realistic UI spacing, subtle paper texture, polished shadows, and believable café-brand design details.

[6. MOOD]
Trustworthy local-business testimonial card — like a modern Korean café Instagram advertisement that combines real customer proof, warm café branding, and polished lifestyle-magazine advertorial design.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{상호}", "{리뷰 점수}", "{리뷰 한 줄}", "{헤드라인}" must appear exactly as written.
- Layout invariant: preserve the square 1:1 composition indicated by {비율}, with the review screenshot remaining the dominant focal element.
- The review capture should feel generic and believable, with invented Korean microcopy such as "방문 후기", "사진 리뷰", "손님_24", and "2026.05.01" allowed as supporting detail.
- Required rendered additions should be in Korean where visible: include at least one small label like "오늘의 후기", one CTA like "저장하고 방문해보세요", and one handle-style text like "@cafe.review".

- Broken Korean characters

Create a realistic, content-rich portrait digital document card that feels like a polished Korean corporate onboarding / fintech document preview, while remaining clearly a shareable business-info card rather than an official government certificate reproduction.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the certificate-style content block occupies the central portrait canvas, with a prominent title area at the top, a realistic document-preview panel beneath it, and clearly organized business information rows stacked in the lower half.
- Background treatment: use a refined off-white to pale cool-gray workspace background with subtle paper grain, faint UI-card texture, soft ambient shadow, and a few understated digital-document details such as attachment labels, page markers, and thin divider rules.
- Spacing, framing direction: keep the portrait reading flow implied by {비율}, with a centered vertical document card, realistic margins, and enough surrounding context to feel like a mobile-ready shared document preview.
- Use {참고 이미지} as the factual reference for the document content, then rebuild it as a crisp digital card with clean alignment, realistic layered paper depth, and high readability.
- Add small supporting text elements around the main block, such as “공유용 사본”, “전자문서 미리보기”, “생성일 2026.05.01”, “DOC-2026-05-001”, and “페이지 1/1” to make the card feel complete and used in a real workflow.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): place the title "사업자등록증" centered in bold black text, with compact letter spacing and a strong document-heading scale. Add a small upper label above or beside it reading "전자문서 미리보기" and a subtle status chip reading "공유용 사본".
2. Main certificate block (upper-mid 26%): frame the reference content from {참고 이미지} as a front-facing document preview panel with slight paper depth, crisp edges, soft shadow, and realistic scanned-document feel. Include a thin top metadata bar with short Korean labels such as "문서번호 DOC-2026-05-001", "발급정보 확인용", and "페이지 1/1". The block should look structured and credible, not empty.
3. Information area (mid-lower 38%): stack the fields in a single-column list inside the centered block, using left-aligned labels and values for quick scanning. Use subtle gray dividers, small label captions, and consistent row spacing.
   - Line 1: "상호: {상호}" in regular black text.
   - Line 2: "대표자: {대표자}" in regular black text.
   - Line 3: "등록번호: {등록번호}" in regular black text.
   - Line 4: "주소: {주소}" in regular black text.
   - Line 5: "업태·종목: {업태·종목}" in regular black text.
   - Add a small side note within the card: "제출처 확인용 · 원본 대조 필요" in light gray, clearly secondary and not official-looking.
4. Footer area (bottom 18%): include realistic digital-card footer details: a small file attachment strip reading "business_certificate.pdf", a date label "생성일 2026.05.01", a compact verification-code style text line "문서 관리번호: BC-2026-0501-KR", and tiny interface micro-icons for share / save / print preview. Add tasteful certificate-style line ornaments or corner rules that do not resemble official seals.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Noto Sans KR for all text; header bold 58px equivalent, body regular 30px equivalent, metadata 18–22px equivalent, with sharp anti-aliased rendering and consistent baseline alignment.
- Color palette: pure white #FFFFFF for the main card, black #000000 text, deep charcoal #111827 for headings, cool gray #E5E7EB and #9CA3AF for dividers and metadata, pale blue-gray #F3F6FA for the outer background, and a restrained navy accent #1E3A8A for small chips or labels.
- Border/shadow: layered digital document card with a fine 1px cool-gray border, subtle inner dividers, and a soft drop shadow under the main content block, 0px x-offset, 8px y-offset, 24px blur, 12% opacity.
- Add realistic document UI details: thin ruled lines, small attachment tag, light metadata chips, page indicator, and gentle paper texture while keeping the business information visually dominant.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: straight-on flat document capture look, equivalent to a 50mm normal lens at f/8 with zero distortion.
- Lighting: even diffused overhead studio light with soft natural shadow around the raised card edges, optimized for document readability and clean edges.
- Color grade: neutral cool-white document grade with true blacks, crisp whites, soft gray UI depth, and a professional Korean fintech-document presentation.
- Rendering detail: high-resolution realistic digital print texture, crisp Korean typography, subtle paper fiber, gentle shadow falloff, and clean vector-like dividers.

[6. MOOD]
Professional Korean business-document digital card — a credible, polished, mobile-friendly certificate preview inside a corporate onboarding, accounting, or fintech document-sharing interface.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "사업자등록증", "상호", "대표자", "등록번호", "주소", "업태·종목" must appear exactly as written.
- The information fields must remain fully legible, consistently aligned, and clearly separated by dividers and spacing that preserves document readability.
- Include realistic Korean microcopy such as "전자문서 미리보기", "공유용 사본", "생성일 2026.05.01", "문서번호 DOC-2026-05-001", "페이지 1/1", and "business_certificate.pdf" where appropriate.
- Keep the layout portrait-oriented and document-like, with the added UI details supporting the form structure rather than overwhelming it.
- Every field label must be rendered in correct Korean with no broken characters, spacing errors, or line-wrap corruption.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean business card mock-up for portfolio presentation, rendered as a realistic product-photography scene.
Square stationery showcase with front-and-back card views, suitable for SNS portfolio thumbnails, design case studies, and premium brand identity presentation.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: The front business card takes about 60% of the frame in the center-left area, rotated 20–30° clockwise, while the back card sits slightly behind it on the right with a different angle to create a layered multi-angle presentation.
- Background treatment: Warm neutral desktop surface with subtle matte paper grain or fine wood texture, cream-beige tone, natural desk styling, and realistic surface imperfections such as faint paper fibers, small dust specks, and soft reflections.
- Spacing and framing: Arrange the cards and desk items so {명함 정보} remains readable; let the props frame the stationery scene like a real brand studio desk photograph.
- Use {참고 이미지} as the exact source for the card artwork, and apply the card content according to {명함 정보}.
- Follow {레이아웃} precisely so the mock-up reads like a real stationery catalog photograph.
- Place {소품} as lifestyle context around the cards, with natural scale, contact shadows, and believable desk placement.
- Add realistic printed details: {브랜드명}, {이름}, {직책}, {전화번호}, {이메일}, {SNS}, {주소}, {슬로건}, and a small {QR문구} label on the back side.
- Apply {비율} as a strict square composition with balanced left-right visual weight.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main card hero area: Show {참고 이미지} as the front-facing card, sharply printed on matte premium stock, placed diagonally as the primary anchor with crisp cut edges, visible paper thickness, subtle ink absorption, and a gentle bevel along the card edge.
2. Secondary card layer: Place a second business card slightly behind and to the right, flipped to show the back side, with a small offset that reveals both edge lines, soft stack depth, and consistent brand color treatment.
3. Printed information layer: Front card includes {브랜드명}, {이름}, {직책}, {전화번호}, {이메일}, and {SNS}; back card includes the logo mark, {슬로건}, {주소}, and a small QR-code style block with the caption {QR문구}.
4. Desk context layer: Position {소품} near the bottom-left and upper-right areas for lifestyle context; the coffee cup can show a subtle rim highlight, the pen can reflect the window light, the leather notebook can reveal stitching, and the plant can add a small organic shadow.
5. Depth and realism layer: Add soft contact shadows beneath each card, slight perspective variation between the two cards, realistic desk-contact response, shallow depth-of-field toward the far props, and a photographed paper-product feel rather than a flat layout.
6. Readability layer: Keep all card text fully legible with consistent alignment, balanced margins around {명함 정보}, and front/back details that feel like one coordinated Korean business card system.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard for all mock-up typography, medium to semibold weight, with 11–18px on-card equivalent size; keep kerning refined, line spacing generous, and hierarchy clear between brand, name, role, and contact details.
- Color palette: Cream #F6F1E8, warm beige #D9C7B2, soft taupe #A58E7A, espresso brown #5A4638, muted gray #8B8B8B, with a restrained accent from the reference artwork.
- Print finish: {용지질감} with subtle tactile fibers, lightly absorbed ink edges, realistic CMYK print density, and premium stationery stock thickness around 350gsm.
- Border/shadow: Soft drop shadow with 3px y-offset, 8px blur, 10% opacity; card edges should show a slight paper bevel with natural separation from the desk surface.
- Micro details: Add tiny print-realistic elements such as a small QR block, line dividers, contact icons, and a back-side logo repeat when consistent with {참고 이미지}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered mobile composition: design a full 1024x1536 vertical Kakao-style channel welcome screen with all major content aligned for phone viewing in {비율}.
- Top app header zone: include a realistic mobile status bar, a Kakao Channel-style header row, {브랜드 이름} as the main channel name, and small UI icons such as search, share, notification, or close controls.
- Greeting block: place {환영 메시지} directly under the brand name as friendly onboarding copy, supported by a small channel handle line, follower greeting label, or short badge-like tag.
- Main hero area: {참고 이미지} occupies the middle 42-48% of the frame as a crisp brand emblem, product cutout, mascot, or photo-card centerpiece, with dimensional layering and a soft contact shadow.
- Information cards: add realistic Kakao Channel content modules around the hero, such as a welcome coupon card, operating-hours strip, tiny notice banner, channel update preview, or featured menu shortcut, using Korean microcopy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18-20%): Add a realistic phone status bar with time 10:24, signal/Wi-Fi/battery indicators, then a channel header row labeled 채널. Place {브랜드 이름} in large bold type below it, centered, with a small verified-looking but unofficial decorative dot or channel tag reading 친구 환영.
2. Greeting area (upper-mid 14-16%): Set {환영 메시지} as two lines when provided, with warm line spacing. Add a small subcaption such as 새 친구님을 위한 첫 안내, @noeulcafe, or 오늘의 소식 도착 to make it feel like an actual channel welcome module.
3. Main hero area (mid 42-48%): Render {참고 이미지} as a crisp centered cutout or emblem layered on a rounded card, speech-bubble frame, or floating circular backdrop. Add small realistic details such as a yellow chat bubble icon, tiny heart sticker, sparkle accent, or product label tag without covering the hero.
4. Channel detail modules (around hero and lower-mid): Include 2-3 small rounded cards: one coupon card reading 채널 추가 환영 쿠폰 / 첫 주문 10% 할인, one notice strip reading 오늘의 메뉴 업데이트, and one info line reading 운영시간 09:00-21:00. Keep these elements secondary to the main hero and greeting.
5. CTA area (bottom 20-22%): Lay out {CTA} as three readable buttons with equal visual balance, rounded corners, clear icons, and tactile depth. If {CTA} contains slash-separated labels, split them into three buttons while preserving each label exactly.
6. Footer strip (lowest edge): Add a tiny footer line with store/contact-style details such as 서울 마포구 노을로 24 · 02-1234-5678, plus small share/save micro-icons to increase realism.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for {브랜드 이름} at headline scale, Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium for {환영 메시지}, Pretendard Medium for {CTA}; use realistic Kakao-style UI hierarchy with smaller metadata labels, coupon captions, and footer text.
- Color palette: Kakao yellow #FEE500, white #FFFFFF, deep charcoal #1F1F1F, warm gray #F6F3EA, plus one brand accent from {컬러 팔레트}; maintain strong contrast for Korean text and buttons.
- UI surface styling: rounded cards, soft panel shadows, 1px translucent dividers, glossy app-like highlight strips, small icon circles, and speech-bubble motifs that feel native to a Kakao Channel welcome screen.
- Button styling: tap-friendly pill buttons with consistent padding, centered text, subtle icon marks, faint 1px outline, and soft drop shadow of 2px y-offset, 6px blur, 18% opacity.
- Hero styling: {참고 이미지} should feel integrated into the interface with a 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 15% opacity shadow, a warm reflection or glow, and a rounded backdrop that uses {컬러 팔레트}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: not applicable for a graphic mobile screen design; if {참고 이미지} is photographic, present it as a polished centered cutout or embedded product/photo card with natural scale and crisp edges.
- Lighting: bright digital product-presentation lighting with soft UI shadows, gentle highlights on cards and buttons, and a warm Kakao-style glow behind the central hero.
- Color grade: Kakao brand-forward palette with saturated yellow accents, creamy off-white panels, deep charcoal text, and subtle brand-accent details from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Rendering detail: emulate a high-resolution mobile app screenshot with realistic status bar, icon spacing, button depth, coupon card texture, tiny labels, and legible Korean UI text.

[6. MOOD]
Friendly, lively, and trustworthy Kakao Channel welcome screen, like a real brand onboarding page that greets a new channel friend with useful shortcuts, a small coupon, and warm store personality.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 안녕하세요 노을 카페예요 ☕, 오늘도 따뜻한 한 잔 함께해요, 오늘의 메뉴 보기 / 매장 위치 / 주문하기, 노을카페.
- Add realistic Korean microcopy where appropriate: 채널 추가 환영 쿠폰, 첫 주문 10% 할인, 오늘의 메뉴 업데이트, 운영시간 09:00-21:00, 새 친구님을 위한 첫 안내, @noeulcafe, 서울 마포구 노을로 24.

- Keep {브랜드 이름}, {환영 메시지}, and all {CTA} labels fully legible and visually dominant over secondary microcopy.

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a square blog thumbnail variation sheet that presents 8 distinct thumbnail concepts derived from one source photo for a post titled "{블로그 주제}".
Design it like a polished editorial style guide for blog/social preview use: one subject, eight visual directions, readable at thumbnail scale, with realistic Korean blog-cover details such as dates, handle labels, hashtags, captions, issue-style marks, and small interface-inspired icons.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall composition: a strict {레이아웃} of 8 equal square panels, separated by narrow consistent gutters, with the entire sheet centered in the 1024x1024 canvas.
- Subject placement: keep the main subject from {참고 이미지} recognizable in every panel; use centered, slightly off-center, close-up crop, sticker cutout, or layered photo placement depending on the style, while keeping the subject identity clear.
- Background treatment: each panel must use a different treatment from {컬러 톤}, including cream editorial paper, magazine black-white contrast, sepia travel print, saturated color blocks, documentary grayscale, illustrated pastel surface, instant-photo paper, and tactile paper collage.
- Framing direction: each panel should follow {비율} square-crop logic with strong thumbnail readability; important facial/body details from the source image should not be cut in a confusing way.
- Realistic overlay system: include compact Korean blog metadata in selected panels, such as "{블로그명}", "{작성자핸들}", "{날짜}", "{장소}", "{대표해시태그}", and "{CTA문구}"; make the text feel intentionally designed rather than randomly scattered.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Thumbnail 1 (top-left): Clean editorial layout — place {참고 이미지} centered on a warm cream or light gray field with a small top label "{블로그명}", the exact title "{블로그 주제}", a date chip "{날짜}", and tiny decorative divider dots or travel-stamp marks.
2. Thumbnail 2 (top-second): Magazine cover layout — place {참고 이미지} slightly off-center with strong editorial contrast; add "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", a small barcode block, spine credit "PHOTO BY {작성자핸들}", and 2–3 Korean feature headlines such as "골목 카페 지도", "디저트 BEST 12", "현지 감성 루트" around the main title.
3. Thumbnail 3 (top-third): Vintage travel layout — render {참고 이미지} with sepia warmth, subtle film grain, faded highlights, ticket-stub graphics, a small caption "{장소} 기록", and a handwritten-style label "{날짜}".
4. Thumbnail 4 (top-right): Color pop layout — surround {참고 이미지} with vivid coral/cobalt accent blocks, sticker bursts, arrow shapes, and an energetic view-bait label such as "이번 여행 저장!" plus the exact title "{블로그 주제}".
5. Thumbnail 5 (bottom-left): Monochrome documentary layout — convert {참고 이미지} to black and white with crisp tonal separation, defined shadows, newspaper-like caption bars, page number "05", and a small line "by {작성자핸들}".
6. Thumbnail 6 (bottom-second): Illustrated social card layout — pair {참고 이미지} with hand-drawn outlines, sketch accents, doodle arrows, small heart/save/share micro icons, "{대표해시태그}", and a playful caption "카페 루트 메모".
7. Thumbnail 7 (bottom-third): Polaroid memory layout — frame {참고 이미지} inside a white instant-photo print with a slight tilt, visible paper texture, taped corners, a handwritten caption "{장소}", date "{날짜}", and a small bottom note "다시 가고 싶은 곳".
8. Thumbnail 8 (bottom-right): Collage end-card layout — layer {참고 이미지} with torn paper edges, overlapping cutout pieces, receipt fragments, map-like shapes, slide indicator "8/8", and a CTA sticker "{CTA문구}" for a scrapbook-inspired blog finish.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard for primary Korean text overlays; Bold 700 for the main title area, SemiBold 600 for feature labels, Medium 500 for captions and metadata, with thumbnail-safe sizing and tight line control for 1:1 preview readability.
- Korean title hierarchy: the exact string "{블로그 주제}" should be the most important readable phrase in at least 4 panels; other panels may use compact supporting labels while still keeping the topic obvious.
- Color palette: use a deliberate eight-way split from {컬러 톤} with tones such as #F4EFE6 neutral beige, #111111 editorial black, #F2D2B6 sepia brown, #FF5A5F coral, #2F6BFF cobalt, #444444 charcoal, #D9C8FF pastel accent, #DDE7F2 faded polaroid blue, plus visible paper textures, tape marks, ink lines, barcode marks, and caption chips where appropriate.
- Panel depth: apply a subtle shadow around each thumbnail, 5px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity, with clean panel separation and slight tactile depth so the sheet reads like a premium printed mockup board.
- Graphic details: use blog/social-specific micro elements such as hashtags, tiny save/share icons, page numbers, slide indicators, speech-bubble stickers, travel stamps, and date/location labels, but keep every major text block readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: simulated DSLR presentation across the entire sheet, as if shot on a Canon EOS R5 with an RF 50mm f/1.8 lens for natural perspective and clear subject readability.
- Lighting: consistent soft light from the top-right at about 45°, with small style-specific shifts in contrast and color temperature per panel to differentiate the eight looks while keeping the sheet coherent.
- Color grade: clean editorial uses warm neutral tones; magazine uses high-contrast editorial blacks and whites; vintage uses warm faded sepia; color pop uses saturated coral/cobalt punch; monochrome uses low-saturation grayscale; illustrated uses playful pastel ink accents; polaroid uses faded instant-film cream and blue tones; collage uses tactile paper-layer colors and mixed texture grading.

[6. MOOD]
A curated high-end lifestyle blog branding sheet — like a modern Korean travel blog moodboard combining editorial magazine covers, social cards, scrapbook textures, and thumbnail-ready title systems.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean string must appear exactly and without typos wherever title text is rendered: "{블로그 주제}".
- Include these Korean rendered details where appropriate: "{블로그명}", "{작성자핸들}", "{날짜}", "{장소}", "{대표해시태그}", "{CTA문구}", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "골목 카페 지도", "디저트 BEST 12", "현지 감성 루트", "이번 여행 저장!", "카페 루트 메모", "다시 가고 싶은 곳", "8/8".
- All 8 panels must remain clearly different in style while preserving the same source subject identity from {참고 이미지}.
- Maintain exactly 8 thumbnails in a {레이아웃}, all square, with consistent spacing and no missing panel.
- Use {변주 8종}, {컬러 톤}, and {비율} as the structural intent for the whole sheet.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, government marks, or certification badges.
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul.

- Celebrity composites or implying the subject is a public figure unless present in {참고 이미지}.

[1. PURPOSE]
Instagram Reels cover design for a mobile-first vertical thumbnail, optimized for fast scrolling, strong Korean typography, and a realistic lifestyle-feed impression.
Editorial brunch / daily-life series cover that looks like an actual creator upload: polished, warm, tactile, and social-media-ready, with small metadata details, handle text, hashtags, and subtle save/share-style micro icons.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center hero placement: {참고 이미지} occupies the middle 65–70% of the frame as the dominant focal point, integrated naturally into a warm lifestyle setting rather than floating on a blank mockup.
- Background treatment: cream paper surface with visible fine paper grain, soft beige shadows, and realistic brunch-table details such as a linen napkin edge, ceramic cup rim, small plate corner, spoon highlight, receipt-like note strip, and coral accent cards derived from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Text hierarchy: top 15% contains {시리즈 이름} as a bold editorial title, {에피소드 번호} as a compact episode chip, and a tiny creator handle line such as “@daily.archive”; bottom 18% contains {서브 타이틀}, short hashtag-like text, and small save/share micro icons.
- Decorative details: add subtle sticker tags, washi-tape strips, rounded coral labels, tiny sparkle or dot accents, and a small date/location label such as “2026.05 · 서울 브런치 노트” to make the cover feel used, designed, and publishable.
- Framing direction: vertical mobile balance with the hero centered, typography stacked in clear readable zones, and surrounding lifestyle elements arranged to guide the eye toward the title and subtitle.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (center 65–70%): {참고 이미지} placed prominently in the middle, softly integrated with the paper-and-tabletop background using realistic contact shadows, natural occlusion, and clean subject edges.
2. Top header (upper 15%): set {시리즈 이름} as the main title in a bold editorial lockup; place {에피소드 번호} nearby inside a small coral rounded label or paper-tab chip for immediate recognition.
3. Metadata strip: include tiny supporting Korean cover text around the header, for example “릴스 커버”, “오늘의 기록”, “@daily.archive”, and “VOL. 08”, set small but crisp so it reads like real creator branding.
4. Bottom footer (lower 18%): place {서브 타이틀} as a lighter-weight subtitle, with one short caption line such as “느리게 먹고 오래 기억하기” plus hashtag-like text “#브런치일상 #데일리루틴 #주말기록”.
5. Social-card details: add tiny outline micro icons suggesting save, share, comment, and play actions without copying any specific app UI; include a small page-like indicator “01 / REELS COVER” near the lower corner.
6. Accent balance: distribute coral, beige, and off-white graphic accents from {컬러 팔레트} around the title and footer; use paper labels, hand-drawn dots, soft underline strokes, and tape textures that support the layout without overpowering the hero.
7. Safe-area polish: keep important text and faces comfortably inside mobile-safe zones while allowing realistic background objects, shadows, and decorative fragments to extend toward the edges for a lived-in feed-cover look.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard for all UI-like text, bold 700 for {시리즈 이름}, medium 500 for {에피소드 번호}, regular 400 for {서브 타이틀}; use small condensed metadata text for handle, date, hashtag, and label details.
- Color palette: cream (#FFFDD0) as the dominant base, coral (#FF6F61) for accents, with soft off-white highlights, muted beige shadows, warm tan paper texture, and color cues from {컬러 팔레트}.
- Shadow and depth: soft drop shadow with about 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity on paper labels and hero integration; add realistic contact shadows under objects and a gentle vignette from the tabletop lighting.
- Graphic language: editorial lifestyle collage with rounded chips, tape strips, small sticker tags, thin dividers, micro icons, and handwritten-style accent marks while preserving clear title readability.
- Text placement: keep {시리즈 이름}, {에피소드 번호}, and {서브 타이틀} visually separated, with supporting microcopy smaller and secondary so the cover still reads instantly at thumbnail size.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm f/1.8 look, shallow depth-of-field feel, natural portrait framing with a softly isolated subject.
- Lighting: soft window light from the upper-left at a 45° angle, with gentle fill from the lower-right to preserve facial, paper, textile, ceramic, and tabletop detail.
- Color grade: warm cream base with coral highlights, slightly lifted shadows, tactile paper texture, realistic brunch-table warmth, and clean editorial contrast similar to a modern lifestyle magazine cover adapted for a Reels thumbnail.

[6. MOOD]
Modern lifestyle editorial — Kinfolk-inspired brunch diary meets Korean creator Reels cover, calm but content-rich, warm, tactile, and ready to post.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{시리즈 이름}", "{에피소드 번호}", "{서브 타이틀}" must appear exactly as written.
- Maintain a strict {비율} vertical layout with the hero centered and the main text blocks clearly separated at top and bottom.
- Add realistic Korean microcopy exactly where appropriate: “오늘의 기록”, “느리게 먹고 오래 기억하기”, “2026.05 · 서울 브런치 노트”, “#브런치일상 #데일리루틴 #주말기록”, and “@daily.archive”.
- Include tiny save/share/comment/play-style outline icons as decorative social-card cues, not as a copied app interface.
- Ensure the title, episode label, and subtitle remain legible at thumbnail size.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 10%): Place {사진관 이름} in large retro display type, centered horizontally, with a slight 70s disco-era arc or block layout for strong storefront visibility; add small supporting text above or beside it such as "SELF PHOTO BOOTH", "SEOUL RETRO CAMPAIGN", and "VOL.07 · 2026 SPRING" to make it feel like a real printed promotion.

Main hero area (mid 55–60%): Show {참고 이미지} as the photo booth interior, cleanly integrated and framed as the main product shot, with subtle disco ball reflections, sparkle overlays near the upper edge, film-frame corners, and a glossy poster highlight; do not obscure important interior details, buttons, mirrors, or seating surfaces.

6. Pricing footer (bottom 10%): Display {가격} in a contrasting bold label, larger than body text and separated by a small divider line or dot ornament so the offer reads instantly; keep the price visually anchored near the bottom with supporting copy such as "현장 결제 · 카드/간편결제 가능".

9. Ratio-safe finishing: Preserve the {비율} composition with balanced top-to-bottom hierarchy and no cropping of key Korean text; maintain a polished vertical poster silhouette suitable for social sharing and storefront display.
