Nostalgic retro disco poster — like a 1970s dance-floor campaign mixed with a modern Seoul unmanned photo-booth ad aesthetic, lively, fun, promotional, and street-ready.

Designed to feel like a small independent bookstore flyer photographed and posted online, with printed paper texture, useful shop information, and the warm realism of an actual local bookstore recommendation card.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The centered hero area takes about 68–70% of the frame and holds {참고 이미지} as the visual focus; the top header occupies about 15%, while the lower information area combines the curation copy, shop details, and social-card micro elements in the remaining space.

- Framing direction: clear editorial separation between header, hero image, and footer, with a believable printed-card layout that could sit on a bookstore counter or appear as an Instagram square post.
- Add practical bookstore-poster details around the main content: small issue/date label, tiny section tag, local shop address line, store hours, handle, hashtags, save/share micro icons, and a small curator credit line.
- Use {책방 이름}, {이번 주 큐레이션}, {큐레이터 한 줄}, {컬러 팔레트}, {비율} placeholders naturally in the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Background layer: fill the entire square with a kraft-paper texture in warm beige, with fibrous paper grain, tiny darker flecks, slight edge darkening, and matte printed ink so the card feels physically produced rather than digitally flat.
2. Header band (top 15%): place a vintage green banner across the upper edge. Set {책방 이름} in bold Pretendard, centered, with compact storefront-sign spacing. Add small supporting text inside or just below the banner: “동네 책방 큐레이션”, “VOL.1161”, and “2026년 5월 1주차” in small cream or deep brown type.
3. Main image block (center 68–70%): place {참고 이미지} as the hero shelf/display photo, with crisp printed-photo edges, a subtle realistic drop shadow, and a thin warm-cream photo border. The image should look like an actual bookstore shelf or front-table display with visible book spines, handwritten shelf talkers, small price tags, bookmark strips, and natural paper textures.
4. Image annotation details: overlay or place beside the photo very small editorial labels such as “STAFF PICK”, “시집 코너”, “새로 들어온 책”, and a tiny caption strip reading “사진: {책방 이름} 매대 기록”. Keep these details secondary but legible.
5. Curation block (bottom area): set “이번 주 큐레이션: {이번 주 큐레이션}” above “큐레이터: {큐레이터 한 줄}” as the primary two-line stack, centered or slightly left-aligned within a cream note panel. Add realistic supporting information below: “OPEN 11:00–20:00”, “서울시 마포구 골목길 12”, “@book_alley”, “#시집추천 #동네책방 #봄독서”.
6. Social-card micro UI: add tiny save/share/comment line icons in one lower corner, a small “저장하고 주말에 들르기” CTA, and a subtle page-marker style text “1/1 CURATION CARD” to make the square feel like a finished social post.
7. Decorative print details: include restrained but visible bookstore ephemera such as a small receipt-stub graphic, thin divider rules, stamped-looking section labels, and a narrow spine-like vertical credit text on one side reading “LOCAL BOOKSTORE WEEKLY CURATION”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for {책방 이름} at headline scale, Noto Sans KR Regular for footer copy and captions, Noto Sans KR Medium for section labels, with clean Korean spacing and no decorative script fonts.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with kraft beige #C4A484, vintage green #4B6F44, warm cream #F5EBDD, deep brown #5B4636, and a muted brick accent #A45A43 for tiny stamps or divider marks.
- Border/shadow: add a subtle drop shadow under the main image only, around 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity; keep the banner flat with tactile ink texture rather than glossy effects.
- Printed realism: allow tiny registration imperfections, paper grain, slight ink spread, softened photo contrast, and real-world bookstore details such as shelf labels, bookmarks, and handwritten recommendation slips.
- Text hierarchy: {책방 이름} remains the largest text, {이번 주 큐레이션} is the second strongest text, and shop details/hashtags/captions remain small but readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: emulate a standard 50mm lens at f/5.6, as if the shelf photo were captured for a small neighborhood bookstore social post, with balanced depth and natural perspective.
- Lighting: soft window light from the left at about 45°, with gentle highlights on book spines, mild shadow falloff on the right side, and warm reflections on paper covers.
- Color grade: warm cream base with muted vintage green accents, slightly desaturated for a paper-print editorial feel, while preserving the natural colors of book covers and shelf materials.
- Material detail: show tactile paper fibers, matte ink, soft photo paper sheen, tiny scuffs near edges, and believable printed-card depth.

[6. MOOD]
Independent neighborhood bookstore editorial — a warm local community recommendation card, part shop notice and part Instagram post, with the intimacy of a carefully curated front-table display and the charm of a printed flyer found near the cashier.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the rendered image: "책읽는 골목", "이번 주 큐레이션: 5월의 시집 — 봄을 다시 사는 5권", "큐레이터: 봄볕에 어울리는 5권을 골랐습니다".
- Additional Korean text should be clean and legible, including short realistic labels such as "동네 책방 큐레이션", "2026년 5월 1주차", "시집 코너", "새로 들어온 책", "저장하고 주말에 들르기", "서울시 마포구 골목길 12", "#시집추천 #동네책방 #봄독서".
- Layout invariant: the top header, centered shelf image, and bottom curation/shop-information block must remain in the same order and proportion across the square.
- Book cover designs may be fictional, but all Korean text must be cleanly rendered with correct spacing and legible characters.
- The finished image should look like a real printed bookstore curation card photographed or exported for social media, not a sterile template.

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

Hero area (top 56-60%): {참고 이미지} cleanly presented as the main visual, centered with a soft realistic shadow beneath the dish, subtle food texture, a faint outer vignette, and small real-life café details around the hero such as a folded beige napkin, tiny herb garnish, fork handle, receipt corner, or espresso crema reflection without covering the dish.
2. Header block (upper-middle): "{헤드라인}" placed directly below the hero in bold centered alignment, occupying about 12-15% of the full height. Add a small eyebrow label above it, such as "WEEKEND BRUNCH MENU" or "오늘의 브런치", and a tiny date label like "2026.05 · SEASONAL BOARD".
3. Café name line (middle-lower): "{카페 이름}" set beneath the header in smaller size, centered or slightly left-weighted within the text block to create a refined editorial rhythm and clear brand separation. Add a small descriptor line nearby: "handmade brunch · coffee · bakery" and a tiny location/contact line: "서울 성동구 카페거리 12 · 02-1234-5678".
4. Menu lineup (bottom 34-40%): "{메뉴 라인업}" stacked vertically with even line spacing, each menu item separated clearly for quick scanning in a café environment, with the price visible in the same line for immediate ordering. Use elegant dotted leaders, thin beige dividers, or small category chips such as "SIGNATURE", "PASTA", "TOAST", "BOWL" while keeping the supplied menu text readable.
5. Footer information band: include a slim printed footer with realistic ordering details such as "주문 가능 10:00-15:00", "커피 세트 +4,000", "포장 가능", and a small QR-code-like reservation square or barcode-style mark on one side. Add a tiny disclaimer line in Korean such as "재료 수급에 따라 일부 메뉴가 변경될 수 있습니다." so the poster feels like an actual café menu.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard for header and menu items; header in bold 700-800 at large poster size, café name and menu items in regular 400-500 with clean tracking for legibility, and slightly increased line-height for the menu list. Use small caps or condensed sans-serif for English micro-labels and date/contact details.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}, use ivory #F5F5DC for the base, warm beige #D2B48C for accent bands, menu chips, and divider rules, soft taupe #B8A58A for secondary text, and muted coffee brown #5C4A3B for main text and contrast details. Add subtle toasted-gold highlights only in small labels or rule lines.
- Border/shadow: use a thin warm beige printed frame, soft rounded menu-card panels, gentle inner paper shadow, and a soft drop shadow with 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity on the hero. Text should remain crisp with subtle contrast enhancement only where needed.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 50mm f/1.8, natural perspective and gentle food-poster compression suitable for a vertical menu layout.
- Lighting: soft window light from the left at roughly 45°, with mild fill from the right to preserve texture on the food and keep the beige background even; add realistic highlights on plate glaze, sauce, bread crust, and coffee surface if visible.
- Color grade: warm cream base with beige highlights, low-contrast editorial toning, slightly softened whites, natural food saturation, and tactile paper grain to match a refined brunch-café print aesthetic.

[6. MOOD]
Premium brunch menu editorial — Kinfolk magazine spread feel with a quiet Scandinavian café sensibility, enriched with realistic café counter details, seasonal menu information, and warm printed hospitality.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "주말 아침의 작은 사치", "Sundays Brunch", "에그 베네딕트 18,000 / 트러플 파스타 22,000 / 아보카도 토스트 14,000 / 시즌 그래놀라 12,000" must appear exactly as written and without broken characters.
- Set bold main cover line in Korean using "{헤드라인}" and keep the café name "{카페 이름}" clearly readable.
- Menu text from "{메뉴 라인업}" must remain fully readable, with each item and price visually separated by line breaks, dotted leaders, or divider rules.
- Include realistic small Korean menu-board details: "주문 가능 10:00-15:00", "커피 세트 +4,000", "서울 성동구 카페거리 12", and "재료 수급에 따라 일부 메뉴가 변경될 수 있습니다." in tiny but legible supporting text.
- Maintain the 2:3 vertical aspect ratio and output_size 1024x1536.

Create a Korean photo booth strip in a square social-post format, featuring four distinct concept transformations of the same person.
Design it as a highly shareable identity-reimagining collage where each panel keeps the same pose and crop but changes the visual style, with realistic photo-booth paper, small Korean captions, date/location labeling, and subtle social-post details that make it feel like an actual printed 4-cut keepsake.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the same face from {참고 이미지} is centered in each panel, occupying about 70% of each frame with head-and-shoulders framing and a stable eye line.
- Background treatment: each panel gets a separate studio-style background matched to {컨셉 4종}; allow realistic booth-wall gradients, gentle paper texture, tiny light falloff, and panel-specific graphic accents that support each concept.
- Spacing, framing direction: strict vertical 4-cut layout using {레이아웃}, equal gutters, consistent crop, and a photo-booth-strip outer frame placed inside the 1024x1024 square social canvas.
- Framing: keep the subject locked to the center axis in all four panels so the four versions read as one coherent set.
- Realistic strip details: add a glossy white photo-strip border, tiny frame numbers, a bottom caption block, a date/location label, small sticker-like tags, and a discreet barcode-style print mark near the lower edge.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Frame 1 (top): transform {참고 이미지} into a Pixar-inspired animated portrait, with rounded facial shading, large expressive eyes, bright skin tones, crisp color separation, and a cheerful backdrop with soft playful shapes.
2. Frame 2: restyle {참고 이미지} as a vintage 70s portrait, using soft warm highlights, muted saturation, subtle film grain, analog print character, and a gently faded background palette with retro color bands.
3. Frame 3: convert {참고 이미지} into a Y2K digital aesthetic, with glossy accents, punchy neon colors, pixel-like graphic hints, chrome sticker details, and a slightly futuristic sticker-finish treatment.
4. Frame 4 (bottom): render {참고 이미지} as a film camera snapshot, with gentle halation, warm nostalgic tones, natural contrast, fine analog grain, and a scanned-print feeling.
5. Bottom strip caption area: include short Korean text such as “오늘의 4컷”, “컨셉 변환 완료”, “2026.05.01 성수동”, “#나다운무드 #인생네컷”, plus a tiny handle like “@my4cut.diary”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use small, clean, realistic Korean photo-booth typography; add tiny panel labels such as “01 애니”, “02 레트로”, “03 Y2K”, “04 필름” without covering the face.
- Color palette: use {컬러 톤} as the guiding color logic for each panel, keeping the four looks clearly differentiated while preserving skin-tone readability.
- Border/shadow: each panel has a thin white border and crisp printed-photo edges; add realistic glossy paper highlights, subtle booth-print texture, slight corner wear, and a soft cast shadow from the strip on the square background.
- Decorative details: include tasteful small stickers or tags, such as a tiny sparkle sticker, heart doodle, chrome star, date stamp, or rounded label tape, placed around the strip edges and caption zone.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: simulate a Ricoh GR1-style compact 35mm point-and-shoot look overall, 28mm f/2.8 snapshot character, with the source portrait reinterpreted like four edited prints from the same photo session.
- Lighting: even frontal beauty-photo-booth light with soft diffusion, natural facial modeling, catchlights in the eyes, consistent exposure across all four frames, and slight realistic variation in paper reflections.
- Color grade: Pixar vibrant and clean in frame 1, 70s muted and grainy in frame 2, Y2K bold and neon in frame 3, film warm and nostalgic in frame 4.
- Material realism: make the final image feel like a photographed physical 4-cut print on glossy paper, with tiny dust specks, fine print grain, soft shadow under the strip, and believable ink density.

[6. MOOD]
Playful retro-to-futuristic makeover — like a carefully curated Korean photo booth strip mixed with a social-media transformation trend, with the charm of a real keepsake from a Seoul photo booth: cute, polished, personal, and ready to share.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render all on-image Korean cleanly and fully legibly, especially “오늘의 4컷”, “컨셉 변환 완료”, “2026.05.01 성수동”, “#나다운무드 #인생네컷”, and “01 애니 / 02 레트로 / 03 Y2K / 04 필름”.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: the same person must be clearly recognizable in all four panels; face proportions, eyes, hands, and accessories must remain anatomically correct; all 4 panels must keep the same layout and crop logic.
- Identity consistency: preserve the recognizable facial structure, hairstyle cues, expression direction from {표정}, and overall {비율} across every concept transformation.

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized real-person likeness substitution

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean storefront transformation poster for social media and portfolio use, designed as a realistic 4-panel seasonal comparison grid.
Show one consistent shop exterior reimagined across spring, summer, autumn, and winter while preserving the exact facade structure and signage placement, enriched with real neighborhood details, seasonal street life, and editorial poster information.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the main storefront occupies the central 80% of the canvas, organized into a precise 2x2 grid with equal gutters and strong visual weight in all four quadrants.
- Poster information layer: add a compact top title band and small bottom credit strip around the grid, using Korean editorial text such as “사계절 매장 외관 변환”, “SEASONAL FACADE STUDY”, “VOL.1157”, “2026 포트폴리오 아카이브”, and a small credit line “공간명: {매장 이름}”.
- Background treatment: each panel uses a season-specific streetscape, weather condition, pavement texture, reflected sky, foliage, and small human-scale details, while the building footprint, camera angle, horizon level, and storefront proportions remain perfectly aligned.
- Real-world context: include believable sidewalk elements such as planters, a bicycle, street curb markings, window reflections, small posters inside the glass, subtle interior lighting, and seasonal shop-front decorations that do not change the facade geometry.
- Spacing and framing: use thin neutral dividers, a portfolio-poster style frame, seasonal panel labels, and small caption text so the comparison reads like a finished design presentation.
- Use {매장 이름}, {레이아웃}, {각 시즌 무드}, {컬러 톤}, {비율} as the governing composition and styling placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Grid base — build a square 2x2 layout with four equally sized panels, each panel dedicated to one season and separated by crisp 1–2px divider lines; add small corner labels “봄 SPRING”, “여름 SUMMER”, “가을 AUTUMN”, “겨울 WINTER”.
2) Shared architecture layer — keep the same storefront facade geometry, window positions, door placement, awning or roofline, signboard location, entrance step, mullion spacing, and exterior proportions identical across all panels.
3) Editorial header/footer — at the top, set the title “사계절 매장 외관 변환” with smaller supporting text “{매장 이름} · {레이아웃} · {비율}”; at the bottom, include a small project note “계절 무드: {각 시즌 무드}”, a color note “톤: {컬러 톤}”, date text “2026.05”, and tiny credit text “Facade concept archive / Neighborhood retail study”.
4) Spring panel — render {매장 이름} with cherry blossoms, fresh pastel greenery, petal scatter on the sidewalk, soft morning daylight, clean glass reflections, a small flower bucket near the entrance, and a window sticker reading “봄 신상”; preserve the same storefront angle, pavement edge, and building silhouette.
5) Summer panel — render dense green foliage, bright sky reflections, stronger awning shadows, sunlit pavement, iced drink poster inside the window, a small standing sign reading “오늘의 추천”, and a faint heat-haze atmosphere while keeping the exact entrance placement and exterior proportions unchanged.
6) Autumn panel — render warm maple leaves, amber sidewalk accents, late-afternoon side light, fallen leaves near the curb, a small seasonal display with muted orange tones, and a window caption “가을 한정” while matching the same storefront details and signage placement exactly.
7) Winter panel — render snow-covered ledges, slushy sidewalk edges, muted street background, overcast diffused light, warm interior glow through the window, subtle condensation on glass, and a small notice “따뜻한 겨울 메뉴”; maintain identical facade alignment, window spacing, and signboard consistency.
8) Seasonal realism — let each season include appropriate weather traces, reflections, textures, and street objects, but never mix weather elements across panels; the viewer should immediately understand this is one shop documented across four different seasonal moods.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold for {매장 이름}, main Korean title, and seasonal labels; use Pretendard Regular for captions, dates, credit text, and small project notes, with readable square-poster hierarchy.
- Korean display text to include where appropriate: “사계절 매장 외관 변환”, “봄 SPRING”, “여름 SUMMER”, “가을 AUTUMN”, “겨울 WINTER”, “공간명: {매장 이름}”, “2026.05”, “계절 무드: {각 시즌 무드}”.
- Color palette: spring #D9F2E6, #F7C7D9, #FFF7E8; summer #6BBF59, #2F6F3E, #8FD3FF; autumn #D98B3A, #8C4A2F, #F2D5A0; winter #DDEAF7, #AAB8C8, #F5F7FA.
- Divider and depth: use 1–2px neutral divider lines between panels; if the storefront is composited, apply a soft realistic shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity.
- Surface detail: include realistic brick, painted metal, glass, concrete, sidewalk seams, leaf litter, snow texture, signage material, and subtle paper-grain or print texture in the poster frame.
- Layout finish: make the result feel like a polished Korean design-studio portfolio poster rather than a blank mockup, with micro labels, captions, and seasonal visual information integrated into the composition.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: straight-on architectural photography look, full-frame 35mm lens at f/8 for crisp storefront detail and minimal perspective distortion.
- Lighting: season-specific natural daylight per panel — spring soft morning light from upper-left, summer bright overhead daylight, autumn late-afternoon side light from right, winter overcast diffused light.
- Color grade: natural documentary realism with season-accurate tones; keep contrast moderate and avoid warm cast in the winter panel while allowing warm interior light through the glass.
- Rendering quality: realistic photographic textures, believable reflections, atmospheric depth, accurate shadows, natural street imperfections, and high-resolution editorial print sharpness.

[6. MOOD]
Editorial neighborhood storefront study — a refined Korean architecture and retail-branding poster with the lived-in realism of a local street photograph and the composed layout discipline of a design magazine feature.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the shop name {매장 이름} must appear correctly if rendered in signage, header text, labels, or caption text.
- Render Korean text cleanly and legibly, especially “사계절 매장 외관 변환”, “공간명: {매장 이름}”, “봄”, “여름”, “가을”, “겨울”, and “계절 무드: {각 시즌 무드}”.
- Maintain one identical store facade across all four panels: same architecture, same camera angle, same signboard placement, same storefront proportions, same door and window structure.
- All four seasonal panels must clearly read as the same location transformed only by weather, foliage, decorations, lighting, reflections, and surrounding seasonal street details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean Pilates studio membership recruitment poster for print and mobile social sharing.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Background treatment: warm-white editorial background with subtle paper grain, soft cream tone, light sage-beige accent panels, faint Pilates line-art graphics, and realistic printed-poster texture.

- Add realistic studio-poster content around the hero: date label, class schedule strip, venue/contact line, limited-membership note, small QR-style reservation box, and a subtle sponsor/partner footer.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (mid 60%): {참고 이미지} placed prominently in the center with a refined rectangular crop or softly rounded photo card, realistic shadow, slight paper lift, and believable Pilates studio context such as reformer machines, mats, mirrors, wooden floor, plants, towels, resistance bands, and daylight reflections if they fit the reference.
2. Header area (top 15%): {스튜디오 이름} set small and refined near the top center in a brand line, with a tiny label such as NEW MEMBER PROGRAM / MAY 2026 above or beside it; {헤드라인} directly below it in the largest bold type, centered and spaced for immediate first read.
3. Offer area (lower middle 15%): {이벤트} placed in medium-weight text inside a soft green accent block or layered paper ticket strip, accompanied by short Korean benefit chips such as 체형 분석 1회 제공, 1:1 상담 예약, 소도구 클래스 체험.
4. Event-detail band: include realistic recruitment details in small Korean type: 모집 기간 2026.05.01–05.31, 운영 시간 평일 07:00–22:00 / 주말 09:00–17:00, 장소 서울 성수동 Aire Pilates 2F, 문의 02-0000-1156 / @aire_pilates.
5. CTA area (bottom 10%): {CTA} positioned near the lower right or centered at the bottom in a button-like treatment, visually distinct with soft green fill or outline, plus a small QR reservation box labeled QR 예약 and a micro line 지금 상담 시 체험권 우선 안내.
6. Footer and sponsor area: add a slim footer with decorative dividers, tiny partner-style text such as Wellness Partner · Barre & Recovery Lab, campaign code MAY-CORE-30, and small legal-style note 선착순 30명 한정 / 타 이벤트 중복 불가.
7. Ratio lock: preserve the vertical 2:3 layout from {비율}, with all elements balanced for poster printing and story-style sharing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold for {스튜디오 이름}, Pretendard Bold for {헤드라인} and key labels, Noto Sans KR Regular for {이벤트}, {CTA}, details, captions, and footer notes; headline around 64–80px feel, body around 30–38px feel, detail text around 18–24px feel, with clean tracking and even line spacing.
- Color palette: warm gray #F5F5F5, charcoal black #333333, soft green #A8D5BA, muted beige #EFE8DE, white #FFFFFF; use soft green as accents in labels, dividers, CTA button, QR box frame, and small graphic tags.
- Layout accents: add fine rule lines, small rounded info chips, a ticket-stub style promotion strip, light botanical or Pilates pose line drawings, and subtle paper-layer shadows that support readability.
- Border/shadow: use delicate hairline separators and soft drop shadows with 5px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity to the hero image, event card, CTA button, and QR reservation box for gentle physical depth.
- Text hierarchy: make {헤드라인} the strongest read, {이벤트} the second strongest read, and the date/time/venue/contact details clearly legible without competing with the hero image.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with a 50mm f/1.8 lens look for crisp, approachable studio photography clarity.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from the top-left at about 45°, subtle fill from the right, airy interior highlight with natural shadow falloff.
- Color grade: warm cream and soft green palette, slightly desaturated neutrals, clean wellness editorial finish with natural skin tones.
- Material realism: printed-poster paper grain, soft ink edges, realistic photo contrast, gentle shadows under layered cards, believable QR placeholder texture, and slight tactile depth in the accent strips.

[6. MOOD]
Modern wellness studio promotion — Kinfolk magazine feature meets a premium Seoul Pilates studio editorial poster, with practical membership details and a welcoming boutique-studio atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "Aire Pilates", "5월, 다시 코어부터", "신규 회원 첫 달 30% 할인", "카톡 채널 상담하기" must appear exactly and clearly.
- Additional Korean poster text should be short, realistic, and legible: "모집 기간 2026.05.01–05.31", "평일 07:00–22:00", "서울 성수동 2F", "선착순 30명", "QR 예약", "@aire_pilates".
- Maintain the 2:3 vertical ratio exactly as specified by {비율}.
- Keep body proportions natural and realistic if people appear in {참고 이미지}; no distorted anatomy, duplicated limbs, or unnatural Pilates poses.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

Portrait-first identity card with clear hierarchy: headshot, company masthead, name block, role, contact details, employee number, access label, issue date, small internal badges, and QR placeholder.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {원본 인물} is centered in the portrait zone, occupying 48–52% of the total frame height, with the face slightly above center for a standard ID-card crop and shoulders visible inside the photo window.
- Badge scene: show the ID card inside a clear acrylic plastic sleeve with subtle rounded corners, a metal clip at the top, and a visible lanyard/strap using {배지 컬러}; place it on a realistic pale office desk or soft gray-blue background with gentle reflections, fine paper texture, and natural sleeve highlights.
- Card base: matte white credential card with a faint cool blue tint, navy accent bands, pale-blue header strip, micro-pattern security lines, tiny serial marks, and light gray separator rules that make it feel like a real employee access pass.
- Spacing and framing: keep a professional grid with readable sections while allowing realistic details such as a top slot punch, small access icons, issue-date stamp, page-like micro labels, plastic sleeve glare, and a barcode-style strip near the lower edge.
- Use {회사·소속}, {이름}, {직급}, {이메일}, {직원 번호}, {배지 컬러}, {QR placeholder} exactly as the primary card content, with all key text clean, crisp, and fully legible.

2. Access strip and hardware: at the very top, include a realistic slot punch, brushed metal clip, and a lanyard loop in {배지 컬러}; add a small navy ACCESS badge and a tiny internal label 본인 확인용 beneath the header, avoiding any government-style seal.
3. Portrait area (mid 46%): {원본 인물} appears as a clean front-facing ID portrait, shoulders visible enough for an ID crop, hairline and eyewear preserved if present, with a subtle soft shadow under the portrait window and faint plastic sleeve reflection across one corner.
4. Identity block (below portrait, mid-lower 18%): place {이름} as the largest line in the left-aligned text column, with {직급} directly below in smaller weight and tighter tracking; add tiny supporting Korean labels 이름 and 직급 in pale gray above or beside the main values.
5. Contact block (lower 14%): show {이메일} and {직원 번호} as a compact directory-style list in smaller regular text, using neat separators, icon-like micro marks for mail and employee number, and an added fixed line 발급일 2026.05.01 in the same style.
6. QR area (bottom-right 10%): render {QR placeholder} as a square QR-code placeholder with a thin navy outline, crisp inner geometry, and white padding, anchored to the bottom-right corner; place tiny text 스캔하여 확인 below the QR box.
7. Footer details: include a small horizontal barcode strip, page-like micro number ID-2026-05, a tiny internal badge text 출입카드, and a slim navy footer band to make the badge feel operational and realistic.
8. Badge accent: integrate {배지 컬러} as the visible neck strap and a small color-coded side tab, with realistic woven fabric texture on the lanyard and soft shadows where it overlaps the plastic sleeve.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the header at large size, Pretendard Semibold for {이름}, Pretendard Regular for {직급}, {이메일}, {직원 번호}, and micro labels; use clean anti-aliased Korean text with formal spacing, sharp readability, and realistic print registration.

Modern corporate ID card — polished HR onboarding credential with realistic office-access details, professional verification feel, premium stationery, subtle security graphics, and a trustworthy employee profile presentation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the rendered badge must show these strings exactly as intended: {회사·소속}, {이름}, {직급}, {이메일}, {직원 번호}.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The subject is a single consistent person repeated across all four panels, with identity, hairstyle, age appearance, and wardrobe continuity preserved across the set.
- Each panel occupies one quarter of the sheet in a strict 2x2 grid; keep equal gutters, a white outer border, and a narrow top caption band reserved for the frame text.
- Background treatment: realistic studio photobooth backdrop in muted lavender-to-plum tones, including soft curtain folds, faint printed-paper texture, subtle flash falloff, and tiny dust/scratch marks from instant photo printing.
- Keep the face and upper torso centered in every panel, with slightly different expressions per pose and natural photobooth spacing around the head for the booth framing.
- Add realistic Korean photobooth print details: tiny cut numbers, small date/location label, subtle sticker-like heart and sparkle marks, a small caption tag, and a tiny receipt-style code area near the lower border.
- Use {원본 인물}, {컨셉}, {포즈 4종}, {레이아웃}, {프레임 문구}, {필름 효과}, {비율} placeholders throughout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Overall sheet layout:
- Build a single vertical poster in a strict 2x2 grid, with identical panel sizing, crisp white dividers, and a white margin around the entire sheet.
- Reserve a slim header band at the top for {프레임 문구}, separated from the grid by a printed divider line and small booth-style metadata.
- Add tiny realistic print information in Korean near the header and footer: “인생네컷 · 2026.05.01”, “홍대입구 포토부스”, “오늘의 기록”, “NO.1149”, and “#보라빛하루”.
2) Panel 1 (top-left):
- Place {원본 인물} chest-up and centered, facing camera with a clear friendly smile, keeping the same face shape, hairstyle, and lighting continuity as the other panels.
- Add a tiny corner label “컷 01” and a small pale-pink sticker heart near the frame edge, not covering the face.
3) Panel 2 (top-right):
- Repeat the same person with a wink pose from a similar crop, shoulders slightly angled, expression playful but still natural, with matching flash exposure and wardrobe continuity.
- Add a tiny corner label “컷 02” plus a subtle sparkle sticker and a short Korean tag “오늘 분위기 좋음”.
4) Panel 3 (bottom-left):
- Show {원본 인물} forming a hand heart near the chest; hands must be fully visible, anatomically correct, and proportionate, with the face still centered in the booth frame.
- Add a tiny corner label “컷 03” and a small caption strip reading “하트 성공”.
5) Panel 4 (bottom-right):
- Use a calmer expression with relaxed lips and a soft gaze, preserving identity consistency and keeping the same camera distance as the other three panels.
- Add a tiny corner label “컷 04” and a small printed date tick mark near the lower-right edge.
6) Header, footer, and print treatment:
- Place {프레임 문구} in the top band like a printed photobooth caption, centered or slightly left-aligned, with Pretendard-style Korean lettering.
- Add a slim footer band with tiny Korean caption text, a small receipt-code block, and soft lavender divider marks to make the sheet feel like a real printed booth card.
- Apply {필름 효과} subtly across the whole sheet so all four frames read as one analog print set with consistent grain, flash bloom, paper fibers, and slight printer ink variation.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold for the header at medium-large size, clean sans-serif spacing, with compact photobooth-caption proportions similar to modern Korean photo-print graphics.
- Supporting typography: tiny Pretendard Regular micro-labels for “컷 01”, “홍대입구 포토부스”, “오늘의 기록”, “NO.1149”, and “#보라빛하루”, printed clearly but secondary to the portrait.
- Color palette: lavender #8E73C8, plum #5E3A78, soft white #F7F4EF, muted gray #CFC9D6, pale pink highlight #E8D3E6.
- Border/shadow: crisp white border with a faint paper-edge shadow, 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity; include slight paper thickness, tiny rounded print corners, and a subtle off-white paper sheen.
- Decorative details should feel like real Korean photobooth graphics: small hearts, sparkle stickers, cut numbers, date label, location label, and lightly printed dividers that support the {컨셉} without overwhelming the face.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Fujifilm X-T5 with 56mm f/1.2 portrait lens, photobooth framing with a centered crop and slight flash flattening.
- Lighting: direct on-camera flash with soft diffusion, mild hot-spot on cheeks and forehead, even exposure across all four panels, with realistic catchlights in the eyes.
- Color grade: vintage print tone with lowered saturation, lavender-purple dominance, warm skin tones preserved, subtle faded shadows.
- Material realism: semi-gloss photo paper, faint fingerprints along the border, barely visible printer grain, small edge shadow, and natural booth-light reflections.

[6. MOOD]
Nostalgic Korean photobooth print — like a stylish late-night arcade booth memory card, with playful sticker details, a soft purple studio glow, and modern editorial polish reminiscent of a Kinfolk-style printed page.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: “인생네컷 · 2026.05.01”
- Additional Korean text should be legible where shown: “홍대입구 포토부스”, “오늘의 기록”, “#보라빛하루”, “컷 01”, “컷 02”, “컷 03”, “컷 04”.
- All 4 panels must clearly depict the same person with consistent facial identity, hairstyle, and age appearance.
- Hands must be anatomically correct, especially in the hand-heart pose.
- The layout must remain exactly 2x2 with four separate panels and a white border.
- Input image usage must be limited to the original person or an explicitly authorized person only.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized use of another person's likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Premium vertical character-profile poster that transforms a real person into a Korean space explorer ID-style portrait.
Designed as a cinematic astronaut mission card for a shareable profile image, polished social post, or profile-cover artwork with realistic mission-card details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: one centered hero portrait fills about 62% of the frame height, chest-up selfie-style framing, face fully visible and unobstructed, matching {구도}.
- Background treatment: deep navy space field with lunar horizon across the lower third, Earth glowing above the subject’s right shoulder, star particles, faint nebula haze, distant satellite glint, and realistic moon dust texture, matching {배경}.
- Layout treatment: the upper band contains a layered mission header, profile name, ID number, and date/location labels; the lower band includes stats, badge chips, caption text, and social-card micro icons.
- Use {원본 인물} as the facial identity base, preserving likeness, expression, skin tone, and age cues.
- Apply {의상} while keeping the helmet open so the face remains clearly visible.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero portrait layer: {원본 인물} centered in the mid-frame, chest-up composition, white astronaut suit rendered with realistic fabric seams, zipper seams, pressure-joint rings, small Korean flag-style patch, mission patch embroidery, reflective visor rim, and open helmet framing the face without occlusion.
2) Mission title block: title text “본인 우주 탐험가 프로필” placed near the upper-left or upper-center, with {이름·계급} beneath it in strong stacked typography and {미션 코드} directly below in smaller tracking-heavy text.
3) Affiliation and ID block: {소속} positioned under the mission code, paired with {기록번호}, a small barcode-style mission strip, and a non-official profile-card serial label.
4) Date/location selfie card details: add compact labels “탐사일 {탐사일}”, “위치 {위치라벨}”, and “콜사인 {호출부호}” as realistic profile metadata near the upper-right or side rail.
5) Stats and badge strip: include {임무통계} in 2–3 small stat cells, {배지문구} as rounded badge chips, a subtle date stamp, thin certificate-style corner ornaments, and a lunar-coordinate micro grid.
6) Social profile finish: add {프로필캡션}, {해시태그}, tiny save/share/like micro icons, and {카드하단문구} along the lower portion without covering the face or mission suit details.
7) Environment layer: {배경} placed behind the subject with realistic scale contrast—moon surface textures low in frame, Earth bright and slightly blurred in the distance, star particles, soft blue atmospheric glow, and a cinematic rim-light halo.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the name line, Pretendard Medium for mission code, affiliation, stats, and date/location labels; sizes around 54–72 px for the name and 20–34 px for support text; use crisp uppercase-style Latin spacing for mission text while keeping Korean labels highly readable.
- Color palette: deep navy #081A33, lunar gray #BFC7D5, space white #F6F8FB, Earth blue #4F8DFF, accent gold #D8B25C, subtle silver #D9E1EA, small safety-orange #FF8A3D accents for badge chips.
- Graphic system: thin 1px white divider lines at low opacity, translucent HUD panels, rounded profile-card tags, micro barcode strip, lunar coordinate ticks, and certificate-style corner marks that feel premium but not governmental.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity under the subject; gentle inner glow around helmet glass and rim-lit shoulder edges.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5-style full-frame portrait look with an 85mm f/1.4 equivalent, shallow depth of field, crisp facial detail, slightly compressed background separation.
- Lighting: soft key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle cool rim light from right edge, faint fill from front to keep the face evenly readable inside the open helmet, small Earth-blue reflection on helmet rim.
- Texture realism: realistic suit fabric weave, embroidered patch stitching, brushed metal helmet ring, subtle visor reflections, moon dust particles, and printed-card overlay grain.
- Color grade: cinematic navy-and-silver base with restrained cool blues, neutral skin tones, and a slight warm highlight on the face for approachable premium contrast.

[6. MOOD]
{분위기} — premium aerospace editorial portrait, warm heroic profile card, Korean sci-fi mission archive, polished K-drama character poster energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear exactly and cleanly rendered if shown in the design: “본인 우주 탐험가 프로필”, “탐사일”, “위치”, “콜사인”, “임무 기록”, “우주 탐험가”.
- Use {미션 코드}, {소속}, {이름·계급}, {탐사일}, {위치라벨}, {호출부호}, {기록번호}, {임무통계}, {배지문구}, {프로필캡션}, {해시태그}, and {카드하단문구} as legible profile-card text blocks.
- Preserve the subject’s facial likeness from {원본 인물}; do not change identity, age, or expression beyond a natural portrait enhancement.
- The helmet must stay open and must not cover the eyes, nose, mouth, or jawline.
- Only one main person should be visible and sharp in focus.
- The design should feel like a fictional premium mission profile card, not an actual government ID or official certification.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, forged government emblems, counterfeit certification marks
- Broken Korean characters, misspelled Korean labels, garbled numbers, unreadable mission text
- Famous celebrity face blending or unauthorized face substitution
- Face warping, extra limbs, duplicated features, helmet obstruction over facial features

   - Add tiny product metadata below the price: "재입고 상품" and "온라인 스토어 단독 알림".
3. Information block (lower section):

- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with cream #F7F1EA, dusty rose #D8A3A0, coral #F27B73, charcoal #2F2F33, soft beige #E9DDD4, and muted warm brown accents for paper and stationery details.

- Graphic details: use thin dividers, rounded information chips, translucent vellum overlays, tiny dotted guide marks, soft receipt-paper edges, and small decorative botanical line art to create a realistic boutique shop-card feel.
- Layout must remain readable on mobile: headline, product name, price, restock date, limited quantity, alert method, and CTA should be immediately legible.

- Lighting: soft diffused studio lighting from upper-left with a faint fill from lower-right, preserving product detail and crisp cutout separation, with gentle shadows from paper tags and decorative objects.
- Color grade: warm cream + dusty rose + charcoal with gentle coral accents, soft contrast, natural paper warmth, and restrained saturation clipping.
- Surface realism: tactile matte paper, subtle linen fibers, slightly raised button effect, realistic product shadow, and mild depth between layered labels and background elements.

Premium boutique restock announcement — a warm editorial e-commerce card for a candle shop, combining Kinfolk-style calm, mobile commerce clarity, and realistic shop-update details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

   - Eyebrow label: "신상품 출시" set as a compact mint-tinted capsule or tight label directly above the headline, paired with a thin metallic gold rule.

   - Add a small product info strip near the hero base: "SKU 26-NEW-1138", "공식몰 런칭", and a tiny barcode/QR-style rectangle for realistic commerce-card detail.
3. Footer area (bottom 34%):

   - Add a small launch-benefit row with compact Korean labels such as "런칭 혜택", "무료배송", "첫 구매 10%", and "오늘만 알림 쿠폰" using tiny icon dots or line icons.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR for all Korean text, with bold 700–800 weight for the headline and medium 500 weight for body copy; use slightly condensed tracking for English micro labels and generous line spacing for Korean body text.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with specific accents in #FFFFFF, #DDEFE7, #9CCFB8, metallic gold #C9A86A, and charcoal #1F2328 for primary text.
- Border/shadow: product shadow should be a soft drop shadow with 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; CTA button may use a subtle 1px gold border or gentle mint fill.
- Decorative details: use thin gold divider lines, mint translucent panels, rounded retail chips, small line icons, tiny barcode/QR marks, and premium paper texture to create a realistic branded launch-card finish.
- Layout rhythm: maintain strong visual hierarchy between headline, hero product, price, and CTA while allowing secondary retail information to feel authentic and useful.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: soft window light from the upper-left at 45°, plus faint right-side fill to keep the bottle evenly lit and label readable; controlled highlights on the bottle curve, no harsh reflections.
- Color grade: clean white and mint base with subtle warm gold accents, slightly cool neutral balance, modern premium retail finish.
- Material realism: show believable product-edge highlights, soft contact shadows, paper-card texture, translucent overlay depth, and crisp printed typography as if photographed from a real premium launch card.

[6. MOOD]
Premium e-commerce launch card — Net-a-Porter product announcement meets a Korean beauty retail campaign, with realistic shopping details, elegant mint-gold styling, and polished mobile-ad energy.

- Product cutout must be clean, precise, fully intact, and not cropped at any edge.
- Launch price within "{가격}" must be visually distinguishable from the original price.

Premium editorial testimonial poster that turns one customer quote into a polished, realistic, saveable feed graphic with magazine-card details, social proof, and warm lifestyle context.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster-like vertical layout with a strong top header, a large centered quote block in the middle, and compact proof elements anchored at the bottom.

- The hero quote occupies the mid 42% of the card, with oversized quotation marks, subtle torn-paper or translucent highlight accents, and a dominant multi-line treatment of {리뷰 본문} that feels like a real customer quote clipped for a campaign card.

- Bottom left contains four pill-shaped keyword chips from {추천 키워드}, arranged on two lively lines if needed, with small decorative dots, mini star icons, or tag labels like '#솔직후기' and '#재방문각' nearby.
- Bottom right contains three small rounded thumbnails from {사진 placeholder}, evenly spaced and slightly staggered for a scrapbook-proof feel; thumbnails should look like realistic smartphone snapshots of the store, menu, table setting, product detail, or customer moment.
- Bottommost area contains a prominent CTA button with {CTA}, and {헤드라인} placed just above it as a small supporting line; include tiny footer details such as '고객 만족도 기록', 'SAVE · SHARE', and a simple page indicator '01 / REVIEW'.
- Use {컬러 톤} as the visual base, enriched with warm cream paper texture, soft yellow sticker accents, charcoal typography, subtle shadows, fine divider lines, and small editorial decorations that make the card feel printed and shareable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top area (18%): {매장명} in bold centered headline type, with {별점} directly below it in a smaller but still prominent line; stars should be visually clear and aligned with the rating text. Add small surrounding metadata: 'REVIEW PICK', 'No. 024', '2026.05', and '@review.note' in tiny editorial type.
2. Hero quote area (42%): Large opening and closing quotation marks framing {리뷰 본문}, set as the main visual anchor in the center of the card, with careful line breaks for easy reading and generous inner padding. Add a soft marker highlight behind one key line, subtle paper grain, and a small caption strip reading '고객이 직접 남긴 한마디'.
3. Author line (8%): {작성자} · {작성일} positioned beneath the quote, using a lighter weight and slightly tighter tracking to feel like metadata. Add a small verified-style text label '방문 후기' without imitating any official certification mark.
4. Bottom left keywords (15%): Four rounded chips extracted from {추천 키워드}, each chip with subtle spacing, soft fill, and consistent height so the cluster feels organized. Add tiny adjacent text like '추천 키워드' and decorative micro icons such as dots, sparkles, and a small tag outline.
5. Bottom right images (12%): Three small rounded photo thumbnails from {사진 placeholder}, arranged in a neat horizontal cluster or slight diagonal stack, with thin borders, soft shadows, and realistic cropped contents. Add tiny captions below or overlaid on thumbnails: '매장 분위기', '인기 메뉴', '방문 컷'.
6. Bottom CTA (5%): {헤드라인} as a small line above a full-width or near-full-width CTA button labeled {CTA}, anchored close to the bottom edge with safe margin. Include footer microcopy '저장하고 다음 방문 때 확인하기' plus tiny save/share icons for an Instagram-card feel.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard for all text; {매장명} bold 700 at large headline size, {별점} bold 700 medium size, {리뷰 본문} regular 400 at large quote size, {작성자} · {작성일} and chips in regular/medium 500; CTA in bold 700 with clear button contrast. Small editorial labels use Pretendard 500/600 with tight tracking.

- Border/shadow: Soft drop shadow on main card and thumbnails, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; chips and button use subtle 1px borders for definition. Add fine divider rules, sticker-like highlight blocks, and layered paper edges with warm cream tones.

- Detail density: Include enough small labels, icons, captions, and thumbnail details to feel like a real branded social review card, while keeping {리뷰 본문}, {매장명}, {별점}, and {CTA} as the clearest reading hierarchy.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Graphic design poster layout, top-down flat editorial composition; no photographic camera look required, but thumbnail mocks should feel like clean smartphone snapshots cropped into rounded rectangles.
- Lighting: Soft diffused studio-like illumination implied by gentle shadows and balanced contrast, with mild ambient warmth and natural paper depth.
- Color grade: White + soft yellow + charcoal with a restrained premium lifestyle editorial balance, warm accent glow in sticker areas, thumbnail highlights, and CTA button details.
- Rendering quality: crisp Korean typography, realistic paper grain, accurate alignment, rounded cards, tactile shadows, layered scrapbook-style review elements, and polished social-media export quality.

[6. MOOD]
Calm premium review-card editorial — like a Kinfolk-inspired lifestyle magazine layout translated into a social media testimonial poster, with warmer real-world details, subtle stickers, proof photos, and save-worthy Instagram card cues.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: {매장명}, {별점}, {작성자}, {작성일}, {리뷰 본문}, {추천 키워드}, {CTA}, {헤드라인}.
- The star rating must display exactly as provided in {별점}, with all star symbols and review count preserved.

- Spacing, framing direction: Central hero panel takes about 58–62% of the frame, with clear vertical separation between header, queue status, instructions, and footer note. Add realistic small signage details such as a ticket-stub strip, tiny service icons, a small QR-like reservation square, store-hours microcopy, and printed corner registration marks.
- Use {매장명}, {현재 시각}, {대기 번호}, {앞 대기 팀}, {예상 대기 시간}, {입장 인원}, {단계 1}, {단계 2}, {단계 3}, {안내 메시지} placeholders exactly as text content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): Large centered title “{매장명}” in bold, with small uppercase “WAITING NOTICE” and a tiny line “오늘의 대기 현황” above or near the title; place “{현재 시각} 기준” beneath it. Include thin terracotta horizontal rules, tiny left/right decorative dots, and a small printed issue-style label such as “HOST DESK CARD · DAILY”.
2. Hero area (middle 52%): A rounded rectangular cream panel with a soft shadow containing the queue number “{대기 번호}” as the largest element. Add a small label above it reading “대기 번호” and a ticket-style corner tag “NOW CALLING”. Below the number, show three compact status rows in a neat stacked layout with label-like dividers:
   - “앞 대기 팀” next to “{앞 대기 팀}”
   - “예상 대기 시간” next to “{예상 대기 시간}”
   - “입장 인원” next to “{입장 인원}”
   Add small icons for team count, clock, and guests, plus faint dotted receipt lines and a tiny barcode-like strip at the lower edge of the panel.
3. Instruction area (lower 22%): Three numbered or icon-led steps arranged vertically with clear spacing; each line should visually separate the step icon and the instruction text so the process reads immediately at a glance. Use coral circular number chips and soft cream cards for each row.
   - Step 1: {단계 1} placed first with a small clipboard-style icon and micro label “STEP 01”.
   - Step 2: {단계 2} placed second with a notification/chat-style icon and micro label “STEP 02”.
   - Step 3: {단계 3} placed third with a door/entry-style icon, slightly stronger emphasis, and micro label “STEP 03”.
4. Footer note (bottom 8%): Small centered note “{안내 메시지}” close to the bottom edge, separated by a thin terracotta divider. Add realistic footer details such as “영업시간 11:30–21:30”, “문의 02-1234-5678”, “좌석 상황에 따라 시간이 변동될 수 있습니다”, and a tiny QR-like reservation square on one side.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard for header and queue number, Noto Sans KR for body and instructions; header 700–800 weight, body 400–600 weight, queue number extra-bold with tall line height and high legibility. Use tiny condensed sans-serif for service labels, barcode captions, and footer microcopy.
- Color palette: Warm beige #F5E8C7, coral #FF6F61, cream #FFF7EA, deep brown #5A4332, muted terracotta #D98C7A, soft gray #8A7D73.
- Border/shadow: Hero panel with soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; rounded corners, thin coral border, terracotta dividers, small printed dots, and gentle ink-over-paper texture.
- Detail density: Include believable restaurant notice-card elements such as small receipt marks, service-hour text, icons, QR-like square, barcode strip, and printed alignment ticks while keeping all primary waiting information easy to read.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat graphic design composition, no photographic lens look; realistic premium print-signage layout with precise editorial spacing, tactile paper texture, and believable ink registration details.
- Lighting: Even print-style lighting with no directional glare; slight paper texture, warm tonal separation, soft panel shadows, and subtle print imperfections.
- Color grade: Warm cream + coral + terracotta palette with subdued contrast, similar to a premium café signage system and a carefully printed host-stand waiting card.

[6. MOOD]
Professional restaurant waiting board with a boutique café menu-board sensibility — warm, organized, service-oriented, and realistic enough to feel placed at an actual restaurant entrance.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: The following strings must appear exactly and legibly as rendered text: “{매장명}”, “{현재 시각} 기준”, “{대기 번호}”, “{앞 대기 팀}”, “{예상 대기 시간}”, “{입장 인원}”, “{단계 1}”, “{단계 2}”, “{단계 3}”, “{안내 메시지}”.
- Additional Korean text should be short and realistic, such as “오늘의 대기 현황”, “대기 번호”, “영업시간 11:30–21:30”, “문의 02-1234-5678”, and “좌석 상황에 따라 시간이 변동될 수 있습니다”.
- Anatomy/layout invariants when relevant: Preserve the exact hierarchy of header → queue status hero → 3-step instruction block → footer note; do not reorder the information blocks.

Vertical 2:3 location guide card for visitors, designed for quick scanning, mobile sharing, and printed café flyers.

- Top header band (18% of frame): A small ✦ icon sits at the far left of the eyebrow line, while the eyebrow text “오시는 길” is centered above the main title; place {매장 이름} in a large bold line, with {주소} directly below in a smaller regular line. Add a tiny date/location chip near the title reading “방문 안내 · 2026” and a small copy label “주소 복사” beside the address line.
- Middle map field (38%): A simplified illustrated neighborhood map occupies the center column, with the café pin slightly right of center and visually largest; place small landmark icons for subway, bus stop, convenience store, crosswalk, parking P, and a tiny park around the pin. Connect transit points to the café with 1–2 dotted walking paths, include short route labels such as “도보 3분”, “횡단보도”, and “골목 입구”, and add a mini legend strip at the lower edge of the map.
- Bottom information block (44%): Stack five clear single-line rows vertically, each row containing a small icon, a bold label, and the corresponding text; keep the label column aligned left and use thin dotted dividers between rows. Add a compact side note panel inside the lower section with “방문 전 확인해 주세요”, “주말 혼잡 시간 14:00–16:00”, and a QR-style square labeled “길찾기 QR”.
- Background treatment: Warm cream paper texture with subtle grain, faint off-white grid lines, soft olive accents, small printed registration marks, and a few café-themed micro illustrations such as a cup outline, leaf mark, arrow sticker, and tiny walking footprints.
- Framing and spacing: Maintain a strong centered vertical hierarchy, with the map in the middle and the details block filling the lower third like a polished lifestyle flyer; use layered paper-card panels, rounded corner label chips, and tactile printed ink details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 18%): Place the ✦ icon and eyebrow “오시는 길” above the main title {매장 이름}; set the title in large bold type, and put {주소} beneath it in smaller regular type, all centered and tightly grouped with balanced line spacing. Add small supporting Korean text: “동네 산책길에서 만나는 카페”, “방문 안내 · 2026”, and a tiny pill tag “주소 복사”.
2. Map area (mid 38%): Draw a simplified hand-illustrated neighborhood map with softly rounded streets, pale crosswalk stripes, a large warm-gold location pin marking the café, small landmark icons near the pin, and one or two dotted walking paths that guide the eye toward the store; add a small “{매장 이름}” label beside the pin and a tiny compass with “N” in the top-right corner of the map field. Include map labels in Korean such as “1번 출구”, “버스정류장”, “편의점”, “작은공원”, “공영주차장”, and a route sticker “도보 3분”.
3. Information area (bottom 44%): Render five neatly separated rows with icon + label + text, in this exact order: 1) 🚇 지하철 — {지하철}; 2) 🚌 버스 — {버스}; 3) 🚗 자가용·주차 — {자가용·주차}; 4) 🕐 영업 시간 — {영업 시간}; 5) 📞 문의 — {문의}; keep each row on one line, with text aligned to the right of the label and clearly readable at a glance.
4. Divider and footer treatment: Use thin dotted horizontal lines between the information rows and a subtle dotted separator between the map and the details block; add a footer band with “길찾기 QR”, “저장 후 공유해 주세요”, “@neighborhood_cafe”, and “MAP CARD 01” in tiny printed text. Include a QR-style square made of abstract blocks, not a functional scannable code.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; eyebrow and labels in medium weight, title in bold 44–52px equivalent, description text in regular 24–30px equivalent, micro labels in 15–18px equivalent, with crisp anti-aliased edges and consistent line spacing.
- Color palette: Cream #FFF8E7, Soft White #FFFCF5, Olive Green #8A9A5B, Deep Olive #5F6E3A, Warm Gold #D4AF37, Warm Gray #8B857A.
- Border/shadow: Thin dotted section dividers, rounded cream panels with olive hairline strokes, soft paper-layer shadows, warm-gold emphasis under the main pin, and tiny ink-like texture on map icons.
- Decorative details: Use small arrow stickers, footprint dots, compass tick marks, route labels, micro caption text, and café illustration accents while keeping every required information row readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat graphic design, top-down editorial infographic look, no photographic lens simulation.
- Lighting: Not applicable; emulate printed paper through even tonal distribution, mild paper grain, soft ink density variation, and subtle risograph-like texture.
- Color grade: Warm cream base with olive green navigation details and warm gold highlights, balanced like a lifestyle print guide.

[6. MOOD]
Clean lifestyle magazine navigation card — like a warm city guide page for a neighborhood café, practical enough for visitors and charming enough to save on a phone.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: The following strings must appear exactly and clearly in Korean: “오시는 길”, “{매장 이름}”, “{주소}”, “🚇 지하철”, “🚌 버스”, “🚗 자가용·주차”, “🕐 영업 시간”, “📞 문의”.
- Map clarity: The store pin must be the most prominent element in the map area, with the “{매장 이름}” label placed near it.
- Information visibility: All five info rows must remain single-line, fully readable, and evenly spaced.
- Realistic flyer details: Include short Korean micro text such as “도보 3분”, “길찾기 QR”, “방문 전 확인해 주세요”, and “저장 후 공유해 주세요” without overpowering the required fields.
- Layout consistency: Keep the top header, center map, and bottom details in a clear vertical hierarchy with no overlapping elements.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, badges, or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Professional Korean parking information card for cafe/store customers, vertical 2:3 printed notice with quick-scan public signage readability.
Create a realistic, content-rich 안내 card that could be displayed at a cafe counter, entrance door, cashier desk, or acrylic tabletop stand, combining clear wayfinding with polished store-service branding.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Single vertical parking 안내 card fills the frame with strong hierarchy; top header zone takes 22% of height, structured information grid 56%, caution/contact footer 22%.
- Use a premium off-white printed card base with subtle uncoated paper grain, navy #001F3F information panels, yellow #FFDC00 highlight tabs, cool gray micro text, and light gray section dividers.
- Design should feel like a real printed customer notice: include small service labels, parking pictograms, directional arrows, a simple mini-map block, step markers, footer metadata, and tiny contact/QR-style utility elements while keeping the main information instantly readable.
- Maintain print-safe padding, crisp left alignment inside rows, consistent vertical rhythm, and a practical counter-sign layout suitable for actual customer use.
- Use {매장명}, {주소}, {주차 위치}, {이용 시간}, {무료 시간}, {추가 시간 요금}, {이용 방법}, {주의사항}, {문의} naturally as the variable text content.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header block (upper 22%):
- Place a small top utility line above the store name: "CUSTOMER PARKING GUIDE · 방문 고객 전용" in compact navy-gray type.
- Place {매장명} centered near the top in the largest bold type, navy #001F3F, with tight tracking and strong headline presence.
- Place {주소} directly below in smaller regular type, centered, in cool gray #6B7280 for secondary hierarchy.
- Set the main title "🅿️ 주차 안내" beneath the address, larger than any body row, with a bold yellow #FFDC00 underline and a small navy parking-sign icon badge beside it.
- Add two small pill labels under the title, such as "주차 등록 필수" and "카운터 문의", styled as realistic printed service tags without overpowering the title.

2. Information list block (middle 56%):
- Build a centered information card column with five rounded panels, subtle shadows, thin #E5E7EB separators, and small yellow number tabs reading "01", "02", "03", "04", "05".
- Row 1: Put icon 📍 then bold label "위치", followed by {주차 위치}; add a compact right-side mini-map illustration with a P marker, entrance arrow, and tiny labels "매장", "입구", "주차장".
- Row 2: Put icon 🕐 then bold label "이용 시간", followed by {이용 시간}; include a small clock pictogram and a thin timeline accent line.
- Row 3: Put icon 🆓 then bold label "무료", followed by {무료 시간}; visually emphasize the free-time phrase with a yellow highlight strip behind the key time phrase only and a small badge reading "무료 적용".
- Row 4: Put icon ⏱️ then bold label "초과", followed by {추가 시간 요금}; use a slightly darker navy body tone so the fee remains highly legible, with a tiny receipt/coin pictogram as a realistic fee cue.
- Row 5: Put icon 🛂 then bold label "이용 방법", followed by {이용 방법}; make this row slightly more prominent with a soft pale-yellow background and include three compact step chips: "STEP 1 차량번호", "STEP 2 직원 확인", "STEP 3 출차".
- Keep all five rows in a clear column with consistent icon size, fixed label width, readable line wrapping, and enough detail to resemble a real store parking notice rather than a plain template.

3. Bottom notice block (lower 22%):
- Place a rounded light-gray caution box with a small warning icon and the label "이용 전 확인" followed by {주의사항}, using compact padding and smaller but legible type.
- Add a thin footer divider with micro text: "PARKING INFO · UPDATED 2026.05 · FRONT DESK".
- Place {문의} centered below the caution box in smaller navy-gray text, preceded by "문의" or a phone/message icon for quick recognition.
- Add a small QR-code-style square placeholder labeled "주차 위치 보기" and a tiny footer line "본 안내는 매장 방문 고객을 위한 주차 이용 안내입니다." to make the printed card feel practical and complete.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for {매장명}, "🅿️ 주차 안내", row labels, and key badges; Pretendard Regular for body copy, address, caution note, and contact details; headline about 44–52px equivalent, body 24–30px equivalent for print clarity, micro labels about 13–16px equivalent.
- Color palette: Off White #FFFDF8, White #FFFFFF, Navy #001F3F, Yellow #FFDC00, Cool Gray #6B7280, Light Gray #F3F4F6, Divider Gray #E5E7EB.
- Border/shadow: use a refined outer stroke in pale gray, subtle rounded card corners, soft panel shadows such as 0px 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), faint section dividers in #E5E7EB, and realistic printed ink edges.
- Graphic details: include parking pictograms, directional arrows, small map lines, step chips, QR-style utility block, footer metadata, and service badges; every added element should support wayfinding and customer comprehension.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: graphic design layout, no camera simulation.
- Lighting: clean print-preview presentation with crisp contrast, subtle paper grain, realistic ink density, and gentle shadowing on raised panels.
- Color grade: bright navy-and-yellow signage palette with premium cafe counter-card finish, realistic printed notice texture, and polished public-information design.

[6. MOOD]
Airport wayfinding board meets premium cafe service sign — precise, orderly, friendly, and easy to scan like a modern transit information placard displayed at a real neighborhood store.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "🅿️ 주차 안내", "위치", "이용 시간", "무료", "초과", "이용 방법", "방문 고객 전용", "주차 등록 필수", "카운터 문의", "이용 전 확인", "주차 위치 보기" must appear exactly and be spelled correctly.
- Render {매장명}, {주소}, {주차 위치}, {이용 시간}, {무료 시간}, {추가 시간 요금}, {이용 방법}, {주의사항}, {문의} clearly and without broken Korean characters.
- Time, fee, parking location, and usage method information must remain precise, legible, and easy to scan at a glance.
- Added decorative information such as arrows, mini-map, badges, step chips, QR-style block, and footer metadata must support the parking 안내 purpose and not obscure the provided variable text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical Korean price-change notice poster for in-store display, designed as a formal yet realistic announcement board for a café, bakery, salon, or boutique retail shop.
Readable from a short distance and suitable for shop windows, cashier counters, entrance doors, elevator notice frames, and lobby notice stands.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster format: vertical 2:3 layout with a calm premium notice-board feel, sized for 1024x1536 poster rendering.
- Subject placement: {매장명} and {공지번호} sit in a small top administrative strip, {공지 제목} occupies the upper headline area, three centered information boxes fill the main middle area, and a realistic footer contains a compact price-change table, address, contact, and a small QR-guide block.
- Background treatment: ivory paper surface with subtle warm paper fiber texture, thin brown border lines, muted-red accent labels, faint receipt-like perforation marks, and small stationery-style corner tape details.
- Spacing and framing: strong symmetrical alignment, premium retail grid, centered main hierarchy, with fine divider rules, small icons, and realistic shop-notice microcopy integrated around the main information.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Administrative strip (top 8%): Place {매장명} at top-left, {공지번호} and {작성일} at top-right in small but legible type, separated by a thin warm-brown rule.
2. Header zone (upper 18%): Place {공지 제목} centered in a large bold headline, with a muted-red capsule label reading “PRICE UPDATE NOTICE” above or below it.
3. Detail zone (middle 42%): Arrange exactly three equally sized information boxes in a vertical stack with even gaps; each box contains a small calendar/check/notice icon on the left, a short muted-red label, and one main line for {시행일}, {변경 내용}, and {안내 문구}.
4. Price reference zone (lower middle 18%): Add a compact comparison table titled “주요 변경 품목” with three rows: {품목1} {이전가1} → {변경가1}, {품목2} {이전가2} → {변경가2}, {품목3} {이전가3} → {변경가3}; use fine dividers and small won symbols.
5. Footer zone (bottom 14%): Include {주소}, {문의전화}, {운영시간}, a small “자세한 내용은 직원에게 문의해 주세요” note, a simple QR placeholder labeled {큐알라벨}, and a subtle spine-like side credit reading {하단크레딧} along the left edge.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {공지 제목} at large poster scale, Pretendard SemiBold for labels and table headers, and Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium for body lines; all Korean text crisp, evenly spaced, and highly legible.
- Color palette: ivory #F7F1E6 base, muted red #B8645D accent, warm brown #7A5A45 lines, soft beige #E8DDCF panels, charcoal #2F2A28 text, pale cream highlight #FBF7EF.
- Border/shadow: thin 1.5px brown outline, soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity on each information box, light inner panel strokes, no harsh bevel.
- Graphic details: small calendar icon, notice pin icon, checkmark icon, thin table dividers, tiny receipt-number marks, corner tape shapes, and QR placeholder should feel printed on the same poster, not pasted randomly.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing flat graphic poster composition, simulated as a clean editorial layout rather than a photo; if rendered as a mockup, use a 50mm lens look with perfectly parallel framing.
- Lighting: even studio top light with zero directional glare, controlled soft diffusion to keep text edges sharp and paper texture subtle.
- Color grade: warm ivory base with muted red and brown accents, slightly desaturated premium stationery tone.

[6. MOOD]
Formal and respectful store announcement — like a premium café or boutique retail notice board photographed for a Kinfolk-style editorial spread, with practical shop details and a sincere customer-facing tone.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “{매장명}”, “{공지번호}”, “{작성일}”, “{공지 제목}”, “{시행일}”, “{변경 내용}”, “{안내 문구}”, “{품목1}”, “{이전가1}”, “{변경가1}”, “{품목2}”, “{이전가2}”, “{변경가2}”, “{품목3}”, “{이전가3}”, “{변경가3}”, “{주소}”, “{문의전화}”, “{운영시간}”, “{큐알라벨}”, “{하단크레딧}” must appear exactly as written and remain fully legible.
- Main layout invariants: exactly three large information boxes in the middle, each with one icon, one short label, and one primary detail line.
- Rendered Korean microcopy must include: “주요 변경 품목”, “자세한 내용은 직원에게 문의해 주세요”, and “PRICE UPDATE NOTICE”.
- The poster must clearly communicate a price-change notice first, with the comparison table and store information supporting the announcement.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, government stamps, or certification marks
- Broken Korean characters, mojibake, or unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity composites or unrelated portrait faces

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean e-commerce shipping information poster, vertical 2:3 UI notice card for product detail pages, mobile sharing, and print insert use.
Realistic polished shopping-mall delivery guide card that feels like a premium printed parcel insert: clear shipping, delivery period, free-shipping, exchange, and return details supported by small commerce UI details, contact cues, and package-inspired decoration.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered vertical poster composition with a strong branded header in the top 20%, four rounded information rows stacked through the middle 60%, and a practical customer-support footer in the bottom 20%.
- White card surface on a pale cool-gray parcel-workspace background with faint packing-paper grain, subtle blue accent lines, tiny adhesive-label motifs, and soft print-like shadows.
- A small generic box icon sits to the left of the main title; add realistic commerce details such as a small order-label strip, barcode area, QR-style square, customer-center line, and decorative divider rules.
- Use {쇼핑몰명}, {출고일}, {배송 기간}, {무료배송}, {교환반품} as the primary rendered Korean text placeholders.
- Include short supporting Korean microcopy such as “배송 안내”, “SHOPPING GUIDE”, “주문 전 꼭 확인해 주세요”, “고객센터 10:00–17:00”, “평일 상담”, “카카오톡 문의”, and “감사합니다” while keeping the four policy rows visually dominant.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 20%): Place a simple outlined box icon on the left, then set {쇼핑몰명} as the large main title in a bold horizontal lockup. Add a smaller subtitle line “배송 안내 · SHOPPING GUIDE” beneath it, plus a tiny date-style label “2026.05 UPDATED” and a slim blue divider separating the header from the rows.
2. Information row 1 (upper-middle 15%): Display a small pill label “출고일” on the left and {출고일} as the main row text inside a rounded white row with a thin blue border, soft shadow, and small sky-blue label accent. Add a tiny parcel-tracking dot icon at the far right.
3. Information row 2 (mid-middle 15%): Display a small pill label “배송 기간” on the left and {배송 기간} as the main row text in the same rounded row style, matching padding, corner radius, border thickness, and row width for consistency. Add a subtle route-line micro icon on the right.
4. Information row 3 (lower-middle 15%): Display a small pill label “무료배송” on the left and {무료배송} as the third row, keeping the same spacing rhythm and slightly inset content alignment. Add a small blue “FREE” tag motif without overpowering the Korean text.
5. Information row 4 (bottom-middle 15%): Display a small pill label “교환·반품” on the left and {교환반품} as the final row, aligned to the same baseline and visual weight as the previous rows. Add a tiny circular arrow icon and a thin separator above the footer.
6. Footer area (bottom 20%): Create a realistic support-and-branding footer with a small barcode block, QR-style square, “고객센터 10:00–17:00”, “평일 상담 · 점심 12:00–13:00”, “@official_shop”, and a short thank-you note “정성껏 포장해 보내드릴게요”. Include tiny page-style text “NOTICE CARD 01” and a light blue rounded stamp-like label “DELIVERY INFO” that is decorative, not an official certification.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Noto Sans KR throughout; title in Bold 800, approx. 48-56px; subtitle and micro labels in SemiBold 600, approx. 18-24px; row text in Medium 500 / Regular 400, approx. 26-30px; footer microcopy approx. 14-18px with strong legibility.
- Color palette: White #FFFFFF card surface; blue #1E90FF accent; soft sky blue #DDF1FF row tint; dark navy #1F2A37 text; light gray #E9EEF5 separators; pale cool gray #F6F9FC outer background; optional warm paper shadow #D9E2EC for realistic printed-card depth.
- Border/shadow: Each row has a soft drop shadow with 5px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity, plus a subtle 1.5px blue border; use rounded corners with a 20-24px radius. Card container may have a larger 28-32px radius, soft edge shadow, and light paper texture.
- Graphic details: Use small line icons, barcode strokes, QR-style block pattern, dotted divider lines, tiny blue corner tabs, and shipping-label fragments to make the card feel like a real e-commerce insert while keeping the hierarchy clear.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat digital graphic design, top-down UI poster rendering, no photographic lens look; add realistic printed-paper texture, soft vector shadows, and tactile packaging-label details within the digital layout.
- Lighting: Even studio-like digital illumination across the entire card with soft contact shadows under the card and rows, gentle paper depth, and crisp UI contrast.
- Color grade: Clean white-and-blue administrative UI palette with premium Korean shopping-app styling, subtle parcel-insert realism, and polished print-ready finishing.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean shopping-app notice card — polished SaaS dashboard UI meets a premium parcel insert included in a carefully packed online order. Friendly, trustworthy, organized, and immediately readable.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: The rendered image must include these exact strings clearly and correctly: "{쇼핑몰명}", "{출고일}", "{배송 기간}", "{무료배송}", "{교환반품}".
- Render supporting Korean text clearly: “배송 안내”, “주문 전 꼭 확인해 주세요”, “고객센터 10:00–17:00”, “평일 상담”, “카카오톡 문의”, “정성껏 포장해 보내드릴게요”.
- Ensure all 4 information rows are evenly spaced, aligned, and fully legible, with the placeholders as the most important content in each row.
- Keep the box icon generic and commerce-related; decorative barcode, QR-style square, tags, and footer contact details should enhance realism without competing with the four policy lines.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
