[1. PURPOSE]
Korean restaurant daily menu board poster for in-store display, vertical 2:3 layout.
Realistic hand-drawn chalkboard-inspired menu board with readable Korean typography, clear pricing hierarchy, and practical customer-facing information for a warm neighborhood bistro.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: centered full-page chalkboard-style board filling the frame, with a narrow warm cream mat margin around all sides and lightly worn edges, as if the sign is mounted inside a cafe near the entrance.
- Background treatment: tactile cream paper over a dark espresso chalkboard surface, visible chalk dust, faint eraser smudges, tiny pin marks, subtle paper fibers, a few hand-drawn divider strokes, and a soft darker vignette toward the edges.
- Spacing and framing: top info block compact and left-to-right balanced, title isolated in the center, menu rows stacked with even spacing and dotted separators, plus small practical micro-copy near the bottom for takeout and pairing guidance.
- Include realistic menu-board details: daily date label, small store credit line, service tags such as “DINE-IN / TAKE OUT”, decorative divider rules, tiny chalk icons for pasta, salad, soup, and wine, address/contact line, and a small footer note.
- Use {매장명}, {영업 시간}, {문의·주소}, {제목}, {메뉴 1}, {메뉴 2}, {메뉴 3}, {추천 페어링}, {컬러 톤} placeholders exactly as content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top section (upper 20%): Place a small ✦ icon and a tiny date label “2026.05.01 FRI · DAILY BOARD” near the top. Render {문의·주소} in the smallest readable text along the very top edge. Below it, render {매장명} in the largest text within this block, then {영업 시간} beneath it in medium-small text. Add small service tags “DINE-IN”, “TAKE OUT”, and “예약 문의” in tiny rounded chalk labels beside the hours. Use clean left alignment within the top block with about 6–8% inset from the paper edge.
2. Center section (middle 20%): Display {제목} as the dominant headline in the center of the poster. Add a short handwritten subtitle under it: “오늘 준비한 재료로 정성껏 만듭니다”. Place a dotted line separator directly underneath spanning about 70% of the board width. Keep the headline visually heavier than every other text element.
3. Menu list section (lower 55%): Arrange four horizontal rows with badge numbers or small labels on the left, item names in the middle, and prices aligned to the right; keep each row separated by dotted dividers for a clean cafeteria board rhythm. Include tiny chalk icons near the labels without covering the Korean text.
   - Row 1: {메뉴 1}
   - Row 2: {메뉴 2}
   - Row 3: {메뉴 3}
   - Row 4: ✦ {추천 페어링}
4. Bottom footer details: Add a narrow footer band with small Korean micro text such as “재료 소진 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다”, “물·피클은 셀프바를 이용해 주세요”, and “Instagram @noeul_table”. Include a small boxed note “오늘의 추천 페어링” connected visually to Row 4, and a tiny chalk-drawn arrow or sparkle for emphasis.
5. Accent details: Add tiny heart accents, stars, short underline strokes, and small hand-drawn ingredient doodles sparingly near corners or between separators, keeping them secondary to the text and not interfering with readability. Use 2–3 small hearts total and a few subtle chalk scuffs for a lived-in handmade sign.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: hand-drawn chalkboard lettering mixed with clean readable display type; use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for {매장명} and {제목}, and Pretendard Medium for body rows; title size large, menu rows medium, info text small. Keep letter spacing slightly expanded for the headline and tighter for the price column.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} translated into cream #F5EBDD, dark brown #3A271B, muted beige #D7C2A3, chalk white #FFF8ED, and tiny heart accents in soft muted red #C96A6A. Add separator dots in a softened brown-gray so they remain visible without overpowering the text.
- Board materials: espresso-brown chalkboard base with cream ink/chalk lettering, muted beige divider ornaments, natural paper fiber texture, chalk dust buildup along dividers, lightly distressed edges, and a soft realistic drop shadow around the board, approximately 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 15% opacity.
- Menu hierarchy: prices should sit in a consistent right-aligned column; item names and descriptions should remain left/middle aligned; small labels and icons should support scanning without competing with the four main rows.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: graphic poster layout, front-facing orthographic composition with no perspective distortion, as if photographed with a 50mm standard lens from straight-on.
- Lighting: soft ambient cafe lighting evenly across the board, slight overhead warm fill and gentle side falloff to preserve chalk texture and legibility; gentle highlights on the paper fibers and chalk dust.
- Color grade: warm cream and dark espresso tones with a restrained vintage cafe finish, similar to a modern neighborhood bistro menu board seen in editorial lifestyle photography.
- Rendering quality: realistic printed-and-chalk surface, crisp Korean glyphs, believable handmade imperfections, tactile ink density variation, and natural shadowing along the mounted board edges.

[6. MOOD]
Warm neighborhood bistro menu board — a Kinfolk-style cafe editorial with handmade chalk signage, practical menu information, cozy service details, and calm everyday charm.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly rendered in Korean: “노을 식당”, “11:00–21:00 (라스트 오더 20:30)”, “010-1234-5678 · 서울 마포구 연남동 123”, “오늘의 메뉴”, “오늘의 파스타 — 토마토 페스토 11,000원”, “오늘의 샐러드 — 시트러스 부라타 9,000원”, “오늘의 스프 — 단호박 크림 6,000원”, “오늘의 와인 — 피노 그리지오 글라스 7,000원”.
- Additional small Korean text may appear clearly, such as “2026.05.01 FRI · DAILY BOARD”, “오늘 준비한 재료로 정성껏 만듭니다”, “재료 소진 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다”, “물·피클은 셀프바를 이용해 주세요”, “예약 문의”, and “오늘의 추천 페어링”.
- Prices must be clearly visible, correctly formatted, and aligned consistently in a right-side price column.
- The four menu rows must remain in the same order and the dotted separators must be present between rows.
- All placeholder anchors must be represented exactly: {매장명}, {영업 시간}, {문의·주소}, {제목}, {메뉴 1}, {메뉴 2}, {메뉴 3}, {추천 페어링}, {컬러 톤}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean SaaS service introduction one-page proposal sheet, vertical 2:3 layout, polished presentation deck style for sales and marketing use.
Designed as a realistic single-page brochure with a strong SaaS hero message, product-context details, feature highlights, audience benefit framing, trust cues, and a conversion-focused CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header zone (about 20%): centered service title and subtitle using {서비스명} as the main hero headline and {한줄 소개} directly beneath it; add a small top metadata bar with “SERVICE OVERVIEW”, “VOL. 01”, “2026.05”, and “세일즈 소개서”.
- Hero detail layer: behind or below the title area, include subtle SaaS dashboard-style UI fragments such as small metric chips, a soft line chart, status badges, and a compact product preview panel, all styled as supporting visual context without overpowering the text.
- Middle content zone (about 48%): three evenly spaced feature cards in a horizontal row, each card containing one concise item from {핵심 기능}, a clear thin-line icon above the text, a small numbered label “FEATURE 01 / 02 / 03”, and a short Korean micro-caption such as “업무 흐름 개선”, “데이터 기반 관리”, “빠른 도입 지원”.
- Bottom zone (about 22%): a short audience-focused explanation for {대상 고객} on the left, a prominent CTA button labeled {CTA} on the right, plus realistic brochure footer details including “도입 문의”, “contact@service.co.kr”, “www.service.co.kr”, and a small QR-code placeholder box.
- Background should be premium white with layered cool-gray and soft green-gray panels, thin divider lines, section labels, tiny page/footer marks, and practical sales-deck details that make the sheet feel like a real SaaS one-pager.
- Use {컬러 톤} as the visual direction for all accents, cards, icon strokes, dashboard chips, section markers, and CTA emphasis.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title block: place {서비스명} in very large bold type at the top center, with strong visual weight and refined letter spacing for a premium SaaS proposal look.
- Subtitle block: position {한줄 소개} directly under the title in smaller text, spanning 70–80% of the page width, aligned center, with relaxed line height for easy reading.
- Metadata strip: at the very top, align small text labels “SERVICE OVERVIEW”, “VOL. 01”, “2026년 5월”, and “One-page Proposal” with thin dividers and a small document code like “DOC-SaaS-247”.
- Product preview elements: include a soft rectangular dashboard preview area with realistic UI details such as “활성 사용자 12,480”, “자동화율 78%”, “이번 달 리포트”, a simple line graph, progress bars, and tiny status dots, rendered as decorative supporting content.
- Feature card row: split {핵심 기능} into exactly 3 separate cards with equal width; each card should contain one feature, one thin-line icon, a numbered feature label, and a short supportive caption, all centered with balanced spacing.
- Audience summary block: near the lower left, set a concise 1–2 line explanation aimed at {대상 고객}, framed as a benefit statement rather than a paragraph; add a small label “추천 대상” above it.
- CTA block: place {CTA} as a rounded rectangular button in the lower right, visually stronger than surrounding text, with clear padding and high contrast; below or beside it, add small text “무료 상담 · 데모 요청 가능”.
- Supporting structure: use a professional editorial grid with consistent gutters, visible section hierarchy, document footer, page number “01”, and subtle divider rules separating headline, features, and closing action.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard for the entire layout; title in Bold 54–64px, subtitle in Medium 24–28px, body in Regular 20–24px, CTA in SemiBold 24–28px, metadata/footer text in 12–16px with high legibility.
- Color palette: white #FFFFFF, deep green #123B2A, soft green-gray #EAF1EC, lime accent #B7E35A, charcoal #1F2A24.
- Border/shadow: feature cards with 1px soft green-gray border, 12px corner radius, subtle drop shadow 0px 6px 18px rgba(18,59,42,0.10); CTA button with slightly stronger shadow and solid deep green fill.
- Icon style: thin-line monochrome icons with consistent stroke width, simple and readable, no 3D effects.
- Brochure details: add small section tags, thin rules, metric pills, dashboard labels, QR placeholder, contact/footer line, and a refined document-number treatment using the same green and lime palette.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: straight-on flat design presentation, as if captured with a 50mm equivalent product layout view, no perspective distortion, accurately aligned document edges.
- Lighting: studio-clean even illumination with soft diffuse front light feel, crisp contrast on text, icons, cards, and dashboard UI details.
- Color grade: clean white + deep green + lime accent, slightly cool and modern with subtle editorial clarity.
- Finish: premium printed-sales-sheet look with delicate shadows, tactile card surfaces, crisp vector UI elements, and realistic SaaS marketing collateral density.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean SaaS proposal deck — refined consulting-brochure feel with modern product UI cues, confident sales collateral energy, and a polished B2B presentation atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시해야 하는 문구 — "{서비스명}", "{한줄 소개}", "{핵심 기능}", "{대상 고객}", "{CTA}".
- Additional Korean text must be crisp and readable, including “서비스 소개서”, “추천 대상”, “도입 문의”, “무료 상담 · 데모 요청 가능”, “활성 사용자 12,480”, “자동화율 78%”, “이번 달 리포트”.
- Feature cards must be exactly 3, no more and no less.
- Layout must remain a vertical 2:3 single-page service intro sheet with clear hierarchy and a realistic brochure composition.
- All Korean text should be large, crisp, and fully legible; no broken Hangul, no clipped characters, no unreadable dense paragraphs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical 2:3 fashion lookbook cover for a seasonal collection, designed like a premium Korean magazine cover with strong typographic hierarchy, realistic editorial photography, and authentic cover-production details.
High-end fashion editorial layout for social sharing and brand presentation, enriched with issue metadata, short feature blurbs, barcode area, credits, and seasonal collection cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The central fashion subject occupies about 58% of the frame height, with the head and upper torso aligned slightly above center for a polished cover composition.
- Place {브랜드명} at the top as the primary masthead, with {시즌명} and {메인 카피} stacked near the bottom in a strong cover-line hierarchy.
- Main subject should be dressed in {대표 아이템}, rendered crisply so the garment silhouette, stitching, textile weave, seams, buttons, and fabric texture are easy to read.
- Background should feel like a premium editorial studio set in {컬러 팔레트}: soft seamless paper or lightly textured wall, subtle floor contact shadow, tonal panels, and refined seasonal styling elements that support the fashion story.
- Add realistic magazine-cover details: issue number 'VOL.247', date label '2026년 5월호', small price text '₩12,000', barcode area at lower right, 2–3 short Korean feature headline blurbs, small spine/credit text, and model-name credit.
- Keep the layout tall and elegant with balanced editorial spacing, ensuring the subject, masthead, cover lines, and product details all remain readable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone (top 12%): set {브랜드명} in a refined editorial masthead, centered or slightly left-aligned, with strong visual weight. Add small metadata nearby: 'LOOKBOOK ISSUE', 'VOL.247', '2026년 5월호'.
- Upper side cover-line zone: place 2–3 short Korean feature blurbs around the subject without covering the outfit, such as '봄의 레이어링', '새로운 실루엣', '매일 입는 구조'. Use compact editorial typography and subtle accent rules in {컬러 팔레트}.
- Main hero zone (middle 58%): place a model or product shot wearing {대표 아이템} as the focal point, sharply lit and separated from the background, with realistic fabric detail, natural posture, believable styling, and a premium fashion-shoot presence matching {무드}.
- Background field: use a refined studio backdrop in {컬러 팔레트}, with soft paper texture, gentle tonal panels, faint surface grain, natural floor shadow, and subtle seasonal set pieces such as a folded fabric swatch, translucent acrylic block, or slim metal stand placed away from key text.
- Bottom caption zone (bottom 18%): place {시즌명} above {메인 카피}, both aligned with neat spacing and a premium magazine-cover look. Add a small model credit line such as 'MODEL 김서윤  STYLING EDITOR 박하린' beneath or beside the main copy.
- Lower production zone: include a barcode box at the lower right with tiny numerals, a small website-style line such as 'brand.kr / collection preview', and a slim vertical spine text along one edge reading '{브랜드명}  {시즌명}  LOOKBOOK'.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the brand name, and Pretendard Medium or Noto Sans KR Regular for supporting lines; header size should feel like 64–84px equivalent, bottom text 34–48px equivalent, feature blurbs 20–30px equivalent, with clean letter spacing and sharp anti-aliased edges.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} should dominate, with off-white as the base and sky blue / silver gray used as restrained accents; keep primary text in deep charcoal or near-black for contrast, and use accent color for issue labels, thin divider rules, and small editorial tags.
- Cover information styling: issue number, date, price, barcode numerals, model credit, and feature blurbs should look professionally typeset, proportionate, and integrated into the magazine cover rather than pasted on.
- Border/shadow: avoid heavy borders; if needed, use a very soft drop shadow under the subject only, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, to preserve a magazine-cover finish.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame fashion editorial photo, shot on a Sony A7R V with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow background separation but enough depth to keep the outfit readable.
- Lighting: clean soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with a subtle fill from the right and gentle shadow modeling for a fresh catalog-cover look.
- Color grade: cool off-white base with sky blue and silver gray accents, slightly desaturated editorial grade, crisp whites, realistic skin tone, preserved garment color, and controlled highlights.
- Material realism: emphasize textile texture, garment edges, collar shape, cuffs, fasteners, stitching, layered styling, natural hair detail, subtle makeup, and realistic contact shadows on the studio floor.

[6. MOOD]
Premium fashion editorial with a modern Korean magazine sensibility — polished, seasonal, confident, and refined, expressing {무드} through styling, pose, typography, and the {컬러 팔레트} atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함:
  - {브랜드명}
  - {시즌명}
  - {메인 카피}
- Additional Korean cover text should be sharp and plausible, including: 'VOL.247', '2026년 5월호', '봄의 레이어링', '새로운 실루엣', '매일 입는 구조', 'MODEL 김서윤'.
- Clothing must be clearly visible and the outfit color/material should not be washed out.
- Model face and hands must be anatomically correct, with natural proportions and no extra fingers.
- Title text, masthead, issue text, feature blurbs, barcode numerals, and credits must be sharp, legible, and free of distortion.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-1128.content:
[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
세로 2:3 비율의 쇼핑몰 상세페이지용 상품 사이즈 가이드 시트. 상단 브랜드 헤더, 중앙 제품 측정 도식, 하단 실측 표와 구매 안내를 결합한 프리미엄 이커머스 정보형 인포그래픽.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header occupies about 16% of the frame: {브랜드명} 로고타입 느낌의 텍스트, {상품명}, “SIZE GUIDE”를 계층적으로 배치하고, 우측에 {업데이트일} / {상품코드} 작은 메타 정보를 넣는다.
- Center hero area takes about 42%: front-view garment diagram with {아이콘스타일}, measurement arrows, dotted guide lines, small circular anchor markers, and subtle fabric swatch chips for {소재정보}.
- A narrow info strip below the diagram shows “FIT: {핏안내}”, “MODEL: {모델정보}”, “FABRIC: {소재정보}” as three compact cards with mint highlights.
- Bottom table area fills about 32%: {사이즈범위} and {측정항목} arranged in a crisp comparison table with realistic numeric sample values in cm, clear column headers, alternating pale-gray row fills, and navy divider lines.
- Lower footer area includes customer support details: {고객센터}, {쇼핑몰주소}, a small QR-code style square labeled “사이즈 상담”, and a short note “측정 위치에 따라 1–2cm 오차가 있을 수 있습니다.”
- Use {표색상} as the main palette, adding a faint woven-paper texture, product-measuring tape ticks along one side edge, and small line icons that support the guide-sheet function.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone: render “{브랜드명}” at the top-left in small caps style, “{상품명}” as the main Korean title, and “SIZE GUIDE” beneath it; add “UPDATED {업데이트일}” and “SKU {상품코드}” as small right-aligned metadata.
2. Diagram zone: place a simplified front-view product outline in the center, showing measurement arrows and markers with {아이콘스타일}; callouts should point to body length, shoulder width, chest width, sleeve length, and hem width when relevant.
3. Measurement labels: add Korean labels from {측정항목} around the diagram with thin leader lines, numbered dots ① ② ③ ④, and small cm badges so the viewer can connect each label to the table.
4. Fit and material strip: create three compact cards reading “핏 안내: {핏안내}”, “소재: {소재정보}”, “모델 정보: {모델정보}”, separated by mint dividers and small product-care icons.
5. Table zone: create a realistic size chart using {사이즈범위} as size labels and {측정항목} as column headers; include readable Korean headings such as “사이즈”, “총장”, “어깨너비”, “가슴단면”, “소매길이”, and plausible values like 69, 52, 58, 57.
6. Footer guidance: place “측정 방법 안내”, “단위: cm”, “구매 전 실측 사이즈를 확인해 주세요”, {고객센터}, and {쇼핑몰주소} in a structured footer with a small QR-code style block and divider rule.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; title in Bold 34–40px, section labels in SemiBold 18–22px, table text in Regular 16–18px, metadata in Medium 12–14px.
- Color palette: follow {표색상}; recommended colors are warm white #FAFAF7, navy #1F3A5F, mint #8EDCC8, light gray #E9EEF3, charcoal #222222, and soft beige #F3EFE7 for background texture.
- Borders and dividers: thin 1–2px navy rules, rounded 8–12px info cards, alternating table row fills, subtle shadow like 0 2px 8px rgba(31,58,95,0.08) for layered retail-catalog realism.
- Graphic details: include measuring tape ticks, tiny scissor/ruler/laundry line icons, fabric swatch chips, QR-style square, and small caption labels without overwhelming table readability.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean flat graphic layout, as if designed in a high-resolution editorial infographic system; orthographic front-facing composition with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: evenly lit studio-like catalog presentation with soft, controlled shadows on cards and table blocks.
- Color grade: crisp neutral whites with navy and mint accents, slightly cool ecommerce catalog tone, with subtle warm paper texture for a realistic printed detail-page feel.

[6. MOOD]
Premium ecommerce specification sheet — Muji product guide meets Nordstrom-style clean retail infographic, with practical Korean shopping-mall detail-page realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “{브랜드명}”, “{상품명}”, “SIZE GUIDE”, “{사이즈범위}”, “{측정항목}”, “{핏안내}”, “{소재정보}”, “{모델정보}”, “{고객센터}”, “{쇼핑몰주소}” must be clearly readable and correctly rendered.
- Include realistic rendered Korean labels such as “사이즈”, “총장”, “어깨너비”, “가슴단면”, “소매길이”, “단위: cm”, “측정 방법 안내”, “구매 전 실측 사이즈를 확인해 주세요”, “측정 위치에 따라 1–2cm 오차가 있을 수 있습니다.”
- The product diagram must remain schematic and practical, with arrows, numbered dots, and measurement callouts visually connected to the table.
- Table lines, numbers, QR-style 상담 박스, footer contact text, and SKU/date metadata must be crisp and neatly aligned.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul
- Unreadable measurement tables, distorted numbers, or mismatched size labels
- Celebrity composites / identity confusion

studio:prompts3:ours-1127.content:
[INPUT]
- title: 릴스 커버 6종 세트
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean Reels cover set, 6-panel grid, vertical 2:3 layout for social media feed thumbnails.
Designed to be instantly legible on mobile, with a unified template repeated across all 6 covers and realistic Reels-series metadata that makes the set feel ready to publish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The canvas is split into a strict 2 columns x 3 rows grid, with equal panel sizes, consistent gutters, and visible separator lines so each tile reads as an individual Reels cover.
- Each panel contains one large keyword from {커버키워드목록} centered as the main focal point, paired with a short supporting caption from {보조문구목록} underneath or beside the title.
- Top information band: repeat {공통배지}, {에피소드범위}, {게시월}, and {계정핸들} as compact editorial metadata across all panels, with the exact episode number changing per tile.
- Bottom social band: repeat {채널명} · {시리즈명}, {CTA문구}, {해시태그}, plus tiny save/share/comment micro icons to mimic a real social content card.
- Background treatment uses {배경톤} as the dominant palette, enhanced with {장식요소}: diagonal color blocks, sticker tabs, neon arrows, highlighter underlines, dots, cropped oversized numerals, and small UI-like labels.
- Keep all six panels visually consistent in structure while allowing each tile to have a slightly different accent placement, title break, and graphic rhythm so the collection feels designed rather than duplicated.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Panel layout for all 6 covers: top badge strip, episode/date/handle micro line, large central keyword, secondary caption, lower channel line, CTA row, and social micro-icon row.
- Episode sequence: label the six panels as EP.01, EP.02, EP.03, EP.04, EP.05, EP.06, matching the order of {커버키워드목록}.
- Main keyword zone: set each keyword as the largest text element, occupying about 40–50% of the panel height, with bold stacked Korean typography and strong line breaks when needed.
- Supporting caption zone: place one short caption from {보조문구목록} near the main keyword inside a small tag, speech-bubble strip, or highlighter label.
- Badge zone: place {공통배지} at the top of every panel inside a small rectangular label with crisp edges, identical sizing, and aligned baselines across the grid.
- Metadata zone: include {게시월}, {계정핸들}, and the current episode number as small but readable text; use a magazine-like numbering system such as 01/06, 02/06, 03/06.
- Footer zone: repeat {채널명} · {시리즈명} at the bottom of every panel, followed by {CTA문구} and {해시태그} in smaller type.
- Social detail zone: add tiny drawn icons for 저장, 공유, 댓글, 하트, and a small progress indicator bar, keeping them secondary to the title but visible enough to add feed-native realism.
- Grid consistency: maintain identical panel proportions, baseline alignment, and typographic hierarchy so the six covers appear as a matched collection.
- Contrast treatment: alternate black-base and white-base panels within the {배경톤} family, using neon green for arrows, labels, page numbers, underlines, and key emphasis marks.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {폰트느낌}; use bold Korean gothic style similar to Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for the main keyword, compact badge text in Pretendard SemiBold, and footer/metadata text in Pretendard Medium.
- Title design: use oversized thumbnail-readable lettering, tight tracking, punchy line breaks, occasional outlined text layers, neon shadow offsets, and sticker-like label backgrounds behind short words.
- Color palette: black #0B0B0B, white #FFFFFF, neon green #B6FF2E, deep gray #1A1A1A, with the {배경톤} palette driving every tile.
- Graphic accents: use {장식요소} as a repeated system across the set; vary their placement per panel while keeping the same visual language.
- Border/shadow: thin 1–2px panel separators in white or neon green, hard-edged drop shadows under title blocks, subtle glow on neon arrows and episode chips, and crisp sticker shadows behind caption tags.
- Real social-card texture: include tiny UI marks, small save/share labels, hashtag snippets, and micro progress bars that feel like a planned Instagram/Reels publishing template.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: graphic poster layout, top-down flat design look, no photography lens distortion; if rendered as a design mockup, use a clean orthographic presentation with sharp vector edges.
- Lighting: high-contrast studio-style design lighting impression, crisp highlights against deep blacks, hard-edged graphic shadows, bright neon accent glow, and strong readability at thumbnail scale.
- Color grade: black-and-white editorial base with neon green punch accents, clean digital contrast, slightly punchy and poster-like.

[6. MOOD]
Bold social-first motion-poster aesthetic — high-impact Korean editorial thumbnail set inspired by modern digital campaign graphics, creator education reels, and feed-native typography systems.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 각 위치에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - 공통 배지: ‘릴스 시리즈’
  - 채널명: ‘오늘의 마케팅’
  - 시리즈명: ‘1분 광고 레슨’
  - 계정 핸들: ‘@오늘의마케팅’
  - 게시월: ‘2026년 5월’
  - CTA: ‘저장하고 따라하기’
  - 해시태그: ‘#마케팅팁 #릴스공부 #광고레슨’
- Six panel text mapping must be clear and legible:
  - EP.01 ‘후킹’ / ‘첫 3초에 멈추게’
  - EP.02 ‘썸네일’ / ‘작게 봐도 크게’
  - EP.03 ‘카피’ / ‘한 줄로 설득’
  - EP.04 ‘타깃’ / ‘누구에게 말할까’
  - EP.05 ‘전환’ / ‘클릭을 행동으로’
  - EP.06 ‘체크리스트’ / ‘올리기 전 6가지’
- Layout invariants: the image must clearly read as 6 separate Reels covers in a 2x3 grid, all panels following the same template logic, with each keyword large enough to read on a mobile feed.
- Render realistic social details: small 저장, 공유, 댓글, 하트 icons, 01/06 style page indicators, neon arrows, caption tags, and repeated footer metadata should be visible but secondary to the main keyword.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, government marks, certification stamps, or award emblems
- Broken Korean characters, misspelled Hangul, garbled typography, or unreadable text
- Celebrity, politician, or real-person composite imagery unless explicitly requested

studio:prompts3:ours-1126.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean bakery opening-soon teaser poster, vertical 2:3 promotional print layout for a neighborhood storefront announcement.
Realistic editorial advertising poster for a neighborhood bakery cafe opening, with tactile paper texture, warm bakery-inspired graphics, event details, and polished Korean retail design.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main headline zone: large centered "OPEN SOON" typography occupies the upper-mid 26–30% of the frame, with {브랜드명} placed directly beneath it as the secondary brand line.
- Supporting info block: {업종}, {오픈일}, {위치}, and "{티저 문구}" arranged as a clear stacked text group in the lower half of the poster, enriched with opening-week details and small caption labels.
- Background treatment: warm cream printed-paper surface with visible paper fiber, subtle ink texture, faint bakery patterning, soft edge wear, and a realistic printed-poster feel.
- Visual accents: include tasteful bakery-related line illustrations such as a croissant, baguette, wheat stem, butter cube, steam curl, or bread crumb pattern, integrated around the headline and event blocks without overpowering the typography.
- Poster information details: add a small top label like "YEONNAM BAKERY TEASER / VOL.01", a date badge, a tiny QR-code placeholder area, a sponsor/friends line, and micro footer text to make the poster feel like a real printed opening announcement.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top area (upper 16–18%): include a small label strip reading "NEW IN TOWN" and "TEASER POSTER VOL.01", plus a tiny bakery icon or wheat illustration aligned with the poster grid.
- Main title area (mid 30%): set "OPEN SOON" in bold high-contrast type, with {브랜드명} directly below in a slightly smaller but still prominent style; keep both lines centered and visually dominant.
- Feature teaser area: add 2–3 short Korean blurbs around the headline or beneath the brand line, such as "매일 굽는 식사빵", "버터 향 가득한 오전", and "동네 산책길에 만나는 한 조각".
- Supporting area (lower-mid 28%): place {업종}, {오픈일}, and {위치} as aligned text lines with clear hierarchy, then add "{티저 문구}" as the warm closing line.
- Event detail block: include realistic opening information in Korean, such as "오픈 주간 08:00–20:00", "첫 주말 시식 11:00–15:00", "선착순 작은 쿠키 증정", and "예약 없이 방문 가능".
- Sponsor / contact footer: include a small footer area with "WITH FRIENDS: 연남 로스터스 · 버터공방", "문의 @noah_bakery", a tiny QR-code placeholder labeled "MAP & NEWS", and a short address-style line using {위치}.
- Decorative structure: use thin dividers, small corner registration marks, soft rounded labels, bread-stamp style shapes, and subtle paper tape or pin-shadow details to make the poster feel physically printed and ready for a storefront window.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main English headline, Pretendard SemiBold for {브랜드명}, and Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium for the Korean details; headline size should be large and poster-dominant, detail text noticeably smaller but fully readable.
- Color palette: build the poster around {컬러 톤}, with paper cream #F6F1E6, butter yellow #F2D97B, deep brown #4A2E20, soft warm gray #A89B8C, and small toasted caramel accents #B9793F.
- Layout treatment: create a refined editorial grid with stacked information blocks, boxed date labels, small caption text, and decorative dividers; balance typography with bakery graphics and realistic print texture.
- Border/shadow: use a soft printed-edge border, subtle paper shadow, or gentle drop shadow 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity on selected labels or illustrations for tactile depth.
- Graphic details: add light halftone grain, tiny ink speckles, bakery-stamp motifs, and delicate line art; all decorative elements should support the opening-soon message and keep the text hierarchy clear.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic straight-on poster photograph inspired by a 50mm normal-lens product-ad layout, shot as if with a Canon EOS R5 and RF 50mm f/1.2L, front-facing with very low distortion and crisp typography.
- Lighting: even soft daylight through a north-facing window, with gentle paper texture visibility, mild edge shadow, and no harsh glare over text.
- Color grade: warm cream + butter yellow + dark espresso brown, with subdued contrast, lightly muted saturation, and a cozy bakery storefront atmosphere.
- Material realism: the poster should look like high-quality matte paper with printed ink, slight paper grain, tiny imperfections, and believable physical presence.

[6. MOOD]
Warm Korean neighborhood cafe opening teaser — refined editorial bakery poster with cozy anticipation, freshly baked bread cues, and a polished local-shop launch feeling reminiscent of a Kinfolk-style food feature and a boutique bakery window announcement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and be fully legible: "노아 베이커리", "동네 베이커리 카페", "2026. 05. 18", "연남동 골목 2층", "따뜻한 빵 냄새로 곧 만나요".
- The poster must keep a clear hierarchy with the English headline "OPEN SOON", then {브랜드명}, then the Korean details and opening-week information below.
- Include realistic poster text additions in Korean, such as "오픈 주간 08:00–20:00", "첫 주말 시식 11:00–15:00", "선착순 작은 쿠키 증정", "문의 @noah_bakery", and "MAP & NEWS" near a tiny QR-code placeholder.
- All Korean and English text must be crisp, correctly spaced, fully legible, and free of broken Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-1125.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a vertical 2:3 FAQ 안내 카드 for mobile reading, with a polished 2x2 grid layout and clear information hierarchy.
The design should feel like a real app help-center card news slide: content-rich, branded, scannable, and ready to post on Instagram Stories or a service onboarding page.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header area occupies about 18% of the canvas, with a small help-center label, slide indicator, and the title centered and visually dominant.
- Main content area uses a 2x2 card grid occupying the middle 70–72% of the frame, with even gutters, balanced padding, and visually consistent card proportions.
- Each card should have rounded corners, consistent padding, a Q badge, a short question, a concise answer, and small supporting micro-details such as category tags or tiny line icons.
- Use {서비스명}, {질문 1}, {답변 1}, {질문 2}, {답변 2}, and two short example FAQ items for the remaining cards.
- Background should be a refined light surface with subtle tone separation from the cards, faint geometric UI patterns, soft gradients, and {컬러 톤} as the main palette direction.
- Add realistic card-news details: small page indicator “01/04”, top label “HELP CENTER”, bottom CTA text in Korean, tiny share/save-style icons, and a footer line with service/contact microcopy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area: Place the title "{서비스명} FAQ" large and centered near the top, with strong contrast and a simple informational tone.
- Above or near the title, add a small rounded label reading “HELP CENTER” and a compact Korean sublabel such as “자주 묻는 질문 안내”.
- Add a small slide/page indicator near the upper-right: “01/04”.
- Grid row 1, left card: Show a small Q icon at the top-left, then {질문 1} as the question line and {답변 1} below it in smaller type; add a tiny tag like “기본 안내”.
- Grid row 1, right card: Show a small Q icon at the top-left, then {질문 2} as the question line and {답변 2} below it in smaller type; add a tiny tag like “이용 팁”.
- Grid row 2, left card: Add a short example FAQ about 배송, matching the same visual pattern. Use natural Korean text such as “배송은 얼마나 걸리나요?” and “평균 2–3일 내 순차적으로 도착해요.”
- Grid row 2, right card: Add a short example FAQ about 문의 or 이용 방법, matching the same visual pattern. Use natural Korean text such as “문의는 어디서 하나요?” and “앱 내 채팅 또는 고객센터에서 확인해요.”
- All four cards must align to the same grid system, with equal card size, equal corner radius, consistent text hierarchy, and matching Q badge placement.
- Bottom footer: include a slim CTA bar or caption line reading “더 궁금한 점은 고객센터에서 확인해 주세요” plus tiny micro icons for save/share/bookmark style UI.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; title in Bold 44–52px, question lines in SemiBold 24–28px, answer lines in Regular 18–22px, micro labels in Medium 12–15px.
- Use the palette direction from {컬러 톤}; recommended accents are white, cobalt blue #245BFF, light gray #EEF2F7, and dark slate text for readability.
- Card styling: rounded corners 22–28px, thin border 1px in pale gray, soft drop shadow with 0px x-offset, 8px y-offset, 24px blur, 10% opacity.
- Q icon: simple solid circle or outlined badge, cobalt blue fill or stroke, consistent across all cards, paired with tiny line icons such as truck, chat bubble, user guide, or check mark where appropriate.
- Add subtle UI realism: faint background grid dots, translucent gradient blobs, tiny footer metadata, and small divider lines, while keeping the FAQ text clear and readable.
- Maintain a polished mobile-card-news layout with crisp alignment, practical spacing, and high-resolution export quality.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean front-facing graphic layout, as if designed in Figma and rendered as a high-resolution social media template, no photographic perspective distortion.
- Lighting: flat digital presentation with subtle depth from layered shadows, gentle highlight edges on cards, and soft ambient separation between background and cards.
- Color grade: bright white base with cobalt blue UI accents and cool light-gray surfaces, crisp and modern.
- Texture/detail: very subtle paper-like grain or soft screen-render texture on the background, plus delicate geometric UI patterns that support the help-center theme.

[6. MOOD]
Modern product-help editorial — a trustworthy mobile FAQ card news design with the clarity of Apple support pages, the friendliness of a service onboarding screen, and the practical polish of a Korean app help center.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{서비스명} FAQ", "{질문 1}", "{답변 1}", "{질문 2}", "{답변 2}"
- Include short Korean support details such as “자주 묻는 질문 안내”, “01/04”, “기본 안내”, “이용 팁”, “배송은 얼마나 걸리나요?”, “평균 2–3일 내 순차적으로 도착해요.”, “문의는 어디서 하나요?”, “앱 내 채팅 또는 고객센터에서 확인해요.”
- Bottom CTA must be short and natural in Korean: “더 궁금한 점은 고객센터에서 확인해 주세요”
- The remaining two cards must contain short, natural Korean example FAQ text about 배송 and 문의, with no broken characters.
- Keep all answers short, direct, and clearly informational, not like legal terms or long policy paragraphs.

[1. PURPOSE]

Create a content-rich informational card for a household appliance product, with a bold title, practical checklist center block, shopping-guide metadata, small editorial labels, recommendation and warning areas, and a clear bottom CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: 2:3 vertical card, top header occupies about 20%, center checklist block 54%, bottom recommendation + warning + CTA area 26%.
- Title area: large centered headline across the top with strong hierarchy, supported by small guide metadata such as “SMART BUY GUIDE”, “VOL.1124”, “2026.05 업데이트”, and a page indicator “01 / 05”.
- Header details: add a small category pill reading “구매가이드”, a short subline such as “비교 전 필수 확인”, and tiny editor credit text like “에디터 쇼핑연구소 · @smartbuy.kr”.
- Center block: a realistic checklist panel with 5 items, each row aligned left with a square checkbox icon, short supporting microcopy, small dividers, and occasional tiny labels such as “필수”, “비교”, “AS”, “설치”, “전기료”.
- Bottom area: three stacked elements — {추천 대상} as a small label line, {주의 문구} in a caution-style strip, and {CTA} as a button-like rectangle with a right-arrow.
- Add realistic card-news details: small save/share micro icons near the lower edge, a tiny “저장하고 매장에서 확인” note, slide/page marker “1/5”, and a subtle QR/barcode-style block or serial line as a decorative retail guide detail.
- Background treatment: real printed card or digital shopping guide surface on warm off-white matte paper, with fine paper grain, subtle grid texture, tactile panel layering, realistic shadows, and crisp mobile-readable typography.
- Use {상품군}, {체크포인트}, {추천 대상}, {주의 문구}, {강조 색상}, {CTA} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header band (top 20%): place the title “{상품군} 구매 전 CHECKLIST” in a bold, high-contrast masthead style, centered, with tight but readable tracking and a confident divider line beneath. Include nearby Korean metadata: “SMART BUY GUIDE”, “VOL.1124”, “2026.05 업데이트”, “구매가이드”, and “01 / 05”.
2. Checklist panel (middle 54%): convert {체크포인트} into about 5 evenly spaced rows. Each row should include a small square checkbox icon on the left, bold key terms, a short readable phrase, and a subtle secondary note line where useful; keep each item instantly scannable.
3. Accent system: apply {강조 색상} to checkbox fills, section tags, page indicator, divider accents, important keywords, and CTA edge details, while keeping the main body text black or near-black for maximum readability.
4. Practical shopping details: integrate small guide-style labels around the checklist such as “설치 전 확인”, “비교표 기준”, “구매 메모”, and a tiny note “체크한 항목은 매장 상담 시 보여주세요” without overpowering the main list.
5. Recommendation line (lower section): show {추천 대상} as a compact supporting sentence in smaller text, aligned to the left within the bottom block, preceded by a small label “추천 대상”.
6. Warning strip: place “{주의 문구}” in a slim highlighted bar or outlined callout, using the accent color sparingly so it reads as a caution note, not a main banner. Add a small alert icon and the Korean label “주의”.
7. CTA button: render {CTA} as a clean rounded rectangle button near the bottom center, with strong contrast, a small right-arrow or chevron icon, and nearby microcopy such as “상세 스펙 비교하기”.
8. Footer micro-area: add tiny but legible editorial/footer details: “@smartbuy.kr”, “저장 · 공유 · 비교”, a small barcode/QR-style rectangle, and “본 체크리스트는 구매 전 참고용입니다”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; title in ExtraBold 42–48px, checklist in SemiBold 24–30px, support text in Regular 18–22px, metadata and footer text in 12–16px.
- Color palette: use {강조 색상} plus neutral white #FFFFFF, warm paper #F7F5EF, charcoal #111111, cool gray #E9ECEF, soft ink gray #6B7280, and a small lime or accent tone only where needed.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px borders on panels, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), subtle rounded corners 16–20px, with realistic layered-card depth.
- Graphic details: include dotted dividers, small label pills, tiny iconography for save/share/check, a light comparison-table motif behind the checklist, and paper texture that remains readable.
- Text density: make the card feel like a useful real buying guide, but keep all major text blocks short, clear, and mobile-readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/2.8 macro, simulated slight top-down editorial product-shot composition of a printed checklist card, while preserving a clean graphic layout suitable for mobile.
- Lighting: soft studio daylight from top-left with gentle card shadow, mild paper grain highlights, and realistic matte surface reflections.
- Color grade: crisp white + black + {강조 색상}, warm retail-paper neutrals, high-legibility contrast, and polished Korean shopping-mall editorial styling.
- Rendering approach: realistic hybrid of printed card-news design and e-commerce infographic, with tactile paper edges, slight depth between panels, and sharp vector-like Korean text.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean shopping guide meets premium household appliance buying checklist: trustworthy, practical, editorial, and easy to save before visiting a store or comparing online. The mood should feel like a polished card-news page from a reliable shopping magazine rather than a bare wireframe.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “{상품군} 구매 전 CHECKLIST”, “{추천 대상}”, “{주의 문구}”, “{CTA}” must appear exactly and legibly.
- Checklist must remain around 5 items and each item must be clearly readable with distinct checkbox icons.
- Preserve simple informational hierarchy: title, checklist, recommendation, warning, CTA.
- Include realistic Korean guide details such as “VOL.1124”, “2026.05 업데이트”, “구매가이드”, “01 / 05”, “저장하고 매장에서 확인”, and “@smartbuy.kr” as small supporting text.
- {강조 색상} must visibly guide the viewer through checkboxes, tags, warning accent, and CTA.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
A vertical 2:3 brand diagnostic report card, designed like a polished consulting summary sheet for social media, investor updates, or pitch decks.
The image should feel like a real premium brand audit card photographed or rendered with tactile editorial detail: readable score badge, compact strength cards, actionable improvement guidance, metadata, small badges, page indicators, and realistic consulting-report microcopy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: centered editorial report grid with a premium printed-card feel; top header occupies about 15% of height, middle score badge 30%, lower insight cards and action box 35%, with footer metadata and page indicator integrated into the remaining space.
- Subject placement: {브랜드명} and {업종} sit in the top header area, the score badge is centered and visually dominant, while the three {강점} cards align in a neat row or stacked compact grid below with small icon badges and category labels.
- Background treatment: paper-like ivory surface with visible matte texture, subtle fibers, faint gray grid lines, warm tonal blocks in {컬러 톤}, light corner registration marks, and realistic printed-report depth.
- Spacing and framing: premium consulting-card layout with aligned edges, consistent corner radii, editorial dividers, small labels, date stamps, report ID, badge chips, and footer details that make the design feel complete and useful.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 15%): place a small monogram-like initials mark at left or centered above the title, then set “{브랜드명} Brand Check” in a bold headline style, with “{업종}” directly underneath as a smaller subtitle. Add realistic metadata such as “BRAND DIAGNOSIS REPORT”, “VOL.1123”, “2026.05”, and “Prepared for {브랜드명}” in small uppercase/Korean microtype.
- Hero score area (middle 30%): place a large circular badge in the center with “{진단 점수}” set in oversized type; use a strong filled circle or ring shape with subtle shadow so it reads as the primary focal point. Around the badge, add small evaluation chips such as “브랜드 선명도”, “고객 기억도”, “콘텐츠 일관성”, and “시장 적합도” as tasteful consulting labels, without turning them into complex charts.
- Strength cards (lower middle 20%): create 3 compact cards for {강점}; each card should have a small label such as “STRENGTH 01”, “STRENGTH 02”, “STRENGTH 03”, a tiny icon or badge, concise spacing, and clear separation, with equal width and consistent borders for a consulting-report feel. Include short supporting Korean microcopy like “핵심 자산”, “고객 반응”, “차별 포인트”.
- Action box (bottom 15%): place {개선 포인트} in a highlighted callout box, designed as one-line action guidance with an arrow, accent bar, or priority tag. Add a small label “NEXT ACTION” and a due-date style note such as “이번 달 우선 실행 과제”.
- Footer and report details: include a realistic footer row with “Page 01 / 03”, “Audit Summary”, “담당 컨설턴트: 브랜드랩”, “검토일: 2026.05.01”, a small QR-code-like placeholder block, and a tiny reference line “내부 진단용 요약 카드”.
- Brand mark treatment: instead of a detailed corporate logo, use a simple monogram-like initials mark based on the brand identity, abstract enough to feel like a report symbol while still matching {브랜드명}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean text, with bold 700–800 weight for the title, medium 500–600 for subtitles, and 600 for score numerals; use 18–28px for body text, 44–72px for the main score, and 10–14px for metadata, footer labels, report IDs, and page indicators.
- Color palette: apply {컬러 톤} as the main palette, with ivory base #F5EFE6, deep brown #3B2A23, muted coral #D97A68, and soft warm gray #D8D1C8 for dividers, badge outlines, tab labels, and card borders.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px borders, rounded 18px cards, subtle inset lines, small tab shapes, and soft drop shadow with 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 16px blur, 12% opacity.
- Graphic details: add tasteful consulting-report elements such as section numbers, small check icons, pill badges, footer rules, micro labels, and certificate-inspired border accents, while keeping all major text readable and hierarchy clear.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic poster composition, simulated as an overhead layout with 50mm equivalent framing and precise design-grid alignment.
- Lighting: diffuse studio light with no harsh directionality, subtle paper texture visibility, gentle shadows along card edges, and crisp contrast so the score badge, Korean text, and metadata remain legible.
- Color grade: warm ivory and espresso base with coral accent highlights, restrained saturation, tactile print texture, and clean editorial contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Premium brand consulting deck — McKinsey-style clarity meets Kinfolk editorial warmth, with the credibility of a real diagnostic report card, subtle award-card polish, and practical social-media readability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 텍스트: “{브랜드명} Brand Check”, “{업종}”, “{진단 점수}”, “{강점}”, “{개선 포인트}”.
- Additional Korean text should be clear and realistic: “브랜드 진단 리포트”, “이번 달 우선 실행 과제”, “핵심 자산”, “고객 반응”, “차별 포인트”, “검토일: 2026.05.01”, “Page 01 / 03”.
- Score badge must be the largest visual element and remain instantly legible.
- The three strength cards must be evenly spaced and visually consistent.
- Use a simple initials mark as the primary brand symbol, not a fake official seal.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Three equal-width comparison cards arranged in a single row across the middle 55–60%, visually identical in size, spacing, and internal hierarchy so comparison feels fair and balanced.
- Use {상품명}, {옵션 1}, {옵션 2}, {옵션 3}, {비교 기준}, {컬러 톤} placeholders throughout the design.
- Add realistic e-commerce helper elements around the cards: small SKU-style label, short Korean guide note, care-icon row, QR/barcode-like product information block, and a bottom legend explaining how to read the material comparison.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header area (top 15%): place the main title "{상품명} 소재 비교" in large Korean type, centered. Above or beside it, include small editorial metadata text such as "SHOPPING DETAIL GUIDE", "VOL.1122", "2026년 5월 업데이트". Beneath the title, add a refined divider line with a tiny centered label "소재별 특징 한눈에 보기".
2) Comparison row (middle 55–60%): create three equal cards from left to right for {옵션 1}, {옵션 2}, {옵션 3}. Each card contains the option name at the top, a realistic material swatch or macro texture sample in the center, a small line icon related to texture/care, and a short Korean summary line at the bottom such as "부드러운 촉감", "탄탄한 조직감", "가벼운 착용감".
3) Criteria block inside each card: represent {비교 기준} using the same three compact icon-label rows or one-line micro bullets in every card, with identical order and layout. Add small visual rating bars or dot indicators beside each criterion, keeping the comparison easy to scan.
4) Card styling: use soft rounded rectangles, thin borders, realistic paper-card shadows, light inner highlights, pinned label tabs, and material color chips. Keep equal padding and matching internal structure for all three material types.
5) Footer area (bottom 10–12%): add a richer shopping-detail legend area with Korean microcopy such as "구매 전 체크", "세탁 및 관리 아이콘", "소재 선택 팁", "상담 문의 10:00–17:00", and a small barcode/QR-like placeholder block labeled "PRODUCT INFO". Include a small note: "실제 색상은 화면 환경에 따라 다를 수 있습니다".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the title and labels; title in Bold 48–60px, card headers in SemiBold 24–30px, supporting text in Regular 18–22px, metadata and footer microcopy in 12–16px.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 톤} with premium clean neutrals; suggested tones such as warm white #FAFAF7, sand beige #DCCBB2, deep green #1F4D3A, soft gray #D9DDD8, muted charcoal #2F3430, and pale cream #F4EFE6.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px borders in muted gray-green, soft drop shadows at 0px 6px 18px with 10–14% opacity, subtle layered paper effects, and gentle accent rules in the selected {컬러 톤}.
- Add decorative but functional infographic details: small numbered tabs "01", "02", "03", material-chip labels, tiny arrow callouts, care symbols, and product-detail annotation lines.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: bright diffuse studio light from above with even fill across the full canvas, gentle paper-card shadows, and soft highlights on texture swatches.
- Color grade: premium e-commerce neutral grade with warm white base, beige accents, deep green emphasis, natural material tones, and clear contrast for titles, labels, ratings, and captions.
- Surface realism: show subtle paper grain, tactile fabric/leather/wood-like swatch details when appropriate, delicate printed ink texture, and realistic card layering while preserving the infographic-first layout.

[6. MOOD]
Premium e-commerce editorial infographic — a refined Korean marketplace product-detail sheet with tactile material samples, practical shopping annotations, and a trustworthy comparison-guide atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{상품명} 소재 비교", "{옵션 1}", "{옵션 2}", "{옵션 3}", "{비교 기준}", "소재별 특징 한눈에 보기", "구매 전 체크", "소재 선택 팁", "실제 색상은 화면 환경에 따라 다를 수 있습니다"
- All 3 option cards must use the exact same internal structure, spacing, card height, card width, rating treatment, and visual hierarchy.
- The comparison must be communicated through three equal cards with matching layouts rather than a dense spreadsheet-style grid.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Portrait 2:3 canvas with the header occupying the top 16%, the calendar grid taking the middle 56%, and the CTA / information area filling the bottom 16%.
- Center the calendar grid as the main object, with clear date spacing, readable weekday labels, and sticker badges placed on selected dates without covering the date numbers.

- Background should be a bright, child-friendly classroom scene based on {배경 무드}: pastel wall, paper craft garlands, small books, crayons, alphabet blocks, soft bulletin-board texture, and rounded playful classroom details that support the academy theme.
- Add realistic printed-card details: slight paper grain, rounded card corners, soft cast shadow, tiny punch-hole sticker accents, small tape tabs, and a faint desk-surface edge so the design feels like a real photographed event card rather than a sterile flat template.

1. Header area (top 16%): Set the title "{매장명} {월} EVENT CALENDAR" in a bold, friendly display style, centered, with a compact two-line hierarchy if needed so the month stays readable. Add a small capsule label above or beside it: "이번 달 클래스 일정" and a tiny issue-style mark such as "VOL. {월}" as decorative fixed text.
2. Main calendar area (middle 56%): Place a monthly grid with Korean weekday labels "월 화 수 목 금 토 일", evenly sized date boxes, thin rounded dividing lines, and small dot markers for ordinary class days. Include realistic calendar notations such as tiny "휴무", "마감", "준비물" labels where appropriate, while keeping all main dates legible.
3. Event highlight layer: Show {주요 이벤트} as exactly three sticker-style badges positioned above or on selected dates, each badge slightly offset from the date number. Make the badges look tactile, with small folded-corner shadows, washi-tape tabs, star / heart / pencil mini icons, and short fixed sublabels like "SPECIAL", "OPEN CLASS", "예약 필수".
4. Decorative background layer: Build the {배경 무드} as a rich illustrated classroom environment with pastel walls, a small cork board, hanging paper flags, toy blocks, art supplies, book spines, childlike doodle shapes, and soft rounded accents. Let the illustration add depth and warmth while keeping the calendar panel readable.
5. Information strip: Under the grid, add a neat row of small info chips: "문의 02-1234-5678", "평일 10:00-18:00", "서울시 우리동네 키즈타운 2F", plus tiny save/share micro icons and a small handle-style text "@kids_class_official".

7. Overall spacing: Maintain a clear vertical rhythm between header, grid, badges, info strip, and CTA. Use layered depth, paper texture, shadows, stickers, and classroom props to make the card feel like a lively real promotional post while preserving readability.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Text hierarchy: Main title and CTA must read first, event badges second, date grid third, and micro-information last.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Realistic photographed printed SNS card aesthetic, captured as a top-down editorial flat-lay with a Canon EOS R5 and RF 50mm f/1.2 lens; keep the graphic design crisp and front-facing with only subtle perspective.

[7. CRITICAL]

- Fixed Korean microcopy may include: "이번 달 클래스 일정", "문의 02-1234-5678", "평일 10:00-18:00", "서울시 우리동네 키즈타운 2F", "선착순 예약", "정원 마감 시 종료", "월 화 수 목 금 토 일".

- Exactly three event badges must be shown for {주요 이벤트}.
- Preserve the 1024x1536 vertical SNS card format and keep {강조 색상} visible as the dominant accent.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean premium mobile wedding invitation hero screen, elegant vertical 2:3 layout, designed for wedding share link / mobile invite landing page.
Create a realistic, content-rich mobile invitation screen with refined typography, layered watercolor botanical artwork, paper texture, subtle app-like UI details, and a polished Korean wedding invitation hierarchy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: top floral motif occupies about 14% of the frame, center names and date block take 38–42%, venue info and invitation message sit below, and a detailed action card row anchors the lower third.
- Background treatment: warm cream paper-like background with visible fine fiber grain, soft watercolor pigment blooms, faint pressed-paper depth, and a subtle ivory-to-cream tonal variation.
- Spacing and framing: centered vertical flow with premium editorial rhythm, balanced left-right symmetry, elegant section dividers, small decorative date chips, and realistic mobile invitation UI density.
- Use {신랑 이름}, {신부 이름}, {예식 일자}, {식장 이름}, {주소}, {컬러 팔레트}, {식물 모티브} placeholders throughout the layout.
- Add tasteful real mobile invite details: a tiny top status-bar style line, “MOBILE INVITATION” label, D-DAY badge, short invitation copy, calendar chip, map preview strip, and subtle footer microtext.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header area (upper 14%): place {식물 모티브} as a soft watercolor-style botanical illustration, lightly arched and airy, with delicate linework, small white blossoms, sage leaves, dusty rose buds, and translucent pigment edges.
- Very top micro UI: include a thin mobile status-bar impression with tiny Korean text “모바일 청첩장”, a small heart icon, and a subtle date tag “SAVE THE DATE”, all visually integrated into the invitation rather than looking like a real phone OS screenshot.
- Eyebrow line (upper-middle): set “WE INVITE YOU” in small uppercase serif text, centered, with wide letter spacing and refined visual weight; add a tiny line below reading “소중한 분들을 초대합니다”.
- Main name block (center 25%): render “{신랑 이름} ♥ {신부 이름}” in a large elegant Korean serif style, centered and prominent, with the heart symbol compact and balanced between the names.
- Couple credit microtext: under the names, add a small centered line “함께하는 첫날, 따뜻한 마음으로 모십니다” in Korean, delicate and readable.
- Date block (mid-lower): place “{예식 일자}” beneath the names in a smaller serif type, spaced clearly and aligned to center; add a rounded date badge nearby reading “D-DAY” and a small calendar-style chip “CALENDAR”.
- Venue block (lower-middle): display “{식장 이름}” on one line and “{주소}” on the next line, using clean readable typography with slightly smaller size than the date; add a miniature muted map preview strip or route-line graphic behind/under the address with a pin icon and label “오시는 길”.
- Invitation message panel: insert a soft translucent cream card between date and action row with short Korean copy: “서로의 가장 좋은 계절이 되어 / 새로운 시작을 함께하려 합니다.” Include tiny decorative divider dots in sage and dusty rose.
- Action card row (lower 20%): draw a dashed border card containing three small icon items laid out horizontally — 축하 메시지·축의금 보내기 / 오시는 길 안내 / 예식 영상 다시보기 — each icon evenly spaced and labeled, with realistic mobile tap-button styling, tiny shadows, and line icons.
- Bottom footer (very bottom): place a small “RSVP” link centered with understated emphasis, plus microtext “참석 여부를 알려주세요 · WEDDING INVITATION” and a tiny flower sprig aligned near the footer.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for UI labels and venue details, and Nanum Myeongjo or a refined Korean serif for the couple names; eyebrow and date should use a modern serif with medium weight, name text around 60–72px equivalent, supporting text around 22–30px equivalent, micro labels around 13–18px equivalent but still legible.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} translated into actual tones such as cream #F5EFE6, sage green #A9B8A5, dusty rose #D8A0A2, muted charcoal #3D3A37, pale blush #F0DAD8, and warm paper shadow #D9CFC1.
- Border and shadow: action card with a thin dashed border in sage green, soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12–15% opacity; rounded card corners, layered paper-card depth, and delicate dotted separators.
- Illustration treatment: {식물 모티브} should feel like delicate watercolor paper print with slightly translucent pigment edges, gentle botanical rhythm, small buds, thin stems, natural asymmetry, and lightly overlapping petals.
- Decorative graphic elements: use fine dividers, small leaf bullets, tiny calendar and location icons, a rounded D-DAY badge, soft map-line decoration, and subtle footer floral accents that support the wedding invitation theme.
- UI realism: the screen should look like a finished premium Korean mobile invite page ready to be shared, with functional-looking buttons, readable microcopy, and tactile paper-card layers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: designed as a realistic premium mobile invitation screen mockup, viewed straight-on with a 50mm-equivalent centered framing feel; if rendered as a photographed digital mockup, use Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/1.8, orthographic-like alignment, no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio-like illumination from upper-left, with gentle ambient fill, faint paper relief shadows, and subtle highlights on card edges.
- Color grade: muted cream + sage + dusty rose editorial palette, low contrast, slightly warm ivory tone, crisp charcoal text, natural watercolor softness, no harsh saturation spikes.
- Texture realism: show fine paper grain, watercolor wash variations, very slight ink bleed on botanical illustration edges, and soft screen-like clarity for Korean text.

[6. MOOD]
Refined Korean premium wedding invitation editorial — similar to mcard.com and the_card, with a calm luxury paper-craft aesthetic, intimate mobile RSVP experience, and warm botanical wedding atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문자열: “{신랑 이름}”, “{신부 이름}”, “{예식 일자}”, “{식장 이름}”, “{주소}”, “축하 메시지·축의금 보내기”, “오시는 길 안내”, “예식 영상 다시보기”, “RSVP”.
- Additional Korean text should be clean and readable: “소중한 분들을 초대합니다”, “함께하는 첫날, 따뜻한 마음으로 모십니다”, “서로의 가장 좋은 계절이 되어”, “새로운 시작을 함께하려 합니다”, “참석 여부를 알려주세요”.
- Layout invariants: the couple names must remain centered and clearly dominant; the bottom action card must contain exactly three icon items; all Korean characters must be clean and readable.
- Preserve the premium mobile wedding invitation concept, vertical 1024x1536 composition, {컬러 팔레트} mood, and {식물 모티브} botanical identity.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean Instagram carousel series mockup, 8-card overview grid for social-media marketing.
Designed as a realistic agency presentation board showing the full 8-slide card-news series at a glance, with readable Korean copy, carousel navigation cues, social micro-icons, and polished campaign details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main canvas: 2행 4열 grid of 8 equal cards, each card styled as a 1080x1080 Instagram carousel mockup within the composition.
- Cards sit on a warm cream presentation background with consistent gutters, realistic paper-like card thickness, subtle separation shadows, and a few presentation-board details such as small alignment ticks, tiny slide labels, and light editorial guide marks.
- Each card uses the same visual system: top badge, brand handle, slide number indicator, central headline area, short supporting caption, small footer text, and tiny save/share-style micro icons, so the series feels unified and campaign-ready.
- Use {시리즈 주제}, {브랜드 핸들}, {번호 표기}, {각 슬라이드 키워드}, {다음 편 티저}, {마지막 CTA}, {컬러 팔레트} placeholders throughout.
- Add realistic Korean micro-copy where appropriate, such as “저장해두기”, “공유하기”, “끝까지 보기”, “오늘의 핵심”, “다음 장에서 계속”, “댓글로 의견 남기기”, and hashtag-like text such as “#카드뉴스 #브랜드팁 #인사이트”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Card 1 (cover): large bold title using {시리즈 주제} centered in the upper-middle area, with a smaller {브랜드 핸들} line beneath it; give this card the strongest contrast and slightly larger type than the rest. Include a small cover label “CARD NEWS SERIES”, a date stamp “2026.05”, a page indicator “01/08”, and a subtle footer line “저장해두고 천천히 읽기”.
- Card 2: top badge {번호 표기} aligned near the upper-left, with the first keyword from {각 슬라이드 키워드} as the main text in the center; add a short sub-caption line “핵심만 빠르게 정리했어요” and bottom UI details: “02/08”, {브랜드 핸들}, tiny save/share icons, and “#브랜드팁”.
- Card 3: repeat the same structure with the second keyword from {각 슬라이드 키워드}; maintain identical badge position and type scale. Add a small callout chip “CHECK POINT” and a caption line “놓치기 쉬운 포인트를 확인하세요”, with footer “03/08 · 공유하기”.
- Card 4: repeat with the third keyword from {각 슬라이드 키워드}; preserve the same card geometry and spacing so the grid reads consistently. Include a small accent shape behind the headline, a footer “04/08”, and tiny hashtag text “#실전팁 #인스타운영”.
- Card 5: repeat with the fourth keyword from {각 슬라이드 키워드}; keep the center text large enough to read at thumbnail size. Add a thin divider, a small note “오늘 바로 적용 가능”, and bottom micro-copy “05/08 · 저장 추천”.
- Card 6: repeat with the fifth keyword from {각 슬라이드 키워드}; use the same badge style and spacing. Include a small checklist-style decorative block with Korean labels “전략 / 실행 / 점검”, plus footer “06/08 · {브랜드 핸들}”.
- Card 7: teaser card with {다음 편 티저} as the main line, slightly more spacious and dramatic, still using the same badge-and-body hierarchy. Include “NEXT” label, “다음 편 예고”, page indicator “07/08”, and a subtle arrow motif pointing toward the final card.
- Card 8: CTA card with {마지막 CTA} as the main message and {브랜드 핸들} as the small footer line; make this card feel like the closing panel of the series. Include “08/08”, a clear CTA button-like element reading “팔로우하고 전체 보기”, a small comment prompt “궁금한 점은 댓글로 남겨주세요”, and hashtag-like footer “#카드뉴스 #SNS마케팅”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Sans Serif, bold 700–800 for headlines, medium 500 for support text, clear line height, tight but readable tracking.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트}; interpret as cream background, deep navy text, and warm coral highlight accents.
- Badge design: small rounded rectangle or pill badge, consistent size across slides, filled with deep navy or coral accent, white text inside.
- Add realistic editorial UI details: page indicators “01/08” through “08/08”, small brand handle placement, micro hashtag lines, save/share/bookmark-style outline icons, tiny divider rules, and subtle sticker-like accent shapes.
- Shadow: soft drop shadow under each card, roughly 0px x-offset, 10px y-offset, 24px blur, 14% opacity, to create a floating mockup feel.
- Borders and spacing: even gutters, clean white/cream card edges, strong modular alignment, with small but meaningful social-card details that make the board feel like a real campaign draft.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat-lay presentation look, equivalent to a 35mm lens at f/8 for crisp all-over clarity.
- Lighting: soft studio lighting from upper-left with gentle fill from the right, diffused and shadow-controlled so text remains readable.
- Color grade: cream + navy + coral editorial UI palette, slightly warm paper tint, clean digital mockup finish.
- Materials and finish: realistic matte card surfaces, faint paper grain, soft bevel at card edges, gentle shadow layering, and polished agency-board presentation quality.

[6. MOOD]
Direct, polished Korean SNS marketing deck — a refined editorial carousel board with the clarity of modern agency presentation slides and the lively detail of a real Instagram card-news campaign ready for posting.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시되어야 하는 문자열: "{시리즈 주제}", "{브랜드 핸들}", "{번호 표기}", "{각 슬라이드 키워드}", "{다음 편 티저}", "{마지막 CTA}".
- Additional Korean strings should be clean and readable, including “저장해두기”, “공유하기”, “다음 편 예고”, “팔로우하고 전체 보기”, “댓글로 의견 남기기”, “#카드뉴스”, “#브랜드팁”.
- All 8 cards must be easily readable at a glance, with consistent badge placement, clear slide numbers, uniform typography rhythm, and recognizable carousel-series continuity.
- The carousel must clearly show 8 distinct slides in a 2x4 grid.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean gym and pilates season-opening promotional poster, vertical 2:3 layout, built for social-feed ad use and realistic printed-poster presentation.
Premium motivational campaign poster that highlights membership discounts, facility/program lineup, opening-week event details, registration information, and a strong CTA with a polished urban fitness brand feel.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Poster canvas is a tall 2:3 layout with a premium editorial ad structure: top eyebrow, large headline block, event subheading, centered hero illustration, discount callout, program lineup row, event detail strip, CTA pill, sponsor/ticket micro area, and footer metadata.
- Use {시즌·시점} as the top eyebrow with a thin gold rule beneath it, aligned near the upper-left area like a luxury campaign label.
- Add small date and issue-style metadata near the top-right: "OPEN SEASON 2026", "VOL.05", "2026.05.01–05.31" in compact warm-white/gold type.
- Place {헤드라인} as the largest typographic element in the upper third, stacked across 2 lines for strong visual impact.
- Set {이벤트명} directly below the headline as a smaller subheading with clear separation and tight tracking.
- Center the hero illustration in the middle 35–40% of the poster: premium detailed line-art gym/pilates scene featuring a reformer, dumbbell set, kettlebell, yoga mat, resistance band, towel, water bottle, and subtle floor-plan grid accents, arranged as a refined equipment cluster rather than isolated icons.
- Add decorative graphic elements around the hero: thin gold orbit lines, small measurement ticks, soft spotlight gradients, subtle dust/paper grain, and tiny labels such as "PILATES", "PT", "GX", "SAUNA".
- Put the discount block {할인 정보} inside a rectangular boxed highlight slightly below the hero area, with high contrast, numeric emphasis, and supporting microcopy such as "선착순 100명 한정" and "신규 등록 혜택".
- Arrange {시설·프로그램 lineup} as a 3-pillar horizontal row beneath the discount block, each item icon-led with small secondary Korean labels like "1:1 PT", "리포머 필라테스", "GX 클래스".
- Add an event details band above or below the lineup: "상담 가능 시간 07:00–23:00", "장소 3F 웰니스 라운지", "등록 문의 02-0000-2026".
- Place {CTA 버튼} as a rounded pill button near the lower third, centered and visually dominant enough to tap on mobile, with a small arrow or QR-style square beside it.
- Include a small ticket/sponsor area near the bottom: "OPEN WEEK PASS", "무료 체험권 1회", "PARTNER  SPORT LAB · WELLNESS CREW" with tiny logo-like wordmarks and divider rules.
- Put {브랜드 풋터} in small type at the bottom edge, aligned center or slightly left for a polished ad-footer feel, accompanied by address/contact microcopy: "서울시 강남구 피트니스로 24 · @yourgym.official".
- Background should be a deep charcoal surface with tactile paper grain, subtle concrete texture, gentle vignette, and restrained gold lighting from the upper-left.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header zone (upper 12–15%): set {시즌·시점} in small uppercase-style Korean/English eyebrow treatment, with a thin metallic gold divider line underneath; add top-right campaign metadata "OPEN SEASON 2026", "VOL.05", "2026.05.01–05.31".
2. Main headline zone (upper 20–30%): render {헤드라인} in bold Pretendard, large size, stacked line breaks, high contrast white text, with slight letter tightening for an assertive campaign look.
3. Subheading zone (just below headline): place {이벤트명} in a smaller but still prominent weight, using a gold or warm off-white tone; add a small supporting line "새로운 루틴을 시작하는 오픈 위크".
4. Center hero zone (mid frame): draw a refined gold-and-white line-art equipment cluster featuring a pilates reformer, dumbbell set, kettlebell, yoga mat, towel, water bottle, locker key tag, and resistance band; add small annotated tags "PILATES", "PT", "GX", "CARDIO" and subtle circular motion lines to make the poster feel like a finished fitness campaign artwork.
5. Discount callout zone (mid-lower): frame {할인 정보} in a boxed module with a thin gold border, slightly darker inset background, clear numeric emphasis for percentage/price changes, and microcopy "선착순 100명", "당일 등록 추가 혜택".
6. Program row zone (lower mid): show {시설·프로그램 lineup} as three evenly spaced pillars, each separated by thin vertical rules, small equipment icons, and secondary labels such as "맞춤 상담", "체형 분석", "무료 체험".
7. Event information zone (lower mid to lower 20%): include compact realistic poster details: "일시 2026.05.01 FRI – 05.31 SUN", "시간 07:00–23:00", "장소 3F 웰니스 라운지", "문의 02-0000-2026".
8. CTA zone (lower 15%): set {CTA 버튼} inside a rounded pill button with gold fill or gold outline, strong contrast text, a small arrow icon, and a soft shadow for button emphasis; place a tiny QR-style square or ticket stub beside it labeled "상담 예약".
9. Footer zone (bottom edge): place {브랜드 풋터} in compact meta text with a clean corporate-ad finish; add sponsor/partner line "PARTNER  SPORT LAB · WELLNESS CREW" and tiny legal-style note "이벤트 혜택은 지점별로 상이할 수 있습니다".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for {헤드라인}, Pretendard SemiBold for {이벤트명}, discount copy, and event details, Pretendard Medium for footer and micro labels; headline size should dominate the upper third, with supporting labels around 24–36px and footer/microcopy around 14–18px.
- Color palette: use {컬러 팔레트} with deep charcoal #1C1C1E, gold accent #C8A24A, warm white #F5F1E8, muted gray #8D8D8D, and dark graphite inset panels for ticket/detail modules.
- Border/shadow: use thin gold rules, a 1.5px gold border around the discount block, metallic divider lines around the event detail band, and a soft drop shadow for the CTA pill with 0px x-offset, 6px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity.
- Graphic details should feel like a real premium gym poster: paper grain, subtle concrete wall texture, tiny registration text, sponsor-style wordmarks, ticket/pass strip, and precise typographic alignment.
- Keep all essential Korean text crisp, correctly spelled, and readable at mobile poster scale.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: designed like a premium graphic poster, equivalent to a studio campaign shot built with an 85mm f/1.8 look and crisp product-ad composition, even though the hero itself is illustration-based.
- Lighting: directional gold spotlight from the upper-left at 45°, with subtle falloff toward the lower-right, creating a staged editorial poster atmosphere.
- Color grade: charcoal noir with metallic gold accents, warm white typography, muted graphite panels, and realistic printed-poster grain.
- Texture: slightly tactile matte paper surface, faint scuffs, fine halftone grain in shadow areas, and metallic gold highlights that catch light around rules, icons, and the CTA.

[6. MOOD]
Premium fitness launch campaign — luxury wellness editorial ad feel with disciplined urban motivation, opening-week energy, and realistic gym brand credibility.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 그대로 정확하게 보여야 함: "{시즌·시점}", "{헤드라인}", "{이벤트명}", "{할인 정보}", "{시설·프로그램 lineup}", "{CTA 버튼}", "{브랜드 풋터}"
- Additional Korean poster text should be clear and plausible: "선착순 100명 한정", "신규 등록 혜택", "일시 2026.05.01–05.31", "시간 07:00–23:00", "장소 3F 웰니스 라운지", "문의 02-0000-2026", "무료 체험권 1회".
- 가격·기간·핵심 혜택은 한눈에 읽히도록 크게, 깨끗하게, 오탈자 없이 표현할 것.
- The layout must keep the poster structure balanced: top eyebrow, large headline, event subheading, centered hero illustration, discount box, 3-pillar row, event detail strip, CTA pill, sponsor/ticket area, footer meta.
- Preserve the deep charcoal and metallic gold campaign identity from {컬러 팔레트} while making the poster feel like a finished real-world gym opening advertisement.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Unauthorized celebrity likenesses or celebrity composites

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
