[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Pop-up store experience-zone advertisement mockup for a lifestyle tea brand, shown as a realistic retail interior visualization. Designed to clearly communicate zoning, customer flow, product hero placement, signage hierarchy, and experiential retail details for promotional use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Hero placement: {브랜드·제품} is the visual anchor in the main retail zone, occupying the central 35–40% of the frame with a product display table, stacked tea tins, boxed gift sets, tester jars, and brand signage aligned to the front-facing aisle.
- Space layout: {공간 컨셉} fills the environment with a calm indoor-garden atmosphere, using layered shelving, soft partitions, a semi-open booth structure, botanical planters, textured floor mats, fabric banners, and warm retail fixtures.
- Experience zones: {체험존} must be distinctly separated but visually connected, with each zone readable at a glance from the wide perspective through signage, counter function, floor direction marks, and small interaction props.
- Visitor flow: guide movement according to {동선}, using floor cues, counter orientation, arrow decals, queue markers, tasting tray placement, and naturally navigable walking lanes.
- Background treatment: realistic mall or department-store retail interior with cream walls, sage accents, walnut wood surfaces, linen fabric canopy overhead, botanical props integrated into booth edges, small ceiling track lights, nearby glass rail reflection, and subtle people silhouettes passing outside the booth.
- Advertising context: include a freestanding campaign poster, event-detail board, QR participation stand, sponsor strip, and small ticket/coupon display so the space feels like an active promotional pop-up installation.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Foreground zone: welcoming entry edge with visible booth opening, floor texture, first contact point of the experience route, entry sign reading “팝업 체험존 입구”, and a small brochure stand with folded leaflets.
- Left-side zone: fragrance or tasting interaction area, with a small bar counter, ceramic tasting cups, glass tea pitchers, ingredient jars, product samples, a menu card, and signage reading “오늘의 블렌드 시음”.
- Center zone: main product table and hero shelf positioned as the most prominent area, with premium packaging front-facing and evenly spaced; add tiered risers, price tags, small shelf labels, seasonal gift ribbon details, and a tabletop card reading “나다운 차의 순간”.
- Right-side zone: photo point, QR stand, and consultation counter placed in a tidy sequence so the viewer immediately understands the full retail journey; include a mirror-like photo frame, soft botanical backdrop, tablet device, staff stool, appointment card, and sign reading “향 취향 상담”.
- Overhead structure: fabric canopy or hanging material framing the top area without blocking signage, creating a soft enclosed exhibition feel; add hanging wayfinding panels, linen ribbons, small spotlight fixtures, and a suspended campaign banner reading “SPRING TEA WEEK”.
- Circulation cues: maintain a believable walking lane from entrance to the final consultation point, with objects spaced to support the exact visitor journey described by {동선}; include floor arrows labeled “1 시향 → 2 시음 → 3 촬영 → 4 상담”.
- Event information: add a poster or wall panel with Korean retail details such as “2026.05.01–05.14”, “매일 11:00–20:00”, “성수 라이프스타일 라운지 1F”, “시음 쿠폰 증정”, and “QR 체크인 후 참여”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: clean Korean sans-serif such as Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight, with highly legible signage at poster-scale sizing and smaller readable labels for shelves, menus, and zone markers.
- Color palette: use {소재·컬러} as the dominant palette, with sage green #A8B8A0, cream #F4F0E8, walnut brown #6B4E3D, soft beige #DCCFBE, and muted botanical green accents.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft shadow under tables, risers, counters, brochure stands, and props, 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; avoid harsh outlines.
- Signage treatment: polished retail wayfinding panels, layered graphic hierarchy, high contrast Korean text, small sponsor/partner strip, QR card, floor arrows, shelf tags, coupon cards, and event notice boards that look printed and professionally installed.
- Material detail: emphasize tactile realism with walnut grain, matte paper posters, linen canopy weave, brushed metal sign brackets, ceramic cups, transparent acrylic stands, kraft sample cards, and soft reflections on polished retail flooring.
- Human scale: include one or two lightly blurred visitors or staff members interacting with the tasting bar or QR stand only if they do not block the zoning; use them to reinforce realistic scale and active retail atmosphere.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: wide 24mm lens, 3/4 retail interior angle, eye-level to slightly elevated viewpoint, realistic commercial space photography.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from the left side like a mall skylight, supplemented by warm practical downlights and gentle fill light to keep all zones readable; add natural highlights on acrylic displays, ceramic cups, and product packaging.
- Color grade: airy cream-and-sage retail editorial grade with soft walnut warmth, slightly desaturated greens, and clean neutral highlights.
- Rendering approach: photorealistic interior visualization with physically believable fixtures, retail-scale counters, crisp print materials, accurate perspective, and realistic surface texture.
- Shooting direction: reflect {촬영} through the final framing, maintaining a commercial advertisement-space proposal look suitable for a client presentation.

[6. MOOD]
Premium lifestyle pop-up retail editorial — Kinfolk x Aesop showroom aesthetic with a polished commercial set design feel, enriched by real store details, warm customer touchpoints, botanical calm, and an inviting promotional event atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all Korean signage and labels must be crisp and correctly rendered; no broken characters, no mirrored text, no gibberish.
- Required Korean text elements in the image: “오늘의 블렌드 시음”, “향 취향 상담”, “팝업 체험존 입구”, “QR 체크인”, “시음 쿠폰 증정”, “2026.05.01–05.14”, “성수 라이프스타일 라운지 1F”.
- Spatial clarity: the path from entrance to tasting, product hero, photo point, and consultation counter must be immediately understandable.
- The space must feel physically buildable, with realistic retail scale, believable counter heights, plausible circulation width, functional lighting placement, and installable booth materials.
- {브랜드·제품}, {공간 컨셉}, {체험존}, {동선}, {소재·컬러}, and {촬영} must remain visually represented without changing the core pop-up store experience-zone concept.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake official seals or certifications

[1. PURPOSE]
라이브커머스 판매 화면 광고 목업 for mobile ad / landing thumbnail use. A realistic Korean in-app commerce livestream screen with an active host, product-focused sales UI, real-time engagement, coupon prompts, and instantly readable purchase hierarchy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main livestream video area occupies the upper 58% of the frame, with {쇼호스트·스튜디오} centered slightly left-of-center for a natural on-camera framing, surrounded by product samples, a small price placard, and berry-themed table styling.
- Product card and purchase UI stack in the lower 42%, with {제품명} and {상품구성} given the strongest visual weight beside the main purchase CTA.
- {UI 요소} are distributed around the video window and lower interface as compact floating and stacked elements: LIVE badge, viewer count, chat bubbles, hearts, coupon chip, cart icon, product thumbnail strip, and pinned notice.
- {판매 정보}, {가격정보}, {쿠폰혜택}, {배송혜택}, and {남은시간} are placed in a clear promo strip and CTA cluster near the lower-right quadrant.
- Background is a polished ecommerce app canvas with warm off-white panels, berry-pattern accent stickers, translucent chat overlays, thin dividers, rounded cards, soft shadows, and believable mobile app chrome under the fictional app name {앱명}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone (about 10%): compact livestream status bar with {앱명}, LIVE badge, {시청자수}, share icon, bell icon, cart icon, and the channel handle {채널핸들}; include a small 방송중 label and a progress-like time bar.
- Hero video zone (about 48%): {쇼호스트·스튜디오} presented inside a crisp rounded-rectangle livestream frame, with bright studio lighting, hands presenting the product, visible cans/box packshot, fruit props, and a small pinned caption reading 오늘만 라이브 혜택.
- Product emphasis zone (about 16%): {제품명} shown in a bold product card with packshot clarity, {상품구성}, thumbnail carousel, star rating microtext, remaining stock note, and sharp label readability.
- Sales info zone (about 12%): {판매 정보} set as stacked promo chips with {가격정보}, {쿠폰혜택}, {배송혜택}, {남은시간}, and a large coral CTA button reading 구매 버튼.
- Social proof/UI zone (about 14%): {UI 요소} placed as chat bubbles, heart reactions, real-time purchase toast, small profile circles, compact counts, and scrolling viewer comments such as {채팅문구}, mimicking a real live shopping session.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR, bold 700 for key labels, semibold 600 for prices and CTA, regular 400 for supporting text; size hierarchy should feel like a mobile commerce app, headline 28–34px equivalent, body 16–20px equivalent, micro UI 11–14px equivalent.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}, plus off-white UI panels; use specific accents like #E84C5B, #FFF6EF, #B63B57, #F2D2C9, #FFD166, and deep charcoal for text.
- Border/shadow: rounded cards with 16–20px corner radius, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 15% opacity, thin 1px separators in warm gray, glossy CTA highlight, and small berry/fruit decorative badges integrated into the UI.
- Rendered interface should feel information-rich and commercially active while preserving clear reading order: header → live video → product card → discount/price → CTA.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm lens look at f/2.8 with a clean studio product-commercial framing, slightly elevated frontal angle for the host and product layout.
- Lighting: bright studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from right, even skin and product illumination, crisp highlights on cans and packaging, realistic reflections on plastic/glass surfaces.
- Color grade: coral-red and berry highlights balanced with creamy whites and clean neutral UI tones, polished ecommerce app advertising finish.
- UI rendering: high-resolution mobile screenshot mockup, crisp vector-like icons, readable Korean typography, realistic spacing, tappable button proportions, and subtle translucent overlays on the livestream area.

[6. MOOD]
Modern live-shopping editorial — energetic Korean ecommerce app UI mixed with a clean D2C brand promo aesthetic, like a premium livestream commerce template with real-time urgency, friendly chat energy, and a colorful fresh-product campaign.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and legibly in the rendered image:
  - 라이브 특가
  - 타임딜
  - 35% 할인
  - 구매 버튼
  - LIVE
  - 오늘만 라이브 혜택
  - 무료배송
  - 쿠폰받기
  - 남은시간 09:58
  - {앱명}
  - {스토어명}
  - {채널핸들}
  - {라이브 제목}
  - {제품명}
  - {가격정보}
  - {채팅문구}
- {제품명} must be the featured product identity and visually readable in the product card area, with product packaging and purchase CTA clearly connected.
- UI hierarchy must remain clear: video area, product card, sales info, coupon, price, chat, and engagement elements should remain readable as a realistic live commerce screen.
- Hands, if visible, must be anatomically correct with exactly 5 fingers per hand.
- Add believable microcopy such as 방금 24명 구매, 재고 128개, 옵션 선택, 장바구니, 공유, 좋아요 1.2만, and 첫 구매 쿠폰 in small supporting UI text.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Famous celebrity face composites
- Misleading medical or official endorsement claims

studio:prompts3:ours-1103.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
UGC-style testimonial advertising collage for {제품명}, designed as a mobile-feed SNS promo with a central product hero, four casual usage snapshots, review cards, handle-style metadata, and save/share micro UI.
Looks like authentic customer content at first glance, but with polished commercial composition suitable for premium social ads and performance creative.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center placement: {원본 제품} stands as the main hero in the vertical center, occupying about 34% of the frame height, with product silhouette, label, cap, material highlights, and package color preserved exactly.
- Surrounding layout: four UGC photos from {UGC 컷} are arranged around the hero in a balanced collage, each framed like a slightly imperfect polaroid-style snapshot with visible paper edges, tape tabs, handwritten-style memo marks, and natural desk or bag textures.
- Social proof layer: {후기 카피} appears as short caption strips attached to each snapshot, supported by {별점문구}, {캠페인문구}, and small reaction stickers that feel like real saved customer posts.
- Instagram card details: add {브랜드핸들}, {날짜위치}, {해시태그}, tiny save/share/heart icons, a small carousel indicator, and a soft CTA chip reading {CTA문구}.
- Background treatment: soft beige base with muted mint accents, subtle paper grain, fabric-like shadows, sticker tape, receipt-like mini notes, and faint tabletop depth so the collage feels physically assembled.
- Spacing: keep readable gutters between the central hero and surrounding cards; use a lively editorial grid with casual overlaps, realistic shadows, and tactile layering.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main hero area (center 34%): {원본 제품} displayed upright, cleanly cut out, with its original shape, label, logo, and color preserved exactly; add a realistic soft shadow beneath and a small mint glow card behind it for premium focus.
2. Top-left UGC card: one scene from {UGC 컷} shown as a candid lifestyle shot, slightly tilted 2–4 degrees, with a narrow white polaroid frame, date stamp, tiny heart icon, and a caption strip using one phrase from {후기 카피}.
3. Top-right UGC card: another {UGC 컷} photo placed symmetrically opposite the left card, matching the same polaroid framing system and scale, with a small sticker label reading {날짜위치}.
4. Bottom-left UGC card: a third scene from {UGC 컷} placed lower-left, slightly overlapping the central hero margin without covering the product label; include a casual note tag, mini sparkle mark, and compact review text.
5. Bottom-right UGC card: the final {UGC 컷} photo anchored lower-right, with a rounded review strip, {별점문구}, and a small save/share micro-icon row as if captured from a social post.
6. Review card styling: each card uses short, friendly feedback phrasing, compact spacing, rounded corners, paper-card texture, and real customer-post rhythm so it reads as UGC rather than a flat banner ad.
7. Header and footer UI: top header contains {브랜드핸들}, small profile circle, and {캠페인문구}; bottom footer contains {해시태그}, page indicator “1/4”, and CTA chip {CTA문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight for {제품명}, regular to semibold for {후기 카피}, size hierarchy roughly 42–56px for product title, 24–30px for review labels, and 16–20px for micro UI text.
- Color palette: beige #F4EBDD, muted mint #CFE3D8, warm ivory #FFF9F1, soft gray #D7D2C8, charcoal #2E2A28, blush sticker accent #F2C6BD, pale lemon note #FFF2B8.
- Border/shadow: polaroid-style white borders with 1–2px inner edge definition, soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 14% opacity; add paper tape shadows, sticker highlights, and realistic overlapping card depth.
- Graphic details: include small hand-drawn arrows, sparkle doodles, review bubbles, star rating icons, carousel dots, and mobile-feed micro icons while keeping the product as the main visual anchor.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial smartphone snapshot look using iPhone 15 Pro 24mm-equivalent casual handheld photos for UGC frames, mixed with Canon EOS R5 with RF 50mm f/1.8 STM portrait-style framing for the hero product.
- Lighting: soft diffused window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, low-contrast shadows to mimic realistic indoor lifestyle photography with natural tabletop bounce.
- Color grade: warm cream + mint + soft beige with restrained saturation, slightly lifted blacks, clean premium e-commerce finish, subtle film grain in the UGC photos and sharper commercial clarity on the hero product.

[6. MOOD]
Premium user-review collage — feels like a carefully designed social proof ad mixed with warm Korean lifestyle editorial, casual customer posts, and polished beauty-brand commerce.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: “{제품명}”, “{후기 카피}”, “{브랜드핸들}”, “{해시태그}”, “{CTA문구}”.
- 화면 내 보조 문구 예시를 자연스럽게 포함: “{별점문구}”, “{캠페인문구}”, “{날짜위치}”, “1/4”, “저장”, “공유”.
- Preserve the original product form, logo, and label exactly as seen in {원본 제품}; package proportions, brand markings, cap shape, and color must remain recognizable.
- The four UGC scenes must feel like genuine daily-use photos and each should clearly support the testimonial theme through props, location context, and believable customer captions.
- Keep the layout readable on a mobile feed, with the hero product instantly identifiable at a glance and all Korean captions sharp enough to read.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or fabricated government/medical certification marks
- Warped, broken, or unreadable Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure faces
- Distorting the original product shape, label, logo, or package identity

[INPUT]
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean product miniature diorama advertising cut, premium real-product showcase with a playful miniature world.
Designed as a vertical commercial image that makes the product feel oversized, iconic, and physically present, while the surrounding diorama adds narrative discovery, believable scale, tactile texture, and campaign-ready detail.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center composition: {원본 제품} occupies the middle 45–55% of the frame as the dominant hero object, keeping its real shape, proportion, color, logo, and label intact.
- Surrounding environment: build a layered miniature landscape from {세계관} and {제형 연출}, with winding paths, tiny platforms, terraces, work zones, sample stations, and terrain flowing naturally around the product like a small branded world.
- Framing and scale: compose the scene as a premium macro advertising set, with miniature activity concentrated around the base, lower third, and side paths, plus a few elevated ladders or platforms that emphasize the product’s oversized monument-like presence.
- Integration details: use {미니어처 활동} to create storytelling points that guide the eye back toward the main product, and connect them with {소품·촬영} as believable scale indicators such as tiny lights, trays, clipboards, crates, stools, paper signs, ropes, ladders, and sampling tools.
- Campaign details: include small realistic Korean diorama signage and printed set pieces, such as '신제품 체험존', '오늘의 추천', '제형 연구소', '{제품명} 미니 월드', '샘플존', and a tiny campaign tag reading '2026 봄 캠페인'.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero product area (center 45–55%): {원본 제품} displayed as a pristine, photoreal centerpiece with intact packaging geometry, crisp label edges, real material finish, accurate logo placement, and subtle reflections matching its original surface.
2. World-building layer (midground and lower half): {세계관} rendered as a handcrafted miniature set where the terrain transitions into {제형 연출}, forming soft hills, glossy pools, creamy ridges, product-colored pathways, carved steps, and small bridges that feel tactile and physically built.
3. Activity layer (foreground and side paths): tiny figures performing {미니어처 활동} in several small clusters, each oriented toward the product, sampling stations, worktables, ladders, or nearby props to imply motion, purpose, and human scale.
4. Prop and linkage layer: {소품·촬영} placed as realistic commercial set pieces—macro light stands, tiny reflector cards, wooden benches, ceramic dishes, paper cups, crates, scoops, trays, ropes, signboards, worktables, and miniature camera cues—so the diorama feels like a professional advertising shoot in progress.
5. Printed micro-details: add small readable Korean labels on paper placards, sample cards, and tiny banners: '체험 시작', '한정 샘플', '부드러운 제형', '오늘의 루틴', and '{제품명}'. Keep them physically integrated into the set, printed on paper, stickers, or tiny display boards.
6. Commercial finish: keep the product sharply defined and premium while allowing the miniature world to be rich with inspectable details, tactile material variation, grounded shadows, tiny human gestures, and layered storytelling.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: preserve all existing package text exactly as printed on {원본 제품}; additional miniature signage may appear only as small Korean campaign text printed on paper placards, sample labels, banners, or set tags, with legible phrases such as '{제품명} 미니 월드', '신제품 체험존', '제형 연구소', '한정 샘플', and '2026 봄 캠페인'.
- Color palette: strawberry red, yogurt white, cream beige, soft sage green, pastel pink, warm brown, with polished highlights, natural material texture, and controlled shadow depth.
- Materials: combine photoreal packaging with handcrafted diorama textures—matte paper fibers, painted wood, tiny ceramic dishes, cream-like glossy surfaces, soft fabric flags, miniature metal tools, and slightly uneven handmade terrain.
- Shadow and grounding: subtle soft drop shadow under the product, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; all miniature pieces, figures, ladders, trays, and signs should cast small grounded contact shadows for realism.
- Scale realism: miniature figures and props should have believable proportions, natural poses, and slight imperfections, while the hero product remains full-size, premium, and commercially lit.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 100mm macro lens with tilt-shift perspective, f/5.6, product-commercial close framing, crisp detail across the hero and miniature set.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, with tiny specular highlights on packaging and slightly warmer bounce light on the cream surfaces.
- Color grade: polished editorial commercial grade with strawberry pink and yogurt ivory emphasis, slightly warm highlights, neutral mids, and restrained contrast.
- Depth and focus: maintain sharp product detail and readable package identity, with macro-realistic depth falloff on the farthest miniature props and background terrain.
- Realism finish: emphasize real tabletop photography, physical miniature fabrication, authentic shadows, tactile set-building marks, and subtle studio reflections rather than a flat digital mockup.

[6. MOOD]
Premium product advertising diorama — a Kinfolk-meets-Aesop miniature commercial set with the polish of a high-end lifestyle campaign, playful discovery, tactile craft detail, and a warm Korean brand-story atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: preserve any packaging text on {원본 제품} exactly with no distortion; additional visible miniature text must be clean, readable Korean such as '신제품 체험존', '오늘의 추천', '제형 연구소', '{제품명} 미니 월드', '샘플존', '한정 샘플', and '2026 봄 캠페인'.
- Preserve the product’s exact form, proportion, logo, label, and package design as shown in {원본 제품}.
- The miniature world must feel handcrafted and believable, but the product itself must remain photorealistic, full-size, and commercial-grade.
- Do not replace or redesign the product package; all added elements must exist around it as a miniature advertising set.
- The scene should read as a real macro photograph of a detailed physical diorama, not a sterile product mockup.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean SaaS/app service brand advertisement for a cafe workspace scene, combining lifestyle product photography with polished editorial typography.
Vertical 2:3 promo image that sells a digital prompt archive through a realistic laptop-and-phone hero shot, enriched with campaign micro details, app UI labels, a QR-style action area, and believable cafe atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: left 52% typography and campaign information column, right 48% occupied by {타깃 인물} holding a laptop in one hand and a phone in the other, looking into camera with a natural smile.
- The subject should stand slightly right of center, with the laptop angled toward the viewer so the screen is readable, and the phone raised near chest height.
- Background treatment: {배경 디테일}; include realistic cafe depth such as a blurred menu board, ceramic saucer, wooden chair edge, soft window reflection, and warm pendant glow.
- Left text column should feel like a premium landing-page poster: readable hierarchy, layered editorial spacing, subtle campaign labels, and a grounded CTA area near the bottom.
- Use {브랜드 이름}, {헤드라인}, {서브 헤드라인}, {브랜드 슬로건}, {본문 카피}, {CTA 버튼}, {캠페인 라벨}, {프로모션 배지}, {웹사이트 주소}, {소셜 핸들}, and {QR 안내문구} placeholders exactly as provided.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top-left brand mark area (approx. 6–8% width): place {브랜드 이름} in small warm-gold lettering with wide tracking, paired with a tiny olive square monogram or dot accent.
- Near the brand mark, add a small campaign kicker label reading {캠페인 라벨} in uppercase-style Korean/English mixed editorial treatment.
- Upper-left headline block (about 22% height): render {헤드라인} in a large Korean serif style, deep olive green #5a6444, with strong vertical rhythm and elegant spacing.
- Directly below headline: place {서브 헤드라인} in lighter gray, one clean line, aligned left with tight but readable spacing.
- Below subheadline: set {브랜드 슬로건} in a neutral sans-serif, medium gray, smaller than the subheadline and acting as a brand descriptor line.
- Add a small gold capsule badge near the body copy reading {프로모션 배지}, like a subtle launch offer sticker printed on the ad.
- Mid-left body copy area: set {본문 카피} as 4–5 short editorial lines with comfortable line-height, using a clean paragraph block that stays inside the left column.
- Bottom-left CTA: draw a gold rounded button containing {CTA 버튼} →, using warm gold fill #d9a441, dark olive text, subtle inner padding, and a soft shadow for lift.
- Beneath the CTA, include a compact info row: {웹사이트 주소} · {소셜 핸들}, with tiny divider dots and muted olive-gray text.
- Add a small QR-style square at the lower-left corner or beside the CTA, with the caption {QR 안내문구}; the QR may be decorative but should look scannable and realistic.
- Right hero area: {타깃 인물} should be sharply focused, holding a laptop with visible catalog grid in dark theme and a phone with a matching mobile catalog screen.
- Device screens: laptop UI should show natural Korean catalog cards labeled with {노트북 UI 라벨}, and phone UI should show a mobile list/card layout labeled with {모바일 UI 라벨}; include tiny tabs, search bar, card thumbnails, and Korean category chips.
- Background props: integrate {배경 디테일} as believable cafe decor, including the coffee cup and “Ideas Create Inspire” notebook on the table, with textures of paper, ceramic, wood, and warm wall paint.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Nanum Myeongjo or a similar Korean serif for the headline, Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body/subheadline/CTA, and a clean sans-serif for the English slogan; headline weight bold, body weight regular to medium, CTA weight semibold.
- Color palette: deep olive green #5a6444, warm gold #d9a441, soft gray #b8b8b8, off-white #f7f5ef, charcoal #2f2f2f, with small caramel and espresso accents from cafe props.
- Border/shadow: use soft drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity on the button and devices; add very subtle paper-grain texture to the off-white ad background.
- The text must remain highly legible with crisp edges, natural baseline alignment, and no warped letters; decorative accents may sit around the layout but must not cover the copy.
- UI details should feel like a real Korean SaaS catalog: tabs, cards, thumbnails, small labels, bookmark icons, and readable short Korean snippets.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 85mm f/1.4 portrait look, shallow background separation but enough depth to keep laptop and phone screens readable.
- Lighting: soft natural window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from front-right and subtle ambient bounce from the cafe interior.
- Color grade: warm cream, muted olive, soft gold, and restrained beige tones with a slightly filmic magazine finish.
- Keep realistic skin texture, natural hand proportions, crisp fabric texture on the blazer, believable glass reflections on devices, and sharp device screen clarity; avoid glossy plastic rendering.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean startup lifestyle ad — like a refined Kinfolk-meets-Aesop editorial photographed for a modern SaaS landing page, with approachable cafe warmth and credible app-product detail.

[7. CRITICAL]
- 한국어 텍스트 정확도: 반드시 다음 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: "{브랜드 이름}", "{헤드라인}", "{서브 헤드라인}", "{브랜드 슬로건}", "{본문 카피}", "{CTA 버튼} →"
- 보조 정보도 자연스럽게 읽혀야 함: "{캠페인 라벨}", "{프로모션 배지}", "{웹사이트 주소}", "{소셜 핸들}", "{QR 안내문구}"
- 디바이스 화면에는 "{노트북 UI 라벨}"과 "{모바일 UI 라벨}"이 보이고, 한국어 카탈로그 카드·검색창·카테고리 칩이 실제 서비스 화면처럼 구성되어야 함.
- 오른쪽 인물의 손은 해부학적으로 자연스러워야 하며, 각 손가락은 정확히 5개이고 노트북과 휴대폰을 실제로 잡은 듯한 그립이어야 함.
- 왼쪽 컬럼의 위계가 유지되어야 하며, 헤드라인·본문·CTA·QR 안내가 잘리지 않아야 함.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or misspelled Korean text
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure lookalikes without permission
- Fake government, bank, or legal-document styling

studio:prompts3:ours-1100.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean blog / YouTube-style thumbnail for comparing a phone with no service versus a newly activated prepaid phone. The image should feel like a realistic tech troubleshooting scene shot on a desk, with strong problem-to-solution storytelling, bold Korean headline text, and mobile-first clickability.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Split the frame vertically into two equal halves with a decisive hard divide; left side carries the problem state, right side carries the solution state.
- Left subject area: a dark smartphone with a black screen or visible “서비스 없음” message, paired with a tense hand touching the device on a real desk surface. Add realistic supporting details such as a loose SIM tray pin, a tiny memo note reading “통화 안됨”, and a dim red warning accent near the phone.
- Right subject area: an activated prepaid phone with a bright screen and visible call icon, paired with a relieved or satisfied hand gesture. Include realistic prepaid-phone context such as a USIM card package, small activation receipt, check-mark sticker, and a soft blue success glow around the phone screen.
- Add bold thumbnail typography across the upper and middle areas: large Korean title text “통화 불능?” on the left and “선불폰 해결!” on the right, with a small accent badge like “3분 체크” or “개통 완료”.
- Include tiny creator/detail elements to make it feel like a real content thumbnail: small channel handle “@mobile_tip”, a small arrow pointing from left to right, and a compact comparison tag “NO SERVICE → CALL OK”.
- Use {주제·장면}, {스타일·톤}, {구도·요소}, {조명·라이팅}, {컬러 팔레트·그레이딩}, {카메라·렌즈}, {비율} as the content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left half (problem state): place the dark phone slightly below center, screen facing camera, with the hand entering from the lower edge to create tension and uncertainty. Surround it with a few believable desk details: SIM ejector pin, folded note, faint red exclamation mark icon, and shadowed paperwork edge.
2. Right half (solution state): place the prepaid phone at the same height and scale for direct comparison, with a bright active screen and a relaxed hand position to signal relief. Add a small prepaid USIM card, receipt strip, check mark graphic, and neat activation label “개통 완료”.
3. Center divider: use a high-contrast vertical split with a subtle lightning-bolt or arrow transition in the middle so the eye instantly compares the two states.
4. Background and surface: both halves share the same realistic tabletop, but the left side is cooler, dimmer, and slightly desaturated while the right side is brighter, cleaner, and warmer to reinforce transformation.
5. Thumbnail text hierarchy: the biggest words must be readable first — “통화 불능?” and “선불폰 해결!” — with secondary badges “서비스 없음”, “개통 완료”, “3분 체크”, and “@mobile_tip” placed like authentic thumbnail overlays.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use crisp bold Korean sans-serif lettering similar to Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, thick stroke, high contrast, with white/yellow text and subtle dark outline for mobile readability.
- Color palette: left side uses charcoal, slate gray, muted monochrome, and warning red accents; right side uses soft sky blue, clean white, light warm pastel accents, and optimistic green check marks.
- Text treatment: use oversized title text with subtle drop shadow and outline; add a red warning badge on the left and a blue-green success badge on the right.
- Border/shadow: subtle realistic drop shadows under each phone, about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, with a crisp editorial split line and natural contact shadows on the desk.
- Graphic accents: include a left-to-right arrow, small circular badge, call icon, signal bars, check mark, and compact comparison labels without changing the main phone comparison.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V with a 50mm f/1.8 look, crisp product-style framing, ISO 200, shallow but controlled depth of field.
- Lighting: left side under soft indirect low-key light from upper-left; right side under bright clean natural window light or a softbox at 45° with gentle fill from the front.
- Color grade: cool gray on the left, bright optimistic pastel on the right, with strong luminance separation and clean editorial contrast.
- Realism: detailed smartphone glass reflections, believable hand texture, natural desk grain, readable screen UI, authentic paper/USIM packaging edges, and realistic shadows.

[6. MOOD]
Practical comparison-thumbnail energy — a clear Korean tech troubleshooting visual with urgency on the left and immediate relief on the right, like a real mobile service guide thumbnail that invites a click.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: “서비스 없음” must appear correctly and clearly if shown on the left phone screen.
- Main thumbnail headline must include readable Korean text: “통화 불능?” on the left and “선불폰 해결!” on the right.
- Supporting Korean labels may include: “개통 완료”, “3분 체크”, “통화 안됨”, “바로 연결”.
- Composition invariant: the frame must stay vertically split into two halves with matched phone scale and clear left-vs-right contrast.
- The overall mood must read as problem resolution, not comedy, luxury, or advertising glamor.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

args.default: 좌측은 차분한 모노톤에 약간의 불안감을 주는 회색조, 우측은 따뜻하고 희망적인 파스텔톤 또는 밝은 스카이블루와 깨끗한 화이트. 전체적으로 명암 대비가 뚜렷하며 긍정적인 분위기 강조

args.name: 카메라·렌즈
args.default: Sony A7R V · 50mm f/1.8 · ISO 200 · 선명하고 디테일한 표현

studio:prompts3:ours-1099.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- aspect_note: {비율}

[1. PURPOSE]
유모차와 아기를 중심으로 한 i2i 명절 한복 컷, 1024x1536 세로형 가족 기념사진/상세페이지 히어로 비주얼.
원본 제품과 아기 실루엣은 충실히 유지하면서, {명절 테마}의 한복·가족·전통 공간감이 한눈에 읽히도록 따뜻한 명절 카드형 장면으로 구성한다.
상단에는 실제 가족 앨범 카드처럼 {표지 문구}, {보조 문구}, {촬영일} · {장소 라벨}을 자연스럽게 넣어 완성도 있는 기념 이미지로 만든다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {원본 유모차·아기}를 화면 중심에서 약 60–64% 비중으로 배치하고, 제품 실루엣과 아기 얼굴/몸 비례는 원본 기준으로 유지한다.
- Secondary figures: {구성 타입}에 맞춰 보호자 또는 가족은 좌우 뒤쪽 1/3 영역에 부드럽게 배치하고, 손을 잡아주거나 한복 소매를 정리해주는 자연스러운 순간으로 연출한다.
- Outfit focus: {의상}이 가장 먼저 읽히도록 색동 소매, 고름, 치마폭, 두루마기 여밈, 조바위/복건 디테일을 또렷하게 표현한다.
- Background treatment: {촬영 배경}을 사용하며 문살, 한지 질감, 낮은 목재 좌식 테이블, 보자기, 화병, 단청 포인트, 바닥 방석이 실제 촬영 세트처럼 어우러지게 한다.
- Text composition: 상단 12–16% 영역에는 얇은 한지 라벨 플래그와 함께 {표지 문구}를 크게 배치하고, 그 아래 {보조 문구}, {촬영일} · {장소 라벨}, {가족 호칭 태그}를 작은 카드뉴스 캡션처럼 정리한다.
- Foreground detail: 유모차 바퀴 앞쪽과 한복 치마 옆에는 {소품 디테일}을 원근감 있게 배치해 명절 컷의 생활감을 살린다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero area (center 62%): {원본 유모차·아기}를 원본 형태 그대로 보존한 채 중앙에 배치하고, 유모차 프레임·캐노피·바퀴·안전벨트·라벨·브랜드 로고가 선명하게 보이도록 정돈한다.
2) Costume emphasis layer: {의상}의 색감과 결을 살리되, 한복 원단의 은은한 광택, 자수, 매듭, 노리개 장식이 고급스럽게 드러나게 한다.
3) Holiday staging: {명절 테마}에 따라 설날이면 떡국 그릇·세배 방석·복주머니, 추석이면 송편 접시·보름달 느낌의 원형 한지 조명·잔디 마당, 돌잔치면 낮은 돌상·실타래·오방색 보자기 요소를 배경과 전경에 배치한다.
4) Family balance: {구성 타입}이 가족 단체인 경우 보호자들은 중앙의 아기와 유모차를 감싸는 반원형 구도로 서거나 앉고, 아기 솔로 구성인 경우 한복 소매와 소품의 리듬으로 화면을 풍성하게 채운다.
5) Editorial card layer: 실제 가족 기념 카드처럼 얇은 금박 라인, 한지 질감의 작은 캡션 박스, 도장 느낌의 장식 태그를 더해 {표지 문구}와 {가족 호칭 태그}가 사진 위에 자연스럽게 얹히도록 한다.
6) Product integrity: 유모차의 프레임, 바퀴, 안전벨트, 라벨, 프린트 마킹, 원단 색상과 질감은 {참고 이미지}에서 보이는 대로 유지하고, 형태나 비율을 새로 디자인하지 않는다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 메인 타이틀은 Pretendard SemiBold 또는 Noto Serif KR Bold 34–46px, 보조 문구는 Pretendard Regular 18–22px, 날짜/장소/태그는 Pretendard Medium 14–18px. 한글 자소가 또렷하고 인쇄물처럼 안정적인 자간으로 처리한다.
- Text hierarchy: {표지 문구}는 상단 한지 라벨 안에 가장 크게, {보조 문구}는 그 아래 한 줄, {촬영일} · {장소 라벨}은 작은 위치 라벨, {가족 호칭 태그}는 하단 또는 우측 작은 태그 스티커처럼 배치한다.
- Color palette: {컬러 무드}를 기반으로 #E9DDC8 한지 베이지, #B3392F 단청 빨강, #2F6B4F 단청 녹색, #2B2B2B 차콜, #C8A24A 골드를 사용한다.
- Decoration system: 얇은 금박 테두리, 모서리 화문 패턴, 작은 복주머니 아이콘, 반투명 한지 캡션 박스, 단청 컬러 포인트 라인을 사용해 명절 카드다운 완성도를 만든다.
- Border/shadow: 유모차와 아기 주변에 soft drop shadow를 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity로 얹고, 텍스트 라벨에는 종이 질감의 얕은 그림자를 적용한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 with 50mm f/4, medium-format editorial product portrait framing. Camera note: {카메라}.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from lower-right, subtle rim light to separate the stroller edges from the background, warm practical lantern glow in the background.
- Color grade: warm beige + dancheong red + muted green + charcoal, with restrained gold highlights, soft skin tones, and a premium family studio finish.
- Texture: visible hanji paper grain, brushed wood floor, woven mat, silk hanbok weave, embroidered thread, matte ceramic tableware, and realistic stroller fabric texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean holiday family portrait — Kinfolk magazine spread meets boutique baby product campaign, with a warm hanok studio atmosphere, festive props, and a polished keepsake-card finish.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Render Korean text cleanly and legibly: {표지 문구}, {보조 문구}, {촬영일} · {장소 라벨}, {가족 호칭 태그}.
- Korean text accuracy: 설날, 추석, 돌잔치, 한복, 세배, 떡국, 송편, 첫한복, 가족기록.
- Replicate the EXACT product from the reference image: preserve precise shape, fabric, color, frame structure, label, brand logo, safety belts, wheels, and any printed marking.
- Keep the stroller and baby proportions faithful to the source; do not invent new product parts or change the original silhouette.
- Hands and faces, if visible, must be anatomically correct and natural, with no extra fingers or distorted facial features.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / government-like approval marks
- Broken Korean characters / unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity composites or implying a real public figure is present

studio:prompts3:ours-1098.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
유모차를 공항·여행 상황에서 실제로 사용하는 i2i 제품 컷. 휴대용·접이식 유모차가 캐리어, 탑승구, 공항 동선 속에서 자연스럽게 쓰이는 모습을 보여주며, 이동 편의성과 여행 적합성을 한 장의 정사각형 커머셜 비주얼로 명확하게 전달한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 유모차}를 프레임의 주인공으로 60~65% 비중으로 배치하고, {인물 구성}은 제품의 크기와 사용 맥락을 보여주는 라이프스타일 요소로 20~25% 면적에 자연스럽게 포함한다.
- 배경은 {여행 장면} 중 하나를 선택해 구성한다. 공항 바닥 타일, 유리창, 게이트 의자, 안내 사인, 캐리어 바퀴 자국, 로비 카펫 등 실제 여행 공간의 디테일을 살려 현장감 있게 만든다.
- {사용 포인트}가 한눈에 읽히도록 유모차 옆에 캐리어 손잡이, 탑승권, 러기지 태그, 보안검색 트레이, 게이트 안내판 같은 여행 소품을 배치한다. 소품은 실제 사용 장면처럼 겹치고 놓이되 제품의 실루엣과 바퀴, 핸들 구조는 선명하게 보이게 한다.
- 유모차 본체는 화면 중앙 약간 하단에 두고, 핸들·바퀴·프레임·시트 패브릭이 모두 보이는 3/4 각도 또는 측면에 가까운 각도로 정렬한다.
- 상단 또는 후면 배경에는 {탑승구 번호}, {노선 문구}, {여행 날짜}가 보이는 공항 안내판을 넣어 여행 상황을 즉시 인식할 수 있게 한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero product area (center 60~65%): {원본 유모차}를 원본 형태 그대로 유지한 채 공항 대합실, 면세 구역, 탑승구 앞, 호텔 로비 바닥 위에 자연스럽게 놓고, 바퀴 아래에는 실제 접지감이 느껴지는 부드러운 그림자와 약한 바닥 반사를 적용한다.
- Human travel context (side 20~25%): {인물 구성}은 보호자가 캐리어를 끌거나 아기 용품 가방을 정리하는 순간으로 배치한다. 얼굴은 자연스러운 거리감으로 처리하고, 손·팔·캐리어 높이와 유모차 크기가 비교되도록 한다.
- Travel utility props: {공항 소품}을 유모차 주변에 현실적으로 배치한다. 탑승권에는 간단한 좌석 표기, 러기지 태그에는 이름 대신 짧은 여행 문구, 캐리어에는 천 소재 네임택이나 스티커를 더해 실제 여행 컷처럼 보이게 한다.
- Signage and micro-copy: 후면 전광판이나 작은 안내 스탠드에 {탑승구 번호}, {노선 문구}, {제품 콜아웃}, {안내 문구}를 정확한 한국어로 렌더링한다. 텍스트는 공항 안내 사인처럼 읽기 쉽고, 제품 광고처럼 과장되지 않게 배치한다.
- Background architecture: 선택된 {여행 장면}의 구조를 살려 유리 파사드, 메탈 프레임, 탑승구 좌석, 면세점 조명, 호텔 컨시어지 데스크 등을 현실적으로 구성한다. 원근감은 자연스럽게 유지하고, 유모차가 가장 먼저 읽히는 상업 사진 구도를 유지한다.
- Clean product integrity: 원본 유모차의 프레임 비례, 바퀴 수와 위치, 패브릭 질감, 라벨/브랜드 로고/마킹, 안전벨트, 접이식 힌지 형태는 절대 변경하지 않는다. 주변 환경과 조명, 여행 소품만 장면에 맞게 바꾼다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 이미지 내 텍스트는 Pretendard Bold 또는 공항 안내판 스타일의 현대적 산세리프로 처리한다. 큰 안내판은 32~44px 느낌, 소형 태그와 탑승권은 12~18px 느낌으로 계층을 나눈다.
- Color palette: {컬러 무드}를 기반으로 #F4F7FA, #DCE7F3, #2F3A46, #FFFFFF, 메탈 실버, 은은한 공항 블루 포인트를 사용한다. 캐리어와 의류에는 차콜, 베이지, 네이비 등 실제 여행객에게 어울리는 색을 더한다.
- Border/shadow: 제품 하단에는 soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity를 적용하고, 바닥 반사는 제품 아래쪽에서만 약하게 표현한다. 장면 가장자리에는 실제 렌즈로 촬영한 듯한 자연스러운 깊이와 공간감을 둔다.
- Surface finish: 공항 장면은 매끈한 대형 타일, 브러시드 메탈, 유리 반사, 패브릭 좌석 질감을 살리고, 호텔 로비 장면은 저채도 석재 바닥과 부드러운 러그 질감을 적용한다.
- Product readability: 소품이나 인물이 유모차의 바퀴, 접이식 관절, 핸들, 시트 라인을 가리지 않도록 배치하되, 실제 여행 현장의 생활감은 유지한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V with 35mm f/4, commercial lifestyle product photography, sharp focus on stroller frame and wheels, minimal distortion.
- Lighting: {라이팅}을 기반으로 공항 천장 조명과 큰 창면에서 들어오는 약한 자연광을 측면 30~45°로 섞어 프레임 윤곽, 바퀴, 패브릭 질감이 또렷하게 보이도록 한다.
- Color grade: clean airport white + cool blue + charcoal with slightly lifted highlights and restrained saturation, polished travel-commerce finish.
- Depth and focus: 유모차와 바로 옆 캐리어는 선명하게, 먼 배경의 전광판과 통행객은 약한 심도로 부드럽게 처리해 상업 제품 컷과 여행 스냅의 균형을 만든다.

[6. MOOD]
Premium family travel retail product photo — modern airport editorial, practical parenting travel guide, polished Korean commerce campaign. 밝고 신뢰감 있으며, “아이와 함께 떠나는 여행 준비가 쉬워지는 순간”의 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 이미지 안에 들어가는 한국어는 반드시 깨짐 없이 자연스럽게 렌더링한다. 우선 사용 문구: “{탑승구 번호}”, “{노선 문구}”, “{여행 날짜}”, “{제품 콜아웃}”, “{안내 문구}”.
- Preserve the exact product from the reference image: precise shape, fabric, color, frame structure, label, brand logo, safety belts, wheels, folding hinge, and any printed marking must remain unchanged.
- Only the background, lighting, staging, props, signage, and travel context may change; do not redesign the stroller, add missing accessories to the stroller itself, or invent new product details.
- If a person appears, keep proportions natural and keep the stroller as the dominant subject. Hands may interact with handle or carry strap only if it matches the reference product structure.
- Render a realistic airport/travel environment with believable scale: stroller wheel size, carry-on suitcase height, gate seating, floor tile perspective, and signage distance must all align naturally.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Replacing the reference stroller with a different model

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean baby products anniversary family demo composite, vertical portrait for 100-day / 200-day / first-birthday celebratory use.
Reference-image-accurate i2i staging that keeps the exact product while turning it into a polished family milestone photo with realistic studio-card details, family warmth, and celebratory Korean text elements.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {원본 제품} occupies the lower-middle 35–45% of the frame, shown clearly as the hero object with the baby and family interacting around it in a believable anniversary portrait.
- Human arrangement: {레이아웃} with parents and baby balanced around the product, faces unobstructed, product fully visible, and hands placed naturally on the handle, seat edge, blanket, or beside the baby.
- Wardrobe styling: {의상} with coordinated family tones, soft knit socks or baby shoes, a small hairband or bow tie when appropriate, and natural studio grooming.
- Background treatment: {배경} rendered as a photographic set with layered celebration details such as a low floral arrangement, pastel balloons, wooden milestone blocks, a tiny rice-cake table, or a framed baby-name sign that supports the anniversary theme.
- Color direction: {컬러 무드} used across clothing accents, flowers, ribbon, cake topper, background wash, and card-style label elements so the scene feels cohesive and premium.
- Framing: vertical editorial family composition with a clear product base, warm parent-baby connection, and a small upper or side area reserved for the milestone title and date label.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Product fidelity layer — {원본 제품} must match the reference image exactly in shape, fabric/material, color, frame structure, label placement, brand logo, safety belts, wheels, printed marks, and overall proportions.
2. Milestone staging layer — place the family and baby around the product in a celebratory arrangement that reads clearly as {기념일}; include age-appropriate gestures such as a parent supporting the baby, a sibling holding a small flower, or the baby seated/posed safely near the product.
3. Celebration detail layer — add tasteful Korean studio props tied to the milestone: 백일상 느낌의 미니 떡 케이크, 돌잡이 소품 일부, pastel balloon cluster, floral garland, date card, baby-name tag, and fabric textures that enhance realism without hiding the product.
4. Background substitution layer — replace only the environment with {배경}, using a studio-quality beige gradient, soft curtain set, warm wooden floor, or gentle natural setting such as a flower garden, while keeping the product’s silhouette crisp.
5. Wardrobe harmonization layer — dress the family in {의상} with understated styling, coordinated layers, and fabric textures that complement the product without overpowering it.
6. Light shaping layer — use soft, flattering portrait lighting that preserves product edges and adds gentle depth to skin tones, baby clothing, flower petals, fabric, metal frame, plastic surfaces, and wheels.
7. Text-card integration layer — add a small Korean anniversary title, date/location label, caption, and studio-style tag as printed or overlay elements, positioned like a premium baby photo card.
8. Final realism layer — retain natural contact shadows, believable scale relationships, realistic baby posture, and tactile material detail so the product reads as real, physical, and unchanged from the source.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: include a polished Korean milestone title and small labels using Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Bold, title 38–52px, labels 18–28px, warm charcoal or muted brown; allow handwritten-style accent text only for the baby name.
- Required visible Korean text elements: title “{기념일} 기념 촬영”, baby name “{아기 이름}”, date “{촬영 날짜}”, location “{촬영 장소}”, caption “{캡션 문구}”, and a small studio tag “{스튜디오명}”.
- Optional decorative micro text: “우리 가족의 소중한 하루”, “D+{기념일 숫자}”, “BABY MILESTONE”, and hashtag-style tags such as “{해시태그}”.
- Color palette: {컬러 무드} with soft beige #E8DCCB, blush pink #EFC9C6, light blue #D7E7F5, warm ivory #FFF4E8, gentle sage #D8E4D2, and charcoal #3A3A3A, balanced into a warm Korean studio-family palette.
- Graphic treatment: use subtle card labels, small ribbon tabs, translucent date stickers, fine-line floral doodles, and realistic contact shadow under the product, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 with 50mm f/4, medium-format portrait framing, shallow but clean depth separation.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from front-right, plus a faint rim to separate the product from the background; keep reflections controlled and skin tones even.
- Color grade: warm beige base with restrained pastel accents, natural skin rendering, creamy highlights, detailed fabric texture, realistic floral colors, and slightly softened contrast reminiscent of premium Korean studio family photography.
- Material realism: preserve the product’s fabric weave, stitching, buckle sheen, wheel rubber, plastic texture, metal frame reflection, label ink, and any original printed text from the reference image.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean baby milestone family portrait — high-end studio portraiture with a warm photo-atelier feel, gentle celebration props, affectionate parent-baby interaction, and polished baby-photo-card presentation.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the visible Korean text exactly as “{기념일} 기념 촬영”, “{아기 이름}”, “{촬영 날짜}”, “{촬영 장소}”, “{캡션 문구}”, “{스튜디오명}”, and “{해시태그}”; all Korean characters must be legible and correctly spaced.
- If any original text exists on {원본 제품}, preserve it exactly as in the reference image, including brand logo, label placement, warning labels, stitching marks, and printed markings.
- Preserve product identity exactly: shape, fabric, color, frame structure, label, brand logo, safety belts, wheels, handles, harness parts, and any printed marking must remain unchanged.
- Do not alter the product dimensions, add missing features, redesign structural parts, move safety components, or cover key product details with people, flowers, balloons, or text.
- Baby and family pose must feel natural, safe, and anatomically correct, with realistic hands, fingers, feet, scale, eye direction, and parent support if the baby is sitting or standing.
- Celebration props and Korean card labels should enhance the milestone story while keeping {원본 제품} clearly recognizable as the hero object.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Fake government, hospital, safety-test, or award marks
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure likenesses

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean i2i stroller seasonal story panel, 4-cut grid for social media and catalog use.
Show one exact stroller product across four seasons with consistent composition, realistic outdoor lifestyle context, and rich seasonal details that make the scene feel like a premium family catalog spread.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 2x2 grid fills the full vertical canvas, with equal panels and thin white gutters; each panel keeps the same camera distance, stroller placement, and {비율}.
- The stroller occupies the lower-middle 45% of each panel, with the guardian’s back-facing figure from {인물} kept subtle and secondary so the product remains the hero.
- Keep {레이아웃} consistent across all 4 panels while adding believable real-world details inside each season: park benches in the distance, walkway textures, fallen petals or leaves, soft signage, lamp posts, tree trunks, snowbanks, and distant pedestrians rendered small and out of focus.
- Background treatment changes by season only: spring cherry blossoms, summer shade, autumn foliage, winter snow path, all in realistic outdoor surfaces and natural depth.
- {원본 유모차} stays identical in shape, fabric, frame, wheels, accessories, printed markings, and logo details across every panel.
- Add a refined editorial overlay system: small season labels, date/location chips, and tiny catalog-style photo credits placed near panel corners without covering the stroller.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Panel 1 (spring, top-left): {원본 유모차} placed on a soft pink cherry blossom walkway, with pale petals scattered near the wheels, flowering branches overhead, a distant park bench, subtle morning haze, and a bright airy park backdrop.
- Panel 2 (summer, top-right): {원본 유모차} under leafy tree shade, with crisp white-blue highlights, sun-dappled ground, a small water bottle or picnic mat far in the background, deeper green foliage, and cooler foliage contrast.

- Use {스펙 항목} as the informational content for the dimension annotations, compact callouts, and bottom table, with each metric separated clearly by visual hierarchy.
- Use {레이아웃} as the overall spatial template, but render it with a premium technical retail layout: aligned modules, readable hierarchy, clear scanning order, and realistic printed-chart density.
- Respect {비율} for the final composition and make the 1536x1024 canvas feel like a landscape catalog detail page.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Main product area: {원본 유모차} shown exactly as in the reference image, side-on and fully intact, with crisp cutout edges; keep all frame joints, wheels, belts, labels, logos, fabric seams, brake details, handle shape, and printed markings faithful to the source.
2. Dimension callout zone: place clean measurement arrows and thin guide lines around the stroller for width, depth, height, folded size, wheel diameter, seat height, and handle height; labels should align parallel to the measured edges, using small but legible Korean text.
3. Spec label strip: position {스펙 항목} as compact info chips near the product, including realistic labels like 사이즈, 중량, 적재 한도, 권장 연령·체중, 핸들 높이, 펼침, 접힘, cm, kg; use accent color tabs and tiny icon markers for fast scanning.
4. Bottom table area: add a structured specification table underneath or beside the hero product, with neat rows, thin separators, alternating soft-gray row fills, and consistent numeric alignment for cm and kg. Include realistic rows such as 펼침 크기, 접힘 크기, 본체 중량, 바퀴 지름, 장바구니 적재, 권장 사용 기간.
5. Retail metadata modules: add a small barcode area labeled SKU ST-1536-1024, a tiny QR-style square labeled 상세 비교 보기, a note block labeled 구매 전 확인, and a customer-info line such as 상담 10:00–17:00 / 온라인 전용 스펙표.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Lines and surfaces: thin 1px gray rules for table lines, slightly bolder accent measurement arrows, subtle soft drop shadow 3px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity under the stroller, plus faint grid ticks and paper-grain detail for a realistic spec-sheet finish.
- Graphic details: include small non-official badges such as 한눈에 보는 사이즈, 폴딩 체크, 기내 반입 참고, and 실측 기준, styled as informational tags rather than seals or certifications.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Keep panel spacing even, with clean vertical dividers, step-number badges, directional arrows, and consistent camera angle across all panels so the workflow reads as one continuous demonstration.
- Preserve the exact product appearance from {원본 유모차}; only change staging, background, lighting, hand placement, fold state, and usage context to match {시연 구성}.
- Add tasteful detail-page style annotations: one short headline strip, three panel captions, subtle motion arrows near the handle/frame, and a small bottom note area for portability benefits.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Left panel: show {원본 유모차} in a ready-to-use state, with {인물} demonstrating one-handed opening in a clear upright pose; stroller should be readable from wheelbase to handlebar, with a small STEP 01 badge and caption.
2) Middle panel: show the folding motion from the same viewpoint, with {인물} compressing the frame in a realistic step-by-step manner; add a curved arrow following the fold trajectory and keep the mechanism visually believable.
3) Right panel: show the folded stroller being carried on the shoulder or placed into a vehicle trunk, with {인물} and {배경} reinforcing compact portability, grip comfort, and easy transport.
4) Maintain identical product proportions and consistent perspective across all 3 panels so the user can compare the ready, folding, and carried/loaded states without visual distortion.
5) Include small realistic UI-like labels such as “한 손”, “접힘”, “트렁크 적재” near the relevant action zones, plus a page-detail micro caption line along the bottom.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard SemiBold for headers and STEP labels, Pretendard Regular for supporting notes; 26–34 px for main top headline, 22–28 px for panel captions, 14–18 px for micro labels and bottom notes.
- Color palette: neutral home-and-auto palette with warm white, soft gray, charcoal, muted beige, and soft sand accents; use accent tones close to #F4F1EA, #D9D6CF, #4A4A4A, #B89C7A, and a subtle safety-yellow highlight for arrows or step dots.
- Border/shadow: use thin 1–2 px vertical separators between panels, rounded step badges, and a soft natural contact shadow under stroller wheels and trunk floor contact points, about 4 px y-offset, 12 px blur, 15% opacity.
- Graphic details: add small arrow strokes, dotted guide marks, compact info chips, and a bottom benefit strip; all graphics must feel like an e-commerce detail-page overlay and must not obscure handles, wheels, brakes, belts, or folding joints.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Sony A7R V with a 35mm f/4 documentary product lens look, straight-on perspective, moderate depth of field, natural framing.
- Lighting: {라이팅}, soft natural daylight from an adjacent window or open garage area, slightly from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill on the shadow side and controlled highlights on metal/plastic frame parts.
- Color grade: clean realistic daylight grade with slightly warm highlights, neutral mids, accurate fabric color, accurate frame geometry, and restrained contrast to keep product materials readable.
- Realism: hands, sleeves, shoulder strap posture, trunk opening height, wheel contact, and floor/trunk shadows should look physically plausible and consistent between panels.

[6. MOOD]
Practical e-commerce demonstration with warm real-home credibility — like a polished shopping detail page shot that still feels photographed in an actual entryway and car trunk setting.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Render Korean text exactly as: “{상단헤드라인}”, “STEP 01 {패널1문구}”, “STEP 02 {패널2문구}”, “STEP 03 {패널3문구}”, “{하단보조문구}”.
- Korean text accuracy: all Korean labels must be legible, correctly spaced, and without broken characters.
- Preserve the exact product from the reference image: same shape, fabric, color, frame structure, label, logo, safety belts, wheels, and any printed marking.
- Show the carry/fold sequence clearly in 3 panels, with the same stroller model and consistent proportions in every panel.
- Face visibility is optional and should remain restrained; the handling action by the {인물} must still read clearly through hands, arms, shoulder, and posture.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Product redesign, dimension changes, invented features, missing belts, missing wheels, or altered frame geometry

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Newborn car seat first-outing safety demonstration i2i poster, vertical 3-panel educational composition for parent guidance and product-safe staging.
Precise product fidelity is the priority: preserve the exact car seat from the reference while changing only environment, lighting, scene arrangement, instructional graphics, and poster information layers.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {원본 카시트} occupies 55–65% of the frame across the 3 scenes, with the product always clearly readable and never cropped off.
- Scene format: {장면} arranged as a realistic editorial safety storyboard with three stacked panels, visible panel numbers, Korean captions, thin separators, and consistent perspective across panels.
- People presence: {인물 결} placed as supporting hands/partial body context, keeping the infant calm and the safety action clear; face visibility should remain restrained and non-distracting.
- Detail emphasis: {포인트} highlighted with close-up callout circles, small arrow labels, and tight framing so straps, anchors, buckle position, shoulder height, recline angle, and support parts are unmistakable.
- Background treatment: realistic first-outing environments with believable hospital discharge cues, a family entryway, and a rear-seat car interior; include natural objects such as a folded muslin blanket, diaper bag edge, discharge papers, baby socks, seat base, door trim, and soft upholstery textures where appropriate.
- Poster information layer: add a top event-style header, small schedule strip, sponsor/organizer area, registration or ticket-info bar, and a practical bottom checklist while keeping the safety demonstration visually dominant.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Poster header area — above the three panels, set a professional Korean title: “신생아 첫 외출 카시트 안전 시연”, small issue/date label “VOL.1088 · 2026년 5월”, and subline “퇴원부터 차량 탑승까지, 보호자가 함께 확인하는 3단계 체크”. Include a compact info strip: “일시 2026.05.16 토 10:30 · 장소 가족교육실 B · 참가비 무료 · 사전예약”.
2. Panel 1 — hospital discharge context: place {원본 카시트} in a rear-seat or hand-carry safety setup near a hospital discharge area, showing a calm departure moment with reception signage blur, pale blue wayfinding board, folded discharge document, and clear mounting orientation. Add panel label “STEP 01 병원 출발 전 각도 확인” and small callouts “45° 리클라인”, “머리 흔들림 체크”.
3. Panel 2 — home preparation context: show {인물 결} securing the infant into the seat in a bright living-room or entryway scene, with hands carefully tightening the harness and the product centered at mid-frame. Add realistic home details such as a wooden console edge, soft rug texture, small changing pouch, and warm daylight. Add panel label “STEP 02 하네스는 손가락 한 개 여유” with arrows to shoulder strap and chest clip.
4. Panel 3 — in-car safety detail: close-up on {포인트}, with the harness path, buckle, chest clip, seat base contact, head support, and fabric texture visible in crisp detail; use a tight crop that still preserves the exact product geometry. Add panel label “STEP 03 버클·헤드서포트 최종 점검” and micro labels “꼬임 없음”, “가슴 중앙”, “목 지지 확인”.
5. Across all panels: keep {원본 카시트} identical in shape, fabric texture, color, label placement, brand markings, belt layout, and structural proportions; only the staging, lighting, background, and overlay graphics may change.
6. Bottom checklist and sponsor area: include a practical footer with four short Korean checklist items — “□ 리클라인 각도”, “□ 어깨끈 높이”, “□ 버클 잠금음”, “□ 베이스 흔들림” — plus a small organizer line “주최: 우리동네 육아안전 클래스” and “문의 @babyride_safe · 02-0000-1088”. Use a small QR-like registration square or ticket stub graphic labeled “예약 확인”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium-to-semibold weight, 26–34px for panel captions; 52–68px for the main Korean poster title; 16–22px for micro labels, schedule, footer, and organizer text. Keep all Korean text crisp, legible, and naturally spaced.
- Color palette: {컬러 무드} with clean white #F7F9FC, medical blue #4A86C5, charcoal #2E3138, soft gray #D9E2EC, plus warm beige #E8D8C7 and muted baby-blue #BFD7EE accents for a realistic family-health poster feel.
- Border/shadow: thin white separators between panels, subtle soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity to lift the product and paper-poster layers from the background.
- Surface styling: smooth matte interior surfaces, visible fabric weave on the car seat, gentle leather or cloth texture in the vehicle seat, soft paper texture in the poster footer, and realistic reflections only where they support material readability.
- Graphic elements: use small blue check icons, numbered circles, arrow leaders, angle arc diagrams, and soft translucent callout bubbles to guide the viewer through the safety actions.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 medium-format look with 50mm f/5.6 for the wide scenes, plus a 90mm macro-style close-up for buckle and strap detail.
- Lighting: {라이팅}; soft daylight from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from front-right; hospital and home scenes should look evenly lit, with clean controlled contrast and natural contact shadows under the seat, hands, and car interior details.
- Color grade: cool clean whites with restrained blue cast, neutral skin tones, slightly desaturated charcoal shadows, and soft warm highlights on home textures for a premium infant-safety editorial finish.
- Camera consistency: {카메라}; keep the same product scale logic across panels, with accurate lens compression and realistic depth of field that keeps all safety details readable.
- Aspect ratio: {비율}, vertical poster layout optimized for 1024x1536.

[6. MOOD]
Premium infant-safety editorial — like a trusted hospital brochure meets a high-end parenting guide and local parent-class event poster. Calm, credible, practical, warm, and real: the image should feel like an actual printed safety guide photographed and designed for new parents preparing their first ride home.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the following on-image Korean cleanly and legibly where used: “신생아 첫 외출 카시트 안전 시연”, “STEP 01 병원 출발 전 각도 확인”, “STEP 02 하네스는 손가락 한 개 여유”, “STEP 03 버클·헤드서포트 최종 점검”, “45° 리클라인”, “꼬임 없음”, “가슴 중앙”, “목 지지 확인”, “일시 2026.05.16 토 10:30”, “장소 가족교육실 B”, “참가비 무료”, “예약 확인”. No broken Korean characters.
- Product fidelity: replicate the exact car seat from the reference image — preserve precise shape, fabric, color, frame structure, label, brand logo, safety belts, wheels, and any printed marking.
- Layout invariants: all 3 scenes must show the same product identity consistently, with no redesign, no added product features, and no altered proportions.
- Safety correctness: belt routing, buckles, ISOFIX connection, recline angle, chest clip position, and head support must appear logically and anatomically correct for infant car-seat use.
- Infant and caregiver depiction: infant must appear calm, safely clothed, and properly supported; caregiver hands should demonstrate gentle, correct adjustment without blocking the key safety points.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals, certifications, or medical endorsements
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
- Unsafe infant depiction or anatomically incorrect car-seat safety setup

[1. PURPOSE]
Premium department-store stroller demo cut for i2i product advertising, vertical editorial-style showcase with realistic luxury retail staging.
Designed to keep the exact stroller from the reference image while upgrading only the environment, lighting, presentation, and surrounding showroom context.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {원본 유모차} occupies the lower center 55–60% of the frame, presented as the clear hero product in a refined department-store stroller demonstration zone.
- Supporting figures: {인물} placed naturally behind or beside the stroller at the 20–25% depth zone, as a parent consultant or sales advisor interaction, kept secondary so the stroller remains the visual focus.
- Location treatment: {장소 결} rendered as a polished premium baby-goods showroom with marble flooring, brushed gold accents, warm display shelves, stroller comparison stands, fabric swatch trays, and soft indirect reflections.
- Retail context elements: include a slim product information placard beside the stroller, a small brochure holder, discreet floor directory signage, and a tasteful counter display with folded catalogs to make the scene feel like a real premium store demo.
- Framing: vertical premium catalog composition, slightly low eye-level angle to give the stroller a showroom-presented presence without changing its shape or proportions.
- Material realism: {원본 유모차} must remain fully faithful to the reference image, with all fabric, frame, wheels, belts, labels, and markings preserved exactly.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Foreground product zone: {원본 유모차} placed realistically on the polished floor with natural contact shadows and wheel reflections; wheels aligned naturally, product geometry unchanged.
- Midground lifestyle zone: {인물} positioned as a soft contextual presence, dressed and posed naturally as if explaining the stroller handle height or checking the canopy, with restrained facial emphasis so the stroller stays dominant.
- Background retail zone: {장소 결} expanded into a premium department-store interior with marble texture, warm gold trims, softly blurred retail shelving, glass display cases, hanging store lights, baby-care product boxes, neutral textile samples, and a concierge-style consultation desk.
- Signage and demo details: add realistic Korean retail signage such as a wall sign reading “프리미엄 유모차 시연”, a small placard reading “NEW ARRIVAL”, and a counter card reading “주말 상담 예약”; use clear but secondary typography.
- Lighting design: {라이팅} used to create clean highlights on the stroller canopy, seat, wheel rims, and frame edges while keeping the background luxurious and softly atmospheric.
- Camera rendering: {카메라} look with crisp product-detail sharpness, controlled depth of field, and clean separation between stroller, people, signage, and background.
- Format handling: {비율} composition should feel like a high-end vertical ad layout, with the stroller centered and luxury surroundings arranged symmetrically enough for a premium catalog image.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: visible store signage and product cards should use clean modern sans-serif styling similar to Pretendard/Noto Sans KR, medium weight, accurate Korean, understated luxury retail scale.
- Korean text to render in scene: “프리미엄 유모차 시연”, “5월 주말 상담”, “백화점 베이비관 4F”, “상담 예약”, “₩1,280,000부터”, “NEW ARRIVAL”.
- Color palette: {컬러 무드} translated into deep charcoal, black gradient shadows, brushed gold, soft ivory white, warm beige stone, and restrained warm neutral highlights.
- Border/shadow: soft studio-style contact shadow under the stroller, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity; integrate it naturally with the marble-floor reflection.
- Surface treatment: polished marble or stone floor with subtle reflections, premium store finish, realistic brushed metal trims, soft glass highlights, leather seating texture, and neatly arranged showroom display materials.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One medium-format look with 80mm f/4, product-catalog sharpness, gentle depth separation, refined compression.
- Lighting: boutique retail indirect lighting from overhead and side sources, plus a controlled key spot aimed at the stroller; soft fill to prevent harsh contrast, slight rim highlight on metallic frame parts.
- Color grade: dark gradient luxury grade with gold accents and white balance leaning slightly warm-neutral, similar to high-end department store campaign photography.
- Realism details: include fine marble veining, subtle fingerprints on brochure acrylic, soft reflections below the wheels, fabric texture on showroom seating, small price-card shadows, and realistic depth blur on distant shelf items.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury retail campaign still — a premium department-store stroller presentation with the polished editorial feel of an Aesop-style product scene, high-end mall showroom advertising, and a believable in-store consultation moment.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all visible Korean text must be legible and correctly formed, especially “프리미엄 유모차 시연”, “5월 주말 상담”, “백화점 베이비관 4F”, “상담 예약”, and “₩1,280,000부터”.
- Exact product preservation: replicate the stroller from the reference image exactly — preserve shape, fabric, color, frame structure, label, brand logo, safety belts, wheels, and any printed marking.
- Composition invariant: only the background, lighting, retail signage, and staging may change; do not redesign the stroller or invent new stroller mechanisms.
- Human anatomy: if {인물} is visible, hands, fingers, face, and body proportions must remain anatomically correct and natural.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-1086.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
유모차를 중심으로 한 i2i 산책 라이프스타일 컷. 한강 변이나 공원 보행 동선을 배경으로, 원본 제품을 그대로 보존한 채 실제 주말 외출처럼 살아 있는 가족 산책 분위기를 만드는 1536x1024 가로형 라이프 스냅.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {원본 유모차} is the clear hero subject, occupying the lower-middle 55% of the frame with the stroller angled slightly 10–15° in the walking direction.
- {인물 결} is placed behind or beside the stroller, with face naturally de-emphasized by angle, distance, hair, cap, or back view; keep attention on the stroller silhouette, wheels, handle, and walking motion.
- {산책 장소} background is staged with a real outdoor pathway feel: river railing, park trees, paved walkway, bicycle lane edge, grass verge, benches, or soft urban greenery, depending on the chosen location.
- Add {주변 디테일} as believable everyday context around the path: distant jogger, passing bicycle, folded picnic mat, paper coffee cup on a bench, stroller bag, fallen leaves, water bottle, small dog walker, or family picnic silhouettes.
- {계절·시간} should control foliage, ground tone, clothing thickness, stroller shadow length, sky color, and atmosphere so the whole scene reads as one coherent season instead of mixed cues.
- If signage appears naturally in the scene, use {장소 표기} as small background Korean text on a park wayfinding sign, riverside marker, or event banner; it must be secondary and not look like a graphic overlay.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Product preservation layer — Keep {원본 유모차} identical to the reference image: same frame geometry, fabric texture, wheel design, belt placement, handles, label/marking placement, stitching, canopy shape, basket position, brake parts, and visible hardware.
2. Motion/staging layer — Place the stroller naturally on a walkway or riverside path as if captured mid-stroll, with subtle rolling posture, believable wheel contact, and matched cast shadows on pavement texture.
3. Human context layer — Render {인물 결} as a supportive presence with restrained body visibility; clothing should feel like real outdoor wear for {계절·시간}, such as linen shirt, trench coat, cardigan, sneakers, ball cap, tote bag, or light scarf depending on season.
4. Environment layer — Build {산책 장소} around the stroller using believable landscape cues: river edge guardrail, park trees, trimmed grass, sidewalk paving, street trees, bench rows, bicycle lane paint, low shrubs, flower beds, or distant apartment skyline.
5. Everyday detail layer — Integrate {주변 디테일} in the midground and background to create lived-in realism without attaching new parts to the stroller or hiding key product details.
6. Time-of-day layer — Apply {계절·시간} through shadow length, leaf density, ambient temperature, clothing texture, background color temperature, and ground material; keep the effect realistic and scene-wide.
7. Light layer — Shape the scene with {라이팅} so the stroller, human figure, pavement, props, and background share one direction of light and matching shadow softness.
8. Camera layer — Frame with {카메라} as a candid lifestyle photo, preserving enough outdoor context for a social-media-ready wide composition while keeping the stroller intact and clearly readable.
9. Final realism pass — Ensure the stroller remains the exact product from the reference image, with no redesign, no invented logo, no missing structural parts, and no unrealistic scale shift.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: environmental Korean text is allowed only when it naturally belongs to the location, such as {장소 표기} on a small wayfinding sign, park notice board, riverside distance marker, or café sandwich board; any text must be clean, legible, and perspective-matched.
- Color palette: soft spring green, river blue-gray, warm beige pavement, leaf shadow olive, sky white, muted charcoal for frame details, seasonal accent colors from flowers, leaves, clothing, or picnic items; keep saturation moderate and natural.
- Surface detail: include realistic pavement seams, tactile paving strips, fine dust, grass texture, tree bark, rippled river highlights, bench wood grain, stroller fabric weave, wheel rubber, and soft leaf shadows.
- Border/shadow: no graphic border; use only real-world depth, lens falloff, and natural cast shadow under wheels and frame, with soft edge falloff and realistic contact darkening.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Leica Q3, 28mm f/4, candid lifestyle snapshot framing with moderate depth of field.
- Lighting: {라이팅}; key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from open sky, realistic shadow direction matching the walkway, soft highlights on stroller frame and canopy fabric.
- Color grade: warm daylight with slightly cool river/park balance, creamy highlights, soft green mids, restrained contrast, realistic skin/clothing tones, and gentle filmic micro-contrast.
- Composition feel: documentary family outing, slightly low adult-eye perspective, natural horizon, subtle foreground texture from pavement or leaves, background depth with recognizable but not distracting park life.

[6. MOOD]
Editorial outdoor family lifestyle — 따뜻한 주말 산책, 한강 바람, 공원 나무 그늘, 실제 육아 외출의 편안함이 있는 프리미엄 라이프 스냅.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: if background signage is used, render only short readable Korean such as “한강 산책로”, “공원 안내”, “자전거 천천히”, “피크닉존”, “오늘의 산책”; avoid warped, random, or broken Hangul.

- Background/staging may change only; the stroller itself must not be redesigned, beautified, resized unnaturally, recolored, simplified, or modified in any structural way.
